verses.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.am: ምስጉን ነው በክፉዎች ምክር ያልሄደ፥ በኃጢአተኞችም መንገድ ያልቆመ፥ በዋዘኞችም ወንበር ያልተቀመጠ።

verses.en: But his delight is in the law of YAHUAH; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ደስ ይለዋል፥ ሕጉንም በቀንና በሌሊት ያስባል።

verses.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.am: እርሱም በውኃ ፈሳሾች ዳር እንደ ተተከለች፥ ፍሬዋን በየጊዜዋ እንደምትሰጥ፥ ቅጠልዋም እንደማይረግፍ ዛፍ ይሆናል፤ የሚሠራውም ሁሉ ይከናወንለታል።

verses.en: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.am: ክፉዎች እንዲህ አይደሉም፥ ነገር ግን ነፋስ ጠርጎ እንደሚወስደው ትቢያ ናቸው።

verses.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ክፉዎች በፍርድ፥ ኃጢአተኞችም በጻድቃን ማኅበር አይቆሙም።

verses.en: For YAHUAH knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጻድቃንን መንገድ ያውቃልና፥ የክፉዎች መንገድ ግን ትጠፋለች።

verses.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.am: አሕዛብ ለምን ያጕረመርማሉ? ወገኖችስ ለምን ከንቱን ይናገራሉ?

verses.en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against YAHUAH, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.am: የምድር ነገሥታት ተነሡ፥ አለቆችም በእግዚአብሔርና በመሢሑ ላይ እንዲህ ሲሉ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.am: ማሰርያቸውን እንበጥስ፥ ገመዳቸውንም ከእኛ እንጣል።

verses.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: YAHUAH shall have them in derision.
verses.am: በሰማይ የሚኖር እርሱ ይሥቃል፥ ጌታም ይሣለቅባቸዋል።

verses.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በቍጣው ይናገራቸዋል፥ በመዓቱም ያውካቸዋል።

verses.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ንጉሤን ሾምሁ በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ በጽዮን ላይ።

verses.en: I will declare the decree: YAHUAH hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.am: ትእዛዙን እናገራለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር አለኝ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወለድሁህ።

verses.en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.am: ለምነኝ፥ አሕዛብን ለርስትህ የምድርንም ዳርቻ ለግዛትህ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
verses.am: በብረት በትር ትጠብቃቸዋለህ፥ እንደ ሸክላ ሠሪ ዕቃዎች ትቀጠቅጣቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.am: አሁንም እናንት ነገሥታት፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤ እናንት የምድር ፈራጆችም፥ ተገሠጹ።

verses.en: Serve YAHUAH with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በፍርሃት ተገዙ፥ በረዓድም ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verses.am: ተግሣጹን ተቀበሉ ጌታ እንዳይቈጣ እናንተም በመንገድ እንዳትጠፉ፥ ቍጣው ፈጥና ትነድዳለችና። በእርሱ የታመኑ ሁሉ የተመሰገኑ ናቸው።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, when he fled from Absalom his son.] YAHUAH, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሚያስጨንቁኝ ምንኛ በዙ! በኔ ላይ የሚቆሙት ብዙ ናቸው።

verses.en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in YAHUAH. Selah.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ነፍሴን። አምላክሽ አያድንሽም አልዋት።

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.am: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ መጠጊያዬ ነህ፥ ክብሬንና ራሴንም ከፍ ከፍ የምታደርገው አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: I cried unto YAHUAH with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.am: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጮሃለሁ ከተቀደሰ ተራራውም ይሰማኛል።

verses.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for YAHUAH sustained me.
verses.am: እኔ ተኛሁ አንቀላፋሁም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደግፎኛልና ነቃሁ።

verses.en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.am: ከሚከብቡኝ ከአእላፍ ሕዝብ አልፈራም።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH; save me, O my YAHUAH: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.am: ተነሥ፥ አቤቱ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አድነኝ፤ አንተ የጠላቶቼን መንጋጋ መትተሃልና፥ የክፉዎችንም ጥርስ ሰብረሃልና።

verses.en: Salvation belongeth unto YAHUAH: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
verses.am: ማዳን የእግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በረከትህም በሕዝብህ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear me when I call, O YAHUAH of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.am: የጽድቄ አምላክ በጠራሁት ጊዜ መለሰልኝ፥ በጭንቀቴም አሰፋህልኝ፤ ማረኝ፥ ጸሎቴንም ስማ።

verses.en: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.am: እናንት የሰው ልጆች፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ልባችሁን ታከብዳላችሁ?

verses.en: But know that YAHUAH hath set apart him that is godly for himself: YAHUAH will hear when I call unto him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በጻድቁ እንደ ተገለጠ እወቁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ወደ እርሱ በተጣራሁ ጊዜ ይሰማኛል።

verses.en: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.am: ተቈጡ፥ ነገር ግን ኃጢአትን አታድርጉ፤ በመኝታችሁ ሳላችሁ በልባችሁ አስቡ፤ ዝም በሉ።

verses.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in YAHUAH.
verses.am: የጽድቅን መሥዋዕት ሠዉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ታመኑ።

verses.en: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? YAHUAH, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.am: በጎውን ማን ያሳየናል? የሚሉ ብዙ ናቸው። አቤቱ፥ የፊትህ ብርሃን በላያችን ታወቀ።

verses.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
verses.am: በልቤ ደስታን ጨመርህ፤ ከስንዴ ፍሬና ከወይን ከዘይትም ይልቅ በዛ።

verses.en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, YAHUAH, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.am: በሰላም እተኛለሁ አንቀላፋለሁም፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብቻህን በእምነት አሳድረኸኛልና።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of Dawid.] Give ear to my words, O YAHUAH, consider my meditation.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቃሌን አድምጥ፥ ጩኸቴንም አስተውል፤

verses.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my YAHUAH: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.am: የልመናዬን ቃል አድምጥ፥ ንጉሤና አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ እጸልያለሁና።

verses.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O YAHUAH; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.am: በማለዳ ድምፄን ትሰማለህ፥ በማለዳ በፊትህ እቆማለሁ፥ እጠብቃለሁም።

verses.en: For thou art not a YAHUAH that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.am: አንተ በደልን የማትወድድ አምላክ ነህና፤ ክፉ ከአንተ ጋር አያድርም።

verses.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.am: በከንቱ የሚመኩ በዓይኖችህ ፊት አይኖሩም፤ ክፉ አድራጊዎችን ሁሉ ጠላህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: YAHUAH will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.am: ሐሰትን የሚናገሩትን ታጠፋቸዋለህ፤ ደም አፍሳሹንና ሸንጋዩን ሰው እግዚአብሔር ይጸየፋል።

verses.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በምሕረትህ ብዛት ወደ ቤትህ እገባለሁ፤ አንተን በመፍራት ወደ ቅድስናህ መቅደስ እሰግዳለሁ።

verses.en: Lead me, O YAHUAH, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ጠላቶቼ በጽድቅህ ምራኝ፤ መንገዴን በፊትህ አቅና።

verses.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.am: በአፋቸው እውነት የለምና፥ ልባቸውም ከንቱ ነው፤ ጕሮሮአቸው የተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፤ በምላሳቸው ይሸነግላሉ።

verses.en: Destroy thou them, O YAHUAH; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍረድባቸው፥ በምክራቸውም ይውደቁ፤ ስለ ክፋታቸውም ብዛት አሳድዳቸው፥ እነርሱ ዐምፀውብሃልና።

verses.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.am: በአንተ የሚታመኑት ሁሉ ግን ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ለዘላለሙ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ እነርሱንም ትጠብቃለህ፤ ስምህንም የሚወድዱ ሁሉ በአንተ ይመካሉ።

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verses.am: አንተ ጻድቁን ትባርከዋለህና፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ጋሻ በሞገስ ከለልኸን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣህ አትቅሠፈኝ፥ በመዓትህም አትገሥጸኝ።

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O YAHUAH; for I am weak: O YAHUAH, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.am: ድውይ ነኝና አቤቱ፥ ማረኝ፤ አጥንቶቼ ታውከዋልና ፈውሰኝ።

verses.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O YAHUAH, how long?
verses.am: ነፍሴም እጅግ ታወከች፤ አንተም አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው?

verses.en: Return, O YAHUAH, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ ነፍሴንም አድናት፥ ስለ ቸርነትህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.am: በሞት የሚያስብህ የለምና፥ በሲኦልም የሚያመሰግንህ ማን ነው?

verses.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.am: በጭንቀቴ ደክሜያለሁ፤ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አልጋዬን አጥባለሁ፥ በዕንባዬም መኝታዬን አርሳለሁ።

verses.en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.am: ዓይኔ ከቍጡ ዕንባ የተነሣ ታወከች፤ ከጠላቶቼ ሁሉ የተነሣ አረጀሁ።

verses.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for YAHUAH hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.am: ዓመፃን የምታደርጉ ሁሉ፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥ እግዚአብሔር የልቅሶዬን ቃል ሰምቶአልና።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath heard my supplication; YAHUAH will receive my prayer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልመናዬን ሰማኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ጸሎቴን ተቀበለ።

verses.en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ይፈሩ እጅግም ይጐስቍሉ፤ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ፥ በፍጥነትም ይፈሩ።

verses.en: [Shiggaion of Dawid, which he sang unto YAHUAH, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.] O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ በአንተ ታመንሁ፤ ከሚያሳድዱኝ ሁሉ አድነኝና አውጣኝ፥

verses.en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.am: ነፍሴን እንደ አንበሳ ነጥቀው እንዳይሰብሩዋት፥ የሚያድንና የሚታደግ ሳይኖር።

verses.en: O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እንዲህስ ካደረግሁ፥ ዓመፃም በእጄ ቢኖር፥

verses.en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.am: ክፉ ላደረጉብኝም ክፉን መልሼላቸው ብሆን፥ ጠላቴንም በከንቱ ገፍቼው ብሆን፥

verses.en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.am: ጠላት ነፍሴን ያሳድዳት ያግኛትም፥ ሕይወቴንም በምድር ላይ ይርገጣት፥ ክብሬንም በትቢያ ላይ ያዋርዳት።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በመዓትህ ተነሥ፥ በጠላቶቼ ላይ በቍጣ ተነሣባቸው፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ባዘዝኸው ትእዛዝ ንቃ።

verses.en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.am: የአሕዛብም ጉባኤ ይከብብሃል፥ በእነርሱም ላይ ወደ ከፍታ ተመለስ።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall judge the people: judge me, O YAHUAH, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ይፈርዳል፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ጽድቄ ፍረድልኝ፥ እንደ የዋህነቴም ይሁንልኝ።

verses.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous YAHUAH trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.am: የኃጥኣን ክፋት ይጥፋ፥ ጻድቁን ግን አቅና፤ እግዚአብሔር ልቡናንና ኵላሊትን ይመረምራል።

verses.en: My defence is of YAHUAH, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጽድቅ ጋሻዬ ነው ልበ ቅኖችን የሚያድናቸው።

verses.en: YAHUAH judgeth the righteous, and YAHUAH is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የእውነት ዳኛ ነው፥ ኃይለኛም ታጋሽም ነው፥ ሁልጊዜም አይቈጣም።

verses.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.am: ባትመለሱ ግን ሰይፉን ይስላል፥ ቀስቱን ገተረ አዘጋጀም፤

verses.en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.am: የሞት መሣርያንም አዘጋጀበት፥ ፍላጻዎቹንም የሚቃጠሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዓመፃ ተጨነቀ ጉዳትን ፀነሰ ኃጢአትንም ወለደ።

verses.en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.am: ጕድጓድን ማሰ ቈፈረም። ባደረገውም ጕድጓድ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.am: ጉዳቱ በራሱ ይመለሳል፥ ዓመፃውም በአናቱ ላይ ትወርዳለች።

verses.en: I will praise YAHUAH according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of YAHUAH most high.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ጽድቁ መጠን አመሰግናለሁ፥ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔርም ስም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH our YAHUAH, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታችን፥ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ተመሰገነ፥ ምስጋናህ በሰማዮች ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.am: ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡ ልጆች አፍ ምስጋናን አዘጋጀህ ስለ ጠላትህ፥ ጠላትንና ቂመኛን ለማጥፋት።

verses.en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.am: የጣቶችህን ሥራ ሰማዮችን ባየሁ ጊዜ፥ ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን አንተ የሠራሃቸውን፥

verses.en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.am: ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ትጐበኘውም ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.am: ከመላእክት እጅግ ጥቂት አሳነስኸው፤ በክብርና በምስጋና ዘውድ ከለልኸው።

verses.en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.am: በእጆችህም ሥራ ሁሉ ላይ ሾምኸው፤ ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት፥

verses.en: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.am: በጎችንም ላሞችንም ሁሉ ደግሞም የምድረ በዳውን እንስሶች፥

verses.en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.am: የሰማይንም ወፎች የባሕርንም ዓሦች፥ በባሕር መንገድ የሚሄደውንም ሁሉ።

verses.en: O YAHUAH our YAHUAH, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታችን፥ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ተመሰገነ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of Dawid.] I will praise thee, O YAHUAH, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ እነግራለሁ።

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.am: በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሐሤትንም አደርጋለሁ፤ ልዑል ሆይ፥ ለስምህ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ወደ ኋላ በተመለሱ ጊዜ፥ ይሰናከላሉ ከፊትህም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.am: ፍርዴንና በቀሌን አድርገህልኛልና፤ ጽድቅን እየፈረድህ በዙፋንህ ላይ ተቀመጥህ።

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.am: አሕዛብን ገሠጽህ፥ ዝንጉዎችንም አጠፋህ፥ ስማቸውንም ለዘላለም ደመሰስህ።

verses.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.am: ጠላቶች በጦር ለዘላለም ጠፉ፥ ከተሞቻቸውንም አፈረስህ፥ ዝክራቸውም በአንድነት ጠፋ።

verses.en: But YAHUAH shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል፥ ዙፋኑንም ለመፍረድ አዘጋጀ፤

verses.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.am: እርሱም ዓለምን በጽድቅ ይፈርዳታል፥ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይዳኛቸዋል።

verses.en: YAHUAH also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለድሆች መጠጊያ ሆናቸው፥ እርሱም በመከራቸው ጊዜ ረዳታቸው ነው።

verses.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, YAHUAH, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.am: ስምህን የሚያውቁ ሁሉ በአንተ ይታመናሉ፥ አቤቱ፥ የሚሹህን አትተዋቸውምና።

verses.en: Sing praises to YAHUAH, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.am: በጽዮን ለሚኖር ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል አደራረጉን ንገሩ፤

verses.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.am: ደማቸውን የሚመራመር እርሱ አስቦአልና፥ የድሆችንም ጩኸት አልረሳምና።

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O YAHUAH; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እዘንልኝ፥ ጠላቶቼም የሚያመጡብኝን መከራ እይ፥ ከሞት ደጆች ከፍ ከፍ የምታደርገኝ፤

verses.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.am: ምስጋናውን ሁሉ እናገር ዘንድ፤ በጽዮን ልጅ በደጆችዋ በማዳንህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.am: አሕዛብ በሠሩት ጕድጓድ ወደቁ፥ በዚያችም በሸሸጓት ወጥመድ እግራቸው ተጠመደች።

verses.en: YAHUAH is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን በማድረግ የታወቀ ነው፤ ኃጢአተኛው በእጆቹ ሥራ ተጠመደ።

verses.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ወደ ሲኦል ይመለሳሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚረሱ አሕዛብም ሁሉ።

verses.en: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.am: ድሀ ለዘላለም አይረሳምና፥ የችግረኞችም ተስፋቸው ለዘላለም አይጠፋም።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፤ ሰውም አይበርታ፥ አሕዛብም በፊትህ ይፈረድባቸው።

verses.en: Put them in fear, O YAHUAH: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍርሃትን በላያቸው ጫንባቸው፤ አሕዛብ ሰዎች እንደ ሆኑ ይወቁ።

verses.en: Why standest thou afar off, O YAHUAH? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለምን ርቀህ ቆምህ? በመከራም ጊዜ ለምን ትሰወራለህ?

verses.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.am: በኃጢአተኛ ትዕቢት ድሀ ይናደዳል፤ ባሰቡት ተንኰላቸው ተጠመዱ።

verses.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom YAHUAH abhorreth.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ በነፍሱ ፈቃድ ይወደሳልና፥ ዓመፀኛም ይባርካል።

verses.en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after YAHUAH: YAHUAH is not in all his thoughts.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ እግዚአብሔርን አበሳጨው፥ እንደ ቍጣውም ብዛት አይመራመረውም በእርሱ ፊት እግዚአብሔር የለም።

verses.en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.am: መንገዱ ሁሉ የረከሰ ነው፥ ፍርድህም በፊቱ የፈረሰ ነው፥ ጠላቶችንም ሁሉ ይገዛቸዋል።

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.am: በልቡ ይላል። ለልጅ ልጅ አልታወክም ክፉም አያገኘኝም።

verses.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
verses.am: አፉ መርገምንና ሽንገላን ተንኰልን የተመላ ነው፤ ከምላሱ በታች ጉዳትና መከራ ነው።

verses.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.am: በመንደሮች መሸመቅያ ይቀመጣል ንጹሓንን በስውር ይገድል ዘንድ፤ ዓይኖቹም ወደ ድኃ ይመለከታሉ።

verses.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
verses.am: እንደ አንበሳ በችፍግ ዱር በስውር ይሸምቃል፤ ድሀውን ለመንጠቅ ያደባል፤ ድሀውን ይነጥቀዋል በአሽክላውም ይስበዋል።

verses.en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.am: ድሀ ይዋረዳል፥ ይጐብጣል፤ በኃያላኑም እጅግ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, YAHUAH hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
verses.am: በልቡም ይላል። እግዚአብሔር ረስቶኛል፤ ፈጽሞም እንዳያይ ፊቱን ሰወረ።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH; O YAHUAH, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ እጅህም ከፍ ከፍ ትበል፤ ድሆችን አትርሳ።

verses.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn YAHUAH? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ስለ ምን እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣው? በልቡ። አይመራመረኝም ይላልና።

verses.en: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.am: አየኸው፥ አንተ ክፋትንና ቍጣን ትመለከታለህና በእጅህ ፍዳውን ለመስጠት፤ ድሀ ራሱን ለአንተ ይተዋል፥ ለድሀ አደግም ረዳቱ አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛንና የክፉን ክንድ ስበር፥ የኃጢአቱንም ብድራት ክፈል ሌላ እስከማይገኝ ድረስ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይነግሣል፤ አሕዛብ ከምድሩ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የድሆችን ምኞት ሰማ፥ ጆሮውም የልባቸውን አሳብ አደመጠች፥

verses.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.am: ፍርዱ ለድሀ አደግና ለችግረኛ ይደረግ ዘንድ፥ ሰዎች በምድር ላይ አፋቸውን ከፍ ከፍ ማድረግ እንዳይደግሙ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] In YAHUAH put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፤ ነፍሴን። እንደ ወፍ ወደ ተራሮች ተቅበዝበዢ እንዴት ትሉአታላችሁ?

verses.en: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች እነሆ ቀስታቸውን ገትረዋልና፥ ፍላጻቸውንም በአውታር አዘጋጅተዋልና፥ ልበ ቅኖችን በስውር ይነድፉ ዘንድ።

verses.en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.am: አንተ የሠራኸውን እነሆ እነርሱ አፍርሰዋልና፤ ጻድቅ ግን ምን አደረገ?

verses.en: YAHUAH is in his holy temple, YAHUAH's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በተቀደሰው መቅደሱ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር፥ ዙፋኑ በሰማይ ነው፤ ዓይኖቹ ወደ ድሃ ይመለከታሉ፥ ቅንድቦቹም የሰው ልጆችን ይመረምራሉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅንና ኅጥእን ይመረምራል፤ ዓመፃን የወደዳት ግን ነፍሱን ጠልቶአል።

verses.en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.am: ወጥመድ በኅጥኣን ላይ ያዘንባል እሳትና ዲን ዐውሎ ነፋስም የጽዋቸው እድል ፈንታ ነው።

verses.en: For the righteous YAHUAH loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነውና፥ ጽድቅንም ይወድዳል፤ ቅንነት ግን ፊቱን ታየዋለች።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of Dawid.] Help, YAHUAH; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አድነኝ፤ ደግ ሰው አልቆአልና፥ ከሰው ልጆችም መተማመን ጐድሎአልና።

verses.en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸው ከንቱ ነገርን ይናገራሉ፤ በሽንገላ ከንፈር ሁለት ልብ ሆነው ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.am: የሽንገላን ከንፈሮች ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ያጠፋቸዋል፥ ታላቅ ነገርን የምትናገረውን ምላስ፤

verses.en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.am: ምላሳችንን እናበረታለን፤ ከንፈራችን የእኛ ነው፥ ጌታችን ማን ነው? የሚሉትን።

verses.en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith YAHUAH; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.am: ስለ ድሆች መከራ፥ ስለ ችግረኞች ጩኸት እግዚአብሔር። አሁን እነሣለሁ ይላል፤ መድኃኒትን አደርጋለሁ፥ በላዩም እገልጣለሁ።

verses.en: The words of YAHUAH are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ እንደ ተፈተነ ሰባት ጊዜ እንደ ተጣራ ብር። የእግዚአብሔር ቃላት የነጹ ቃላት ናቸው።

verses.en: Thou shalt keep them, O YAHUAH, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጠብቀን፥ ከዚህችም ትውልድ ለዘላለም ታደገን።

verses.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.am: በሰው ልጆች ዘንድ ምናምንቴ ከፍ ከፍ ባለ ጊዜ ክፉዎች በዙሪያው ሁሉ ይመላለሳሉ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] How long wilt thou forget me, O YAHUAH? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ፈጽመህ ትረሳኛለህ? እስከ መቼስ ፊትህን ከእኔ ትሰውራለህ?

verses.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.am: እስከ መቼ በነፍሴ እመካከራለሁ? ትካዜስ እስከ መቼ ሁልጊዜ ይሆናል? እስከ መቼ ጠላቴ በላዬ ይጓደዳል?

verses.en: Consider and hear me, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እየኝ ስማኝም፤ ጠላቴ። አሸነፍሁት እንዳይል፥

verses.en: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.am: የሚያስጨንቁኝም እኔ ብናወጥ ደስ እንዳይላቸው፥ ለሞትም እንዳልተኛ ዓይኖቼን አብራ።

verses.en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በቸርነትህ ታመንሁ፥ ልቤም በመድኃኒትህ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: I will sing unto YAHUAH, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.am: የረዳኝን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፥ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔር ስምም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] The fool hath said in his heart, There is no YAHUAH. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.am: ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.en: YAHUAH looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሚያስተውል እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ እንዳለ ያይ ዘንድ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ የሰው ልጆችን ተመለከተ።

verses.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.am: ሁሉ ዐመፁ በአንድነትም ረከሱ በጎ ነገርን የሚሠራ የለም፤ አንድም ስንኳ የለም።

verses.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon YAHUAH.
verses.am: ጕሮሮአቸው የተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ በምላሳቸው ሸነገሉ፤

verses.en: There were they in great fear: for YAHUAH is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.am: ከከንፈራቸው በታች የእባብ መርዝ አለ፤ አፋቸው መርገምንና መራራን ተሞልቶአል፤

verses.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because YAHUAH is his refuge.
verses.am: ደምን ለማፍሰስ እግራቸው ፈጣን ነው፤ ጥፋትና ጕስቍልና በመንገዳቸው አለ፥ የሰላምን መንገድ አላወቁአትምና፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በዓይናቸው ፊት የለም።

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Yisra'el were come out of Zion! when YAHUAH bringeth back the captivity of his people, Ya'aqob shall rejoice, and Yisra'el shall be glad.
verses.am: ሕዝቤን እንደ እንጀራ የሚበሉ ኃጢአት የሚሠሩ ሁሉ በውኑ አያውቁምን? እግዚአብሔርንም አይጠሩትም።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በድንኳንህ ውስጥ ማን ያድራል? በተቀደሰውም ተራራህ ማን ይኖራል?

verses.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.am: በቅንነት የሚሄድ፥ ጽድቅንም የሚያደርግ፥ በልቡም እውነትን የሚናገር።

verses.en: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.am: በአንደበቱ የማይሸነግል፥ በባልንጀራው ላይ ክፋትን የማያደርግ፥ ዘመዶቹንም የማይሰድብ።

verses.en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear YAHUAH. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ በፊቱ የተናቀ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈሩትን የሚያከብር፥ ለባልንጀራው የሚምል የማይከዳም።

verses.en: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.am: ገንዘቡን በአራጣ የማያበድር፥ በንጹሑ ላይ መማለጃን የማይቀበል። እንዲህ የሚያደርግ ለዘላለም አይታወክም።

verses.en: [Michtam of Dawid.] Preserve me, O YAHUAH: for in thee do I put my trust.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና ጠብቀኝ።

verses.en: O my soul, thou hast said unto YAHUAH, Thou art my Master: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ ጌታዬ ነህ አልሁ፤ ከአንተ በቀር በጎነት የለኝም።

verses.en: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.am: ፈቃድህ ሁሉ በምድር ባሉት ቅዱሳንና ክቡራን ላይ ነው።

verses.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.am: ወደ ሌላ ለሚፋጠኑት መከራቸው ይበዛል፤ የቍርባናቸውን ደም እኔ አላፈስሰውም፥ ስማቸውንም በከንፈሬ አልጠራም።

verses.en: YAHUAH is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የርስቴ እድል ፈንታና ጽዋዬ ነው፥ ዕጣዬንም የምታጠና አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.am: ገመድ ባማረ ስፍራ ወደቀችልኝ፥ ርስቴም ተዋበችልኝ።

verses.en: I will bless YAHUAH, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.am: የመከረኝን እግዚአብሔርን እባርካለሁ፤ ደግሞም በሌሊት ኵላሊቶቼ ይገሥጹኛል።

verses.en: I have set YAHUAH always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን በፊቴ አየዋለሁ፤ በቀኜ ነውና አልታወክም።

verses.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ልቤን ደስ አለው ምላሴም ሐሴት አደረገች፤ ሥጋዬም ደግሞ በተስፋ ታድራለች፤

verses.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.am: ነፍሴን በሲኦል አትተዋትምና፥ ቅዱስህንም መበስበስን ያይ ዘንድ አትተወውም።

verses.en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.am: የሕይወትን መንገድ አሳየኸኝ፤ ከፊትህ ጋር ደስታን አጠገብኸኝ፥ በቀኝህም የዘላለም ፍሥሐ አለ።

verses.en: [A Prayer of Dawid.] Hear the right, O YAHUAH, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጽድቄን ስማ ጩኸቴንም አድምጥ፤ በተንኰለኛም ከንፈር ያልሆነውን ጸሎቴን አድምጥ።

verses.en: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.am: ፍርዴ ከፊትህ ይውጣ፥ ዓይኖችህም በቅንነት ይዩ።

verses.en: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.am: ልቤን ፈተንኸው በሌሊትም ጐበኘኸኝ፤ ፈተንኸኝ፥ ምንም አላገኘህብኝም።

verses.en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.am: የሰውን ሥራ አፌ እንዳይናገር ፈቃዴ ነው፤ ስለ ከንፈሮችህ ቃል ጭንቅ የሆኑ መንገዶችን ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
verses.am: እግሮች እንዳይናወጡ አረማመዴን በመንገድህ አጽና።

verses.en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O YAHUAH: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሰምተኸኛልና ወደ አንተ ጠራሁ፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፥ ቃሌንም ስማ።

verses.en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
verses.am: የሚያምኑህን ከሚቃወሙ በቀኝህ የምታድናቸው፥ ቸርነትህን ድንቅ አድርገህ ግለጠው።

verses.en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.am: እንደ ዓይን ብሌን ጠብቀኝ፥ በክንፎችህ ጥላ ሰውረኝ፥

verses.en: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.am: ከሚያስጨንቁኝ ከኃጢአተኞች፥ ነፍሴንም ከሚከብቡአት ከጠላቶቼ።

verses.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.am: አንጀታቸውን በስብ ቋጠሩ፥ በአፋቸውም ትንቢትን ተናገሩ።

verses.en: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.am: አሁንም እርምጃችንን ከበቡ፤ ዓይናቸውን ወደ ምድር ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.am: እርሱ ንጥቂያን እንደሚናፍቅ አንበሳ ተሸጕጦም እንደሚኖር እንደ አንበሳ ደቦል ነው።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፤ ቀድመህ ወደ ታች ጣለው፤ ነፍሴን ከኃጢአተኛ በሰይፍህ አድናት።

verses.en: From men which are thy hand, O YAHUAH, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከሰዎች፥ እድል ፈንታቸው በሕይወታቸው ከሆነች ከዚህ ዓለም ሰዎች በእጅህ አድነኝ፤ ከሰወርኸው መዝገብህ ሆዳቸውን አጠገብህ፤ ልጆቻቸው ብዙ ናቸው የተረፋቸውንም ለሕፃናቶቻቸው ያተርፋሉ።

verses.en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በጽድቅ ፊትህን አያለሁ፤ ክብርህን ሳይ እጠግባለሁ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid, the servant of YAHUAH, who spake unto YAHUAH the words of this song in the day that YAHUAH delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Sha'ul: And he said,] I will love thee, O YAHUAH, my strength.
verses.am: አቤቱ ጕልበቴ ሆይ፥ እወድድሃለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my YAHUAH, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ዓለቴ፥ አምባዬ፥ መድኃኒቴ፥ አምላኬ፥ በእርሱም የምተማመንበት ረዳቴ፥ መታመኛዬና የደኅንነቴ ቀንድ መጠጊያዬም ነው።

verses.en: I will call upon YAHUAH, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.am: ምስጋና የሚገባውን እግዚአብሔርን እጠራለሁ፥ ከጠላቶቼም እድናለሁ።

verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.am: የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፥ የዓመፅ ፈሳሽም አስፈራኝ፤

verses.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.am: የሲኦል ጣር ከበበኝ፤ የሞት ወጥመድም ደረሰብኝ።

verses.en: In my distress I called upon YAHUAH, and cried unto my YAHUAH: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
verses.am: በጨነቀኝ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራሁት፥ ወደ አምላኬም ጮኽሁ፤ ከመቅደሱም ቃሌን ሰማኝ፥ ጩኸቴም በፊቱ ወደ ጆሮው ገባ።

verses.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.am: ምድርም ተንቀጠቀጠች ተናወጠችም፥ የተራሮችም መሠረቶች ተነቃነቁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ተቈጥቶአልና ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.am: ከቍጣው ጢስ ወጣ፥ ከፊቱም የሚበላ እሳት ነደደ፤ ፍምም ከእርሱ በራ።

verses.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.am: ሰማዮችን ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረገ ወረደም፥ ጨለማ ከእግሩ በታች ነበረ።

verses.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.am: በኪሩቤልም ላይ ተቀምጦ በረረ፥ በነፋስም ክንፍ በረረ።

verses.en: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.am: መሰወሪያውን ጨለማ አደረገ፤ በዙሪያውም ድንኳኑ፤ በደመናት ውስጥ የጨለማ ውኃ ነበረ።

verses.en: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.am: በፊቱ ካለው ብርሃን የተነሣ ደመናትና በረዶ የእሳት ፍምም አለፉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከሰማያት አንጐደጐደ፥ ልዑልም ቃሉን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.am: ፍላጻውን ላከ በተናቸውም፤ መብረቆችን አበዛ አወካቸውም።

verses.en: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O YAHUAH, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከዘለፋህ ከመዓትህም መንፈስ እስትንፋስ የተነሣ፥ የውኆች ምንጮች ታዩ፥ የዓለም መሠረቶችም ተገለጡ።

verses.en: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.am: ከላይ ሰደደ ወሰደኝም፥ ከብዙ ውኆችም አወጣኝ።

verses.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.am: ከብርቱዎች ጠላቶቼ ከሚጠሉኝም አዳነኝ፥ በርትተውብኝ ነበርና።

verses.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but YAHUAH was my stay.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን ደረሱብኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ደገፋዬ ሆነ።

verses.en: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.am: ወደ ሰፊ ስፍራም አወጣኝ፤ ወድዶኛልና አዳነኝ።

verses.en: YAHUAH rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጽድቄ ይከፍለኛል፤ እንደ እጄ ንጽሕና ይመልስልኛል።

verses.en: For I have kept the ways of YAHUAH, and have not wickedly departed from my YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ጠብቄአለሁና፥ በአምላኬም አላመፅሁም።

verses.en: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.am: ፍርዱ ሁሉ በፊቴ ነበረና፥ ሥርዓቱንም ከፊቴ አላራቅሁም።

verses.en: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.am: በእርሱ ዘንድ ቅን ነበርሁ፥ ከኃጢአቴም ተጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: Therefore hath YAHUAH recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ጽድቄ እንደ እጄም ንጽሕና በዓይኖቹ ፊት መለሰልኝ።

verses.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.am: ከቸር ሰው ጋር ቸር ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከቅን ሰው ጋር ቅን ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤

verses.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.am: ከንጹሕ ጋር ንጹሕ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከጠማማም ጋር ጠማማ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ።

verses.en: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.am: አንተ የተጠቃውን ሕዝብ ታድናለህና፥ የትዕቢተኞችን ዓይን ግን ታዋርዳለህ።

verses.en: For thou wilt light my candle: YAHUAH my YAHUAH will enlighten my darkness.
verses.am: አንተ መብራቴን ታበራለህና፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ጨለማዬን ያበራል።

verses.en: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my YAHUAH have I leaped over a wall.
verses.am: በአንተ ከጥፋት እድናለሁና በአምላኬም ቅጥሩን እዘልላለሁ።

verses.en: As for YAHUAH, his way is perfect: the word of YAHUAH is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.am: የአምላኬ መንገድ ፍጹም ነው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የነጠረ ነው፥ በእርሱ ለሚታመኑት ሁሉ ጋሻ ነው።

verses.en: For who is YAHUAH save YAHUAH? or who is a rock save our YAHUAH?
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር አምላክ ማን ነው? ከአምላካችን በቀር አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.en: It is YAHUAH that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.am: ኃይልን የሚያስታጥቀኝ መንገዴንም የሚያቃና፥

verses.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.am: እግሮቼን እንደ ብሖር እግሮች የሚያረታ በኮረብቶችም የሚያቆመኝ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.am: እጆቼን ሰልፍ ያስተምራል፥ በክንዴም የናስ ቀስት እገትራለሁ።

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.am: ለደኅንነቴም መታመኛን ሰጠኸኝ፥ ቀኝህም ትረዳኛለች፥ ትምህርትህም ለዘላለም ታጠናኛለች፥ ተግሣጽህም ታስተምረኛለች።

verses.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.am: አረማመዴን በበታቼ አሰፋህ፥ እግሮቼም አልተንሸራተቱም።

verses.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼን አሳድዳቸዋለሁ እይዛቸዋለሁም፥ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ አልመለስም።

verses.en: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.am: አስጨንቃቸዋለሁ መቆምም አይችሉም፥ ከእግሬም በታች ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.am: ለሰልፍም ኃይልን ታስታጥቀኛለህ፤ በበላዬ የቆሙትን ሁሉ በበታቼ ታስገዛቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.am: የጠላቶቼን ጀርባ ሰጠኸኝ፥ የሚጠሉኝንም አጠፋሃቸው።

verses.en: They cried, but there was none to save unto YAHUAH, but he answered them not.
verses.am: ጮኹ የሚረዳቸውም አልነበረም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ አልሰማቸውም።

verses.en: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.am: እንደ ትቢያ በነፋስ ፊት እፈጫቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ አደባባይም ጭቃ እረግጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.am: ከሕዝብ ክርክር ታድነኛለህ፥ የአሕዛብም ራስ አድርገህ ትሾመኛለህ፥ የማላውቀው ሕዝብም ይገዛልኛል።

verses.en: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.am: በጆሮ ሰምተው ተገዙልኝ፤ የባዕድ ልጆች ደለሉኝ።

verses.en: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.am: የባዕድ ልጆች አረጁ፥ በመንገዳቸውም ተሰናከሉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let YAHUAH of my salvation be exalted.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕያው ነው፥ አምላኬም ቡሩክ ነው፥ የመድኃኒቴም አምላክ ከፍ ከፍ ይበል።

verses.en: It is YAHUAH that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.am: በቀሌን የሚመልስልኝ አምላክ አሕዛብን በበታቼ ያስገዛልኛል።

verses.en: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.am: ከጠላቶቼ የሚታደገኝ እርሱ ነው፤ በእኔም ላይ ከቆሙ ከፍ ከፍ ታደርገኛለህ፥ ከግፈኛ ሰው ታድነኛለህ።

verses.en: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O YAHUAH, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to Dawid, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.am: የንጉሡን መድኃኒት ታላቅ ያደርጋል፥ ቸርነቱንም ለቀባው ለዳዊትና ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ይሰጣል።

verses.en: The heavens declare the glory of YAHUAH; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.am: ሰማያት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ የሰማይም ጠፈር የእጁን ሥራ ያወራል።
verses.gez: ሰማያት ይነግሩ ስብሐተ እግዚአብሔር ወግብረ እደዊሁ ይዜንው ጠፈር።

verses.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.am: ቀን ለቀን ነገርን ታወጣለች፥ ሌሊትም ለሌሊት እውቀትን ትናገራለች።

verses.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.am: ነገር የለም መናገርም የለም፥ ድምፃቸውም አይሰማም።

verses.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun.
verses.am: ድምፃቸው ወደ ምድር ሁሉ፥ ቃላቸውም እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ ወጣ።

verses.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.am: በእነርሱም ውስጥ የፀሐይን ድንኳን አደረገ፥ እርሱም እንደ ሙሽራ ከእልፍኙ ይወጣል፤ እንደ አርበኛ በመንገዱ ለመሮጥ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.am: አወጣጡ ከሰማያት ዳርቻ ነው፥ ዙረቱም እስከ ዳርቻቸው ነው፤ ከትኩሳቱም የሚሰወር የለም።

verses.en: The law of YAHUAH is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of YAHUAH is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ፍጹም ነው፤ ነፍስን ይመልሳል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ምስክር የታመነ ነው፤ ሕፃናትን ጠቢባን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: The statutes of YAHUAH are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of YAHUAH is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሥርዓት ቅን ነው፥ ልብንም ደስ ያሰኛል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ብሩህ ነው፥ ዓይንንም ያበራል።

verses.en: The fear of YAHUAH is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of YAHUAH are true and righteous altogether.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ፍርሃት ንጹሕ ነው፤ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ እውነትና ቅንነት በአንድነት ነው።

verses.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.am: ከወርቅና ከክቡር ዕንቍ ይልቅ ይወደዳል፤ ከማርና ከማር ወለላም ይጣፍጣል።

verses.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.am: ባሪያህ ደግሞ ይጠብቀዋል፤ በመጠበቁም እጅግ ይጠቀማል።

verses.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.am: ስሕተትን ማን ያስተውላታል? ከተሰወረ ኃጢአት አንጻኝ።

verses.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.am: የድፍረት ኃጢአት እንዳይገዛኝ ባሪያህን ጠብቅ፤ የዚያን ጊዜ ፍጹም እሆናለሁ፥ ከታላቁም ኃጢአት እነጻለሁ።

verses.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O YAHUAH, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ረድኤቴ መድኃኒቴም፥ የአፌ ቃልና የልቤ አሳብ በፊትህ ያማረ ይሁን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of YAHUAH of Ya'aqob defend thee;
verses.am: በመከራ ቀን እግዚአብሔር ይስማህ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ስም ያቁምህ።

verses.en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.am: ከመቅደሱ ረድኤትን ይላክልህ፥ ከጽዮንም ያጥናህ።

verses.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.am: ቍርባንህን ሁሉ ያስብልህ፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትህን ያለምልምልህ።

verses.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.am: እንደ ልብህ ይስጥህ ፈቃድህንም ሁሉ ይፈጽምልህ።

verses.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our YAHUAH we will set up our banners: YAHUAH fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.am: በማዳንህ ደስ ይለናል፤ በአምላካችን ስም ከፍ ከፍ እንላለን፤ ልመናህን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ይፈጽምልህ።

verses.en: Now know I that YAHUAH saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን እንዳዳነው ዛሬ አወቅሁ፤ ከሰማይ መቅደሱ ይመልስለታል፤ በቀኙ ብርታት ማዳን።

verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነዚያ በሰረገላ እነዚያም በፈረስ ይታመናሉ፤ እኛ ግን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ከፍ ከፍ እንላለን።

verses.en: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.am: እነርሱ ተሰነካክለው ወደቁ፤ እኛ ግን ተነሣን፥ ጸንተንም ቆምን።

verses.en: Save, YAHUAH: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ንጉሥን አድነው፥ በጠራንህም ቀን ስማን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] The king shall joy in thy strength, O YAHUAH; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በኃይልህ ንጉሥ ደስ ይለዋል፤ በማዳንህ እጅግ ሐሤትን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.am: የልቡን ፈቃድ ሰጠኽው፥ የከንፈሩንም ልመና አልከለከልኸውም።

verses.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.am: በበጎ በረከት ደርሰህለታልና፤ ከክቡር ዕንቍ የሆነ ዘውድን በራሱ ላይ አኖርህ።

verses.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.am: ሕይወትን ለመነህ ሰጠኸውም፥ ለረጅም ዘመን ለዘላለሙ።

verses.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.am: በማዳንህ ክብሩ ታላቅ ነው፤ ክብርንና ምስጋናን ጨመርህለት።

verses.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.am: የዘላለም በረከትን ሰጥተኸዋልና። በፊትህም ደስታ ደስ ታሰኘዋለህ።

verses.en: For the king trusteth in YAHUAH, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.am: ንጉሥ በእግዚአብሔር ተማምኖአልና፥ በልዑልም ምሕረት አይናወጥም።

verses.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.am: እጅህ ጠላቶችህን ሁሉ ታግኛቸው፥ ቀኝህም የሚጠሉህን ሁሉ ታግኛቸው።

verses.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: YAHUAH shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.am: በተቈጣህም ጊዜ እንደ እሳት እቶን አድርጋቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣው ያጠፋቸዋል፥ እሳትም ትበላቸዋለች።

verses.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.am: ፍሬአቸውን ከምድር ዘራቸውንም ከሰው ልጆች ታጠፋለህ።

verses.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.am: ክፋትን በአንተ ላይ ዘርግተዋልና፥ የማይቻላቸውንም ምክር አሰቡ።

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.am: ወደ ኋላቸው ትመልሳቸዋለህ፤ ፍላጻን በፊታቸው ላይ ታዘጋጃለህ።

verses.en: Be thou exalted, YAHUAH, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በኃይልህ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ጽናትህንም እናመሰግናለን እንዘምርማለን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of Dawid.] My YAHUAH, my YAHUAH, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ለምን ተውኸኝ? እኔን ከማዳንና ከጩኸቴ ቃል ሩቅ ነህ።

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ በቀን ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ፥ አልመለስህልኝም፤ በሌሊትም እንኳ ዕረፍት የለኝም።

verses.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በእስራኤል የተመሰገንህ አንተ ግን በቅድስና ትኖራለህ።

verses.en: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን አንተን ተማመኑ፥ ተማመኑ አንተም አዳንሃቸው።

verses.en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.am: ወደ አንተ ጮኹ አመለጡም፥ አንተንም ተማመኑ አላፈሩም።

verses.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ትል ነኝ ሰውም አይደለሁም፤ የሰው ማላገጫ በሕዝብም ዘንድ የተናቅሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.am: የሚያዩኝ ሁሉ ይላገዱብኛል፤ ራሳቸውን እየነቀነቁ በከንፈሮቻቸው እንዲህ ይላሉ።

verses.en: He trusted on YAHUAH that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ተማመነ፥ እርሱንም ያድነው፤ ቢወድደውስ ያድነው።

verses.en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ከሆድ አውጥተኸኛልና፥ በእናቴ ጡት ሳለሁም በአንተ ታመንሁ።

verses.en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my YAHUAH from my mother's belly.
verses.am: ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ላይ ተጣልሁ፤ ከእናቴ ሆድ ጀምረህ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ።

verses.en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.am: ጭንቀት ቀርባለችና የሚረዳኝም የለምና ከእኔ አትራቅ።

verses.en: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.am: ብዙ በሬዎች ከበቡኝ፥ የሰቡትም ፍሪዳዎች ያዙኝ፤

verses.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.am: እንደ ነጣቂና እንደሚጮኽ አንበሳ በላዬ አፋቸውን ከፈቱ።

verses.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.am: እንደ ውኃ ፈሰስሁ፤ አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ ተለያዩ፤ ልቤ እንደ ሰም ሆነ፥ በአንጀቴም መካከል ቀለጠ።

verses.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.am: ኃይሌ እንደ ገል ደረቀ፥ በጕሮሮዬም ምላሴ ተጣጋ፥ ወደ ሞትም አሸዋ አወረድኸኝ።

verses.en: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.am: ብዙ ውሾች ከብበውኛልና፤ የክፋተኞች ጉባኤም ያዘኝ፤ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን ቸነከሩኝ።

verses.en: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.am: አጥንቶቼ ሁሉ ተቈጠሩ፤ እነርሱም አዩኝ ተመለከቱኝም።

verses.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.am: ልብሶቼን ለራሳቸው ተከፋፈሉ፥ በቀሚሴም ላይ ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.en: But be not thou far from me, O YAHUAH: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ፤ አንተ ጕልበቴ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ከሰይፍ አድናት፥ ብቻነቴንም ከውሾች እጅ።

verses.en: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.am: ከአንበሳ አፍ አድነኝ፥ ብቻነቴንም አንድ ቀንድ ካላቸው።

verses.en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.am: ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ፥ በጉባኤም መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Ye that fear YAHUAH, praise him; all ye the seed of Ya'aqob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ፥ አመስግኑት፤ የያዕቆብ ዘር ሁላችሁ፥ አክብሩት፥ የእስራኤልም ዘር ሁላችሁ፥ ፍሩት።

verses.en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.am: የችግረኛን ችግር አልናቀምና፥ ቸልም አላለምና፤ ፊቱንም ከእኔ አልሰወረምና፥ ነገር ግን ወደ እርሱ በጮኽሁ ጊዜ ሰማኝ።

verses.en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.am: በታላቅ ጉባኤ ምስጋናዬ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው። እርሱን በሚፈሩት ፊት ስእለቴን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise YAHUAH that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.am: ችግረኞች ይበላሉ፥ ይጠግቡማል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚሹት ያመሰግኑታል፤ ልባቸውም ለዘላለም ሕያው ይሆናል።

verses.en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto YAHUAH: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.am: የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ ያስቡ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለሱ፤ የአሕዛብ ነገዶች ሁሉ በፊቱ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: For the kingdom is YAHUAH's: and he is the governor among the nations.
verses.am: መንግሥት ለእግዚአብሔር ነውና፥ እርሱም አሕዛብን ይገዛል።

verses.en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.am: የምድር ደንዳኖች ሁሉ ይበላሉ ይሰግዳሉም፤ ወደ መሬት የሚወርዱት ሁሉ በፊቱ ይንበረከካሉ፤ ነፍሴም ስለ እርሱ በሕይወት ትኖራለች።

verses.en: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to YAHUAH for a generation.
verses.am: ዘሬ ይገዛለታል፤ የምትመጣው ትውልድ ለእግዚአብሔር ትነግረዋለች፤

verses.en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
verses.am: ጽድቁንም ለሚወለደው ሕዝብ፥ እግዚአብሔር ያደረገውን ጽድቁን፥ ይነግራሉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እረኛዬ ነው፥ የሚያሳጣኝም የለም።

verses.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.am: በለመለመ መስክ ያሳድረኛል፤ በዕረፍት ውኃ ዘንድ ይመራኛል።

verses.en: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.am: ነፍሴን መለሳት፥ ስለ ስሙም በጽድቅ መንገድ መራኝ።

verses.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.am: በሞት ጥላ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ነህና ክፉን አልፈራም፤ በትርህና ምርኵዝህ እነርሱ ያጸናኑኛል።
verses.gez: ወእመሂ ሖርኩ ውስተ ገዳመ ጽልመት፤ ኢይፈርህ እኪተ እስመ አንተ ምስሌየ አንተ።

verses.en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.am: በፊቴ ገበታን አዘጋጀህልኝ በጠላቶቼ ፊት ለፊት ራሴን በዘይት ቀባህ፥ ጽዋዬም የተረፈ ነው።

verses.en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of YAHUAH for ever.
verses.am: ቸርነትህና ምሕረትህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ ይከተሉኛል፥ በእግዚአሔርም ቤት ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] The earth is YAHUAH's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ሰንበት የዳዊት መዝሙር።  1 ምድርና ሞላዋ ለእግዚአብሔር ናት፥ ዓለምም በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ።

verses.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.am: እርሱ በባሕሮች መሥርቶአታልና፥ በፈሳሾችም አጽንቶአታልና።

verses.en: Who shall ascend into the hill of YAHUAH? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ ማን ይወጣል? በቅድስናውስ ስፍራ ማን ይቆማል?

verses.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.am: እጆቹ የነጹ፥ ልቡም ንጹሕ የሆነ፥ ነፍሱን ለከንቱ ያላነሣ፥ ለባልንጀራውም በሽንገላ ያልማለ።

verses.en: He shall receive the blessing from YAHUAH, and righteousness from YAHUAH of his salvation.
verses.am: እርሱ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በረከትን ከመድኃኒቱ አምላክም ምሕረትን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Ya'aqob. Selah.
verses.am: ይህች ትውልድ እርሱን የምትፈልግ ናት፥ የያዕቆብን አምላክ ፊት የምትፈልግ።

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.am: እናንት መኳንንቶች፥ በሮችን ክፈቱ፥ የዘላለም ደጆችም ይከፈቱ፥ የክብርም ንጉሥ ይግባ።

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? YAHUAH strong and mighty, YAHUAH mighty in battle.
verses.am: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ ብርቱና ኃያል፥ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በሰልፍ ኃያል።

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.am: እናንተ መኳንንቶች፥ በሮችን ክፈቱ፥ የዘላለም ደጆችም ይከፈቱ፥ የክብርም ንጉሥ ይግባ።

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? YAHUAH of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.am: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? የጭፍሮች አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱ የክብር ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Unto thee, O YAHUAH, do I lift up my soul.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ነፍሴን አነሣለሁ።

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ አልፈር፥ ጠላቶቼ በእኔ አይሣቁብኝ።

verses.en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.am: አንተን ተስፋ የሚያደርጉ አያፍሩም፤ በከንቱ የሚገበዙ ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Shew me thy ways, O YAHUAH; teach me thy paths.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን አመልክተኝ፥ ፍለጋህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art YAHUAH of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.am: አንተ የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ ነህና በእውነትህ ምራኝ፥ አስተምረኝም፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ አንተን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.en: Remember, O YAHUAH, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህንና ቸርነትህን አስብ፥ ከጥንት ጀምሮ ናቸውና።

verses.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: የልጅነቴን ኃጢአትና መተላለፍ አታስብብኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ስለ ቸርነትህ ብዛት እንደ ምሕረትህ አስበኝ።

verses.en: Good and upright is YAHUAH: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር ቅንም ነው፤ ስለዚህ ኃጢአተኞችን በመንገድ ይመራቸዋል።

verses.en: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.am: ገሮችን በፍርድ ይመራል፥ ለገሮችም መንገድን ያስተምራቸዋል።

verses.en: All the paths of YAHUAH are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ሁሉ ቸርነትና እውነት ነው። ቃል ኪዳኑንና ምስክሩን ለሚጠብቁ።

verses.en: For thy name's sake, O YAHUAH, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአቴ እጅግ ነውና ስለ ስምህ ይቅር በለኝ።

verses.en: What man is he that feareth YAHUAH? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ማን ነው? በሚመርጠው መንገድ ያስተምረዋል።

verses.en: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.am: ነፍሱ በመልካም ታድራለች፥ ዘሩም ምድርን ይወርሳል።

verses.en: The secret of YAHUAH is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሚፈሩት ኃይላቸው ነው፥ ቃል ኪዳኑንም ያስታውቃቸዋል።

verses.en: Mine eyes are ever toward YAHUAH; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.am: እርሱ እግሮቼን ከወጥመድ ያወጣቸዋልና ዓይኖቼ ሁልጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ናቸው።

verses.en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.am: እኔ ብቻዬንና ችግረኛ ነኝና ፊትህን ወደ እኔ አድርግ ማረኝም።

verses.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.am: የልቤ ችግር ብዙ ነው፤ ከጭንቀቴ አውጣኝ።

verses.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.am: ድካሜንና መከራዬን እይ፥ ኃጢአቴንም ሁሉ ይቅር በለኝ።

verses.en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ እንደ በዙ እይ፥ የግፍም ጥል ጠልተውኛል።

verses.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ጠብቅና አድነኝ፤ አንተን ታምኛለሁና አልፈር።

verses.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.am: አንተን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁና የውሃትና ቅንነት ይጠብቁኝ።

verses.en: Redeem Yisra'el, O YAHUAH, out of all his troubles.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስራኤልን ከመከራው ሁሉ አድነው።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Judge me, O YAHUAH; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in YAHUAH; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ በየውሃቴ ሄጃለሁና ፍረድልኝ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም አምኛለሁና አልናወጥም።

verses.en: Examine me, O YAHUAH, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍተነኝ መርምረኝም፤ ኵላሊቴንና ልቤን ፍተን።

verses.en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ በዓይኔ ፊት ነውና፥ በእውነትህም ተመላለስሁ።

verses.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.am: በከንቱ ሸንጎ አልተቀመጥሁም፥ ከዓመፀኞችም ጋር አልገባሁም።

verses.en: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.am: የክፉዎችን ማኅበር ጠላሁ፥ ከዝንጉዎችም ጋር አልቀመጥም።

verses.en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O YAHUAH:
verses.am: እጆቼን በንጽሕና አጥባለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ መሠዊያህን እዞራለሁ፥

verses.en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.am: የምስጋናን ድምፅ እሰማ ዘንድ፥ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ እነግር ዘንድ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የቤትህን ስፍራ የክብርህንም ማደሪያ ቦታ ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.am: ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ነፍሴን፥ ከደም ሰዎችም ጋር ሕይወቴን አታጥፋ።

verses.en: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.am: በእጃቸው ተንኰል አለባቸው፥ ቀኛቸውም መማለጃ ተሞልታለች።

verses.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በየውሃቴ ሄጃለሁ፤ አድነኝ ማረኝም።

verses.en: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግሮቼ በቅንነት ቆመዋልና፤ አቤቱ፥ በማኅበር አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? YAHUAH is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ብርሃኔና መድኃኒቴ ነው፤ የሚያስፈራኝ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር የሕይወቴ መታመኛዋ ነው፤ የሚያስደነግጠኝ ማን ነው?

verses.en: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.am: ክፉዎች፥ አስጨናቂዎቼ ጠላቶቼም፥ ሥጋዬን ይበሉ ዘንድ በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ እነርሱ ተሰናከሉና ወደቁ።

verses.en: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
verses.am: ሠራዊትም ቢሰፍርብኝ ልቤ አይፈራም፤ ሰልፍም ቢነሣብኝ በዚህ እተማመናለሁ።

verses.en: One thing have I desired of YAHUAH, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of YAHUAH all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of YAHUAH, and to enquire in his temple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አንዲት ነገር ለመንሁት እርስዋንም እሻለሁ፤ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እኖር ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኘውንም አይ ዘንድ፥ መቅደሱንም እመለከት ዘንድ።

verses.en: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን በድንኳኑ ሰውሮኛልና፥ በድንኳኑም መሸሸጊያ ሸሽጎኛልና፥ በዓለት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አድርጎኛልና።

verses.en: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አሁን በዙሪያ ባሉ በጠላቶቼ ላይ ራሴን ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ፤ በድንኳኑም የእልልታ መሥዋዕትን ሠዋሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ እዘምርለትማለሁ።

verses.en: Hear, O YAHUAH, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ የጮኽሁትን ቃሌን ስማኝ። ማረኝና አድምጠኝ።

verses.en: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, YAHUAH, will I seek.
verses.am: አንተ ፊቴን እሹት ባልህ ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ፊትህን እሻለሁ ልቤ አንተን አለ።

verses.en: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O YAHUAH of my salvation.
verses.am: ፊትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር፥ ተቈጥተህ ከባሪያህ ፈቀቅ አትበል፤ ረዳት ሁነኝ፥ አትጣለኝም፥ የመድኃኒቴም አምላክ ሆይ፥ አትተውኝ።

verses.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then YAHUAH will take me up.
verses.am: አባቴና እናቴ ትተውኛልና፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን ተቀበለኝ።

verses.en: Teach me thy way, O YAHUAH, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን አስተምረኝ፥ ስለ ጠላቶቼም በቀና መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.am: የሐሰት ምስክሮችና ዓመፀኞች ተነሥተውብኛልና ለጠላቶቼ ፈቃድ አትስጠኝ።

verses.en: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of YAHUAH in the land of the living.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነት በሕያዋን ምድር አይ ዘንድ አምናለሁ።

verses.en: Wait on YAHUAH: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርግ፤ በርታ፥ ልብህም ይጽና፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርግ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Unto thee will I cry, O YAHUAH my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ፤ ዝም ብትለኝ ወደ ጓድጓድ እንደሚወርዱት እንዳልመስል፥ አንተ አምላኬ፥ ዝም አትበለኝ።

verses.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደስህ ማደሪያ እጄን ባነሣሁ ጊዜ፥ ወደ አንተ የጮኽሁትን የልመናዬን ቃል ስማ።

verses.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.am: ከኃጥኣንና ከክፉ አድራጊዎች ጋር ነፍሴን አትውሰዳት፤ ክፋትም በልባቸው እያለ ከባልንጀራቸው ጋር ሰላም ከሚናገሩት ጋር አትጣለኝ።

verses.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.am: እንደ ሥራቸው እንደ አካሄዳቸውም ክፉት ስጣቸው፤ እንደ እጃቸውም ሥራ ስጣቸው፤ ፍዳቸውን ወደ ራሳቸው መልስ።

verses.en: Because they regard not the works of YAHUAH, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሥራ ወደ እጆቹም አደራረግ አላሰቡምና ያፈርሳቸዋል እንጂ አይሠራቸውም።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.am: የልመናዬን ቃል ሰምቶኛልና እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: YAHUAH is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ኃይሌና ጋሻዬ ነው፤ ልቤ በእርሱ ታመነ እኔም ተረዳሁ፤ ሥጋዬም ደስ ይለዋል፥ ፈቅጄም አመሰግነዋለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ኃይላቸው ነው፥ ለቀባውም የመድኃኒቱ መታመኛ ነው።

verses.en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን አድን፥ ርስትህንም ባርክ፤ ጠብቃቸው፥ ለዘላለሙም ከፍ ከፍ አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Give unto YAHUAH, O ye mighty, give unto YAHUAH glory and strength.
verses.am: የአምላክ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ። ክብርንና ምስጋናን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ።

verses.en: Give unto YAHUAH the glory due unto his name; worship YAHUAH in the beauty of holiness.
verses.am: የስሙን ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ።

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH is upon the waters: YAHUAH of glory thundereth: YAHUAH is upon many waters.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በውኆች ላይ፥ የክብር አምላክ አንጐደጐደ፥ እግዚአብሔር በብዙ ውኆች ላይ።

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH is powerful; the voice of YAHUAH is full of majesty.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በኃይል ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በታላቅ ክብር ነው።

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH breaketh the cedars; yea, YAHUAH breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.am: የእግዚአብር ድምፅ ዝግባን ይሰብራል፤ እግዚአብሔር የሊባኖስን ዝግባ ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.am: እንደ ጥጃ ሊባኖስን፥ አንድ ቀን እንዳለው አውሬ ልጅ ስርዮንን ያዘልላቸዋል።

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH divideth the flames of fire.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ የእሳቱን ነበልባል ይቈርጣል።

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH shaketh the wilderness; YAHUAH shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ምድረ በዳውን ያናውጣል፥ እግዚአብሔር የቃዴስን ምድረ በዳ ያናውጣል።

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ዋላዎችን ያጠነክራቸዋል፥ ጫካዎቹንም ይገልጣል፤ ሁሉም በመቅደሱ። ምስጋና ይላል።

verses.en: YAHUAH sitteth upon the flood; yea, YAHUAH sitteth King for ever.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጥፋት ውኃን ሰብስቦአል፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ንጉሥ ሆኖ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: YAHUAH will give strength unto his people; YAHUAH will bless his people with peace.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ኃይልን ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በሰላም ይባርካል።

verses.en: [A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of Dawid.] I will extol thee, O YAHUAH; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተቀብለኸኛልና፥ ጠላቶቼንም ደስ አላሰኘህብኝምና ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.en: O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ ምሕረትም አደረግህልኝ።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ከሲኦል አወጣሃት፥ ወደ ጕድጓድም እንዳልወርድ አዳንኸኝ።

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.am: ቅዱሳን ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፥ ለቅድስናውም መታሰቢያ አመስግኑ።

verses.en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.am: ቍጣው ለጥቂት ጊዜ ነው፥ ሞገሱ ግን ለሕይወት ዘመን፤ ልቅሶ ማታ ይመጣል፥ ጥዋት ግን ደስታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.am: እኔም በደስታዬ። ለዘላለም አልታወክም አልሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፈቃድህ ለሕይወቴ ኃይልን ሰጠሃት፤ ፊትህን መለስህ፥ እኔም ደነገጥሁ።

verses.en: I cried to thee, O YAHUAH; and unto YAHUAH I made supplication.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጠራሁ፥ ወደ አምላኬም ለመንሁ።

verses.en: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.am: ወደ ጥፋት ብወርድ በደሜ ምን ጥቅም አለ? አፈር ያመሰግንሃልን? እውነትህንም ይናገራልን?

verses.en: Hear, O YAHUAH, and have mercy upon me: YAHUAH, be thou my helper.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰማ ማረኝም፤ እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ሆነኝ።

verses.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.am: ክብሬ ትዘምርልህ ዘንድ ዝምም እንዳትል ልቅሶዬን ለደስታ ለወጥህልኝ፥ ማቄን ቀድደህ ደስታንም አስታጠቅኸኝ።

verses.en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ለዘላለም አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] In thee, O YAHUAH, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.am: አቤቱ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘላለም አልፈር፤ በጽድቅህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.am: ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፥ ፈጥነህም አድነኝ፤ ታድነኝ ዘንድ መታመኛ አምላክና የመጠጊያ ቤት ሁነኝ።

verses.en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.am: አምባዬና መጠጊያዬ አንተ ነህና ስለ ስምህ መንገዴን አቅና ምራኝም።

verses.en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
verses.am: አንተ መታመኛዬ ነህና ከደበቁብኝ ወጥመድ አውጣኝ።

verses.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O YAHUAH of truth.
verses.am: በእጅህ ነፍሴን እሰጣለሁ፤ የእውነት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ ተቤዥተኸኛል።

verses.en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከንቱ ምናምንቴነትን የጠበቁትን ጠላህ፤ እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ።

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.am: መከራዬን አይተሃልና፥ ነፍሴንም ከጭንቀት አድነሃታልና በምሕረትህ ደስ ይለኛል ሐሤትም አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.am: በጠላቴ እጅ አልዘጋኸኝም፥ በሰፊም ስፍራ እግሮቼን አቆምህ።

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O YAHUAH, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.am: ተቸግሬአለሁና አቤቱ ምራኝ፤ ዓይኔም ከኃዘን የተነሣ ተፈጀች፥ ነፍሴም ሆዴም።

verses.en: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.am: ሕይወቴ በኅዘን አልቃለችና፥ ዓመታቴም በልቅሶ ጩኸት፤ ኃይሌ በችግር ደከመ፥ አጥንቶቼም ተነዋወጡ።

verses.en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.am: በጠላቶቼ ዘንድ ተነወርኹ፥ ይልቁንም በጎረቤቶቼ ዘንድ፥ ለሚያውቁኝም ፍርሃት ሆንሁ፤ በሜዳ ያዩኝም ከእኔ ሸሹ።

verses.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.am: እንደ ሞተ ሰው ከልብ ተረሳሁ፥ እንደ ተበላሸ ዕቃም ሆንሁ።

verses.en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.am: የብዙ ሰዎችን ስድብ ሰምቻለሁና፤ በዙሪያው ፍርሃት ነበረ፤ በላዬ በአንድነት በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ነፍሴን ለመንጠቅ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: But I trusted in thee, O YAHUAH: I said, Thou art my YAHUAH.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ግን በአንተ ታመንሁ፤ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ አልሁ።

verses.en: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.am: ርስቴ በእጅህ ነው፤ ከጠላቶቼ እጅና ከሚያሳድዱኝ አድነኝ።

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.am: ፊትህን በባሪያህ ላይ አብራ፥ ስለ ምሕረትህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: Let me not be ashamed, O YAHUAH; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ጠርቻለሁና አልፈር፤ ክፉዎች ይፈሩ በሲኦልም ዝም ይበሉ።

verses.en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.am: በድፍረትና በትዕቢት በመናቅም በጻድቅ ላይ የሚናገሩ የሽንገላ ከንፈሮች ድዳ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.am: በአንተ ለሚያምኑ በሰው ልጆች ፊት ያዘጋጀሃት ለሚፈሩህም የሰወርሃት፥ ቸርነትህ እንደ ምን በዛች!

verses.en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.am: በፊትህ መጋረጃ ከሰው ክርክር ትጋርዳቸዋለህ፥ በድንኳንህም ከአንደበት ክርክር ትሸፍናቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.am: በተከበበ ከተማ የሚያስደንቅ ምሕረቱን በእኔ የገለጠ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.am: እኔስ ከዓይንህ ፊት ተጣልሁ፥ በድንጋጤ አልሁ፤ አንተ ግን ወደ አንተ በጮኽሁ ጊዜ የልመናዬን ቃል ሰማኸኝ።

verses.en: O love YAHUAH, all ye his saints: for YAHUAH preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.am: ሁላችሁ ቅዱሳኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ውደዱት፤ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኞችን ይፈልጋል፥ ትዕቢተኞችንም ፈጽሞ ይበቀላቸዋል።

verses.en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር የምታምኑ ሁላችሁ፥ በርቱ ልባችሁም ይጥና።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, Maschil.] Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.am: መተላለፉ የቀረችለት ኃጢአቱም የተከደነችለት ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: Blessed is the man unto whom YAHUAH imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በደልን የማይቈጥርበት በመንፈሱም ሽንገላ የሌለበት ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ ከመጮኼ የተነሣ ዝም ባልሁ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼ ተበላሹ፤

verses.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.am: በቀንና በሌሊት እጅህ ከብዳብኛለችና፥ እርጥበቴም ለበጋ ትኵሳት ተለወጠ።

verses.en: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto YAHUAH; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.am: ኃጢአቴን ለአንተ አስታወቅሁ፥ በደሌንም አልሸፈንሁም፤ ለእግዚአብሔር መተላለፌን እነግራለሁ አልሁ፤ አንተም የልቤን ኃጢአት ተውህልኝ።

verses.en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ቅዱስ ሁሉ በምቹ ጊዜ ወደ አንተ ይለምናል፤ ብዙ የጥፋት ውኃም ወደ እርሱ አይቀርብም።

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.am: አንተ ለእኔ መሸሸጊያዬ ነህ፥ ከጣርም ትጠብቀኛለህ፤ ከከበቡኝ ታድነኝ ዘንድ ደስታዬ ነህ።

verses.en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.am: አስተምርሃለሁ በምትሄድበትም መንገድ እመራሃለሁ፤ ዓይኖቼን በአንተ ላይ አጠናለሁ።

verses.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.am: ወደ አንተ እንዳይቀርቡ በልባብና በልጓም ጉንጫቸውን እንደሚለጕሙአቸው፥ ልብ እንደሌላቸው እንደ ፈረስና እንደ በቅሎ አትሁኑ።

verses.en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in YAHUAH, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.am: በኃጢአተኛ ብዙ መቅሠፍት አለበት፤ በእግዚአብሔር የሚታመነውን ግን ምሕረት ይከብበዋል።

verses.en: Be glad in YAHUAH, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.am: ጻድቃን ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ ሐሤትም አድርጉ፤  ልባችሁም የቀና ሁላችሁ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.en: Rejoice in YAHUAH, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.am: ጻድቃን ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ለቅኖች ምስጋና ይገባል።

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በመሰንቆ አመስግኑት፥ አሥር አውታርም ባለው በበገና ዘምሩለት።

verses.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.am: አዲስ ቅኔም ተቀኙለት፥ በእልልታም መልካም ዝማሬ ዘምሩ፤

verses.en: For the word of YAHUAH is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ቅን ነውና ሥራውም ሁሉ በእምነት ነውና።

verses.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ጽድቅንና ፍርድን ይወድዳል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነት ምድርን ሞላች።

verses.en: By the word of YAHUAH were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሰማዮች ጸኑ፥ ሠራዊታቸውም ሁሉ በአፉ እስትንፋስ፤

verses.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.am: የባሕርን ውኃ እንደ ረዋት የሚሰበስበው፥ ቀላዮችንም በመዝገቦች የሚያኖራቸው።

verses.en: Let all the earth fear YAHUAH: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ትፍራው፥ በዓለም የሚኖሩ ሁሉም ከእርሱ የተነሣ ይደንግጡ።

verses.en: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.am: እርሱ ተናግሮአልና፥ ሆኑም፤ እርሱ አዘዘ፥ ጸኑም።

verses.en: YAHUAH bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የአሕዛብን ምክር ያጠፋል፥ የአሕዛብንም አሳብ ይመልሳል።

verses.en: The counsel of YAHUAH standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ምክር ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል። የልቡም አሳብ ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: Blessed is the nation whose YAHUAH is YAHUAH; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ የሚሆንለት ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው፥ እርሱ ለርስቱ የመረጠው ሕዝብ።

verses.en: YAHUAH looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ተመለከተ፥ የሰውንም ልጆች ሁሉ አየ።

verses.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.am: ከማደሪያው ቦታ ሆኖ በምድር ወደሚኖሩ ሁሉ ተመለከተ፥

verses.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.am: እርሱ ብቻውን ልባቸውን የሠራ ሥራቸውንም ሁሉ የሚያስተውል።

verses.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.am: ንጉሥ በሠራዊቱ ብዛት አይድንም ኃያልም በኃይሉ ብዛት አያመልጥም።

verses.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.am: ፈረስም ከንቱ ነው፥ አያድንም፤ በኃይሉም ብዛት አያመልጥም።

verses.en: Behold, the eye of YAHUAH is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች ወደሚፈሩት ናቸው፥ በምሕረቱም ወደሚታመኑ፥

verses.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.am: ነፍሳቸውን ከሞት ያድን ዘንድ፥ በራብም ጊዜ ይመግባቸው ዘንድ።

verses.en: Our soul waiteth for YAHUAH: he is our help and our shield.
verses.am: ነፍሳችን እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ ታደርገዋለች፥ ረዳታችንና መጠጊያችን እርሱ ነውና።

verses.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.am: ልባችን በእርሱ ደስ ይለዋልና፥ በቅዱስ ስሙም ታምነናልና።

verses.en: Let thy mercy, O YAHUAH, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በላያችን ትሁን፥ በአንተ እንደ ታመንን።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.] I will bless YAHUAH at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ሁልጊዜ እባርከዋለሁ፥ ምስጋናውንም ዘወትር በአፌ ነው።

verses.en: My soul shall make her boast in YAHUAH: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በእግዚአብሔር ትከብራለች፥ ገሮችም ሰምተው ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: O magnify YAHUAH with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ከእኔ ጋር ታላቅ አድርጉት፥ በአንድነትም ስሙን ከፍ ከፍ እናድርግ።

verses.en: I sought YAHUAH, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ፈለግሁት መለሰልኝም፥ ከመከራዬም ሁሉ አዳነኝ።

verses.en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱ ቅረቡ ያበራላችሁማል፥ ፊታችሁም አያፍርም።

verses.en: This poor man cried, and YAHUAH heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.am: ይህ ችግረኛ ጮኸ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማው፥ ከመከራውም ሁሉ አዳነው።

verses.en: The angel of YAHUAH encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ በሚፈሩት ሰዎች ዙሪያ ይሰፍራል፥ ያድናቸውማል።

verses.en: O taste and see that YAHUAH is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር እንደ ሆነ ቅመሱ እዩም፤ በእርሱ የሚታመን ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: O fear YAHUAH, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.am: የሚፈሩት አንዳችን አያጡምና ቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩት።

verses.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek YAHUAH shall not want any good thing.
verses.am: ባለጠጎች ደኸዩ፥ ተራቡም፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልጉትን ግን ከመልካም ነገር ሁሉ አይጐድሉም።

verses.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ልጆቼ ኑ፥ ስሙኝ፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት አስተምራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.am: ሕይወትን የሚፈቅድ ሰው ማን ነው? በጎንም ዘመን ለማየት የሚወድድ?

verses.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.am: አንደበትህን ከክፉ ከልክል፥ ከንፈሮችህም ሽንገላን እንዳይናገሩ።

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.am: ከክፉ ሽሽ መልካምንም አድርግ፤ ሰላምን እሻ ተከተላትም።

verses.en: The eyes of YAHUAH are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች ወደ ጻድቃን ጆሮቹም ወደ ጩኸታቸው ናቸውና።

verses.en: The face of YAHUAH is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.am: መታሰቢያቸውን ከምድር ያጠፋ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉን በሚያደርጉ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: The righteous cry, and YAHUAH heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.am: ጻድቃን ጮኹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማቸው ከመከራቸውም ሁሉ አዳናቸው።

verses.en: YAHUAH is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልባቸው ለተሰበረ ቅርብ ነው፥ መንፈሳቸው የተሰበረውንም ያድናቸዋል።

verses.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but YAHUAH delivereth him out of them all.
verses.am: የጻድቃን መከራቸው ብዙ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከሁሉ ያድናቸዋል።

verses.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አጥንቶቻቸውን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ አይሰበርም።
