verses.en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞችን ክፋት ይገድላቸዋል ጻድቃንንም የሚጠሉ ይጸጸታሉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.am: የባሪያዎቹን ነፍስ እግዚአብሔር ይቤዣል፥ በእርሱም የሚያምኑ ሁሉ አይጸጸቱም።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Plead my cause, O YAHUAH, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.am: የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.am: ጥሩርና ጋሻ ያዝ፥ እኔንም ለመርዳት ተነሥ።

verses.en: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.am: ሰይፍህን ምዘዝ የሚያሳድዱኝንም መንገዳቸውን ዝጋ፤ ነፍሴን። መድኃኒትሽ እኔ ነኝ በላት።

verses.en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.am: ነፍሴን የሚሹ ሁሉ ይፈሩ ይጐስቈሉም፤ ክፉትን በእኔ ላይ የሚያስቡ ይፈሩ ወደ ኋላቸውም ይበሉ።

verses.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of YAHUAH chase them.
verses.am: በነፋስ ፊት እንዳለ ትቢያ ይሁኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልአክ ያስጨንቃቸው።

verses.en: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of YAHUAH persecute them.
verses.am: መንገዳቸው ዳጥና ጨለማ ይሁን፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ያሳድዳቸው።

verses.en: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.am: በከንቱ ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ወጥመዳቸውን ሸሽገውብኛልና፥ ነፍሴን በከንቱ አበሳጭተዋልና።

verses.en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.am: ያላወቁት ወጥመድ ይምጣባቸው፥ የሸሸጉትም ወጥመድ ይያዛቸው፤ በዚህ ወጥመድ ውስጥ ይውደቁ።

verses.en: And my soul shall be joyful in YAHUAH: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይላታል፥ በማዳኑም ሐሴት ታደርጋለች።

verses.en: All my bones shall say, YAHUAH, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.am: አጥንቶቼ ሁሉ እንዲህ ይሉሃል። አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው? ችግረኛን ከሚቀማው እጅ፥ ችግረኛንና ድሀውንም ከሚነጥቀው እጅ ታድነዋለህ።

verses.en: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.am: የክፋት ምስክሮች ተነሡብኝ፥ የማላውቀውንም በእኔ ላይ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.am: ስለ በጎ ክፋትን መለሱልኝ፥ ነፍሴንም ልጆችን አሳጡአት።

verses.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.am: እኔስ እነርሱ በታመሙ ጊዜ ማቅ ለበስሁ፥ ነፍሴንም በጾም አደከምኋት፤ ጸሎቴም ወደ ብብቴ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.am: ለወዳጄና ለወንድሜ እንደማደርግ አደረግሁ፤ ለእናቱም እንደሚያለቅስ ራሴን ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ ደስም አላቸው፤ ግፈኞች በእኔ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ እኔም አላውቅሁም፤ ቀደዱኝ አልተውኝምም።

verses.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.am: ፈተኑኝ በሣቅም ዘበቱብኝ፥ ጥርሳቸውንም በእኔ ላይ አንቀጫቅጩ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ታይልኛለህ? ነፍሴን ከክፉ ሥራቸው ብችነቴንም ከአንበሶች አድናት።

verses.en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በታላቁ ጉባኤ ውስጥ እገዛልሃለሁ፥ በብዙ ሕዝብ መካከልም አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.am: በግፍ የሚጠሉኝ በላዬ ደስ አይበላቸው፥ በከንቱ የሚጣሉኝም በዓይናቸው አይጣቀሱብኝ።

verses.en: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.am: ለእኔስ ሰላምን ይናገሩኛልና፥ በቍጣም ሽንገላን ይመክራሉ።

verses.en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.am: አፋቸውንም በእኔ ላይ አላቀቁ፤ እሰይ እሰይ፥ ዓይናችን አየው ይላሉ።

verses.en: This thou hast seen, O YAHUAH: keep not silence: O YAHUAH, be not far from me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አየኸው፤ ዝም አትበል፤ አቤቱ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ።

verses.en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my YAHUAH and my Master.
verses.am: አምላኬ ጌታዬም፥ ወደ ፍርዴ ተነሥ፥ አቤቱ፥ ፍርዴን አድምጥ።

verses.en: Judge me, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እንደ ጽድቅህ ፍረድልኝ፥ በላዬም ደስ አይበላቸው።

verses.en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.am: በልባቸው። እሰይ እሰይ፥ ነፍሳችንን ደስ አላት አይበሉ፤ ደግሞም። ዋጥነው አይበሉ።

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ደስ የሚላቸው ይፈሩ፥ በአንድነትም ይጐስቍሉ፤ በእኔ ላይ የሚታበዩ እፍረትንና ጕስቍልናን ይልበሱ።

verses.en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let YAHUAH be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.am: ጽድቄን የሚወድዱአት ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሴትንም ያድርጉ፤ የባሪያውን ሰላም የሚወድድ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ይሁን ዘወትር ይበሉ።

verses.en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
verses.am: ምላሴ ጽድቅህን ሁልጊዜም ምስጋናህን ይናገራል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid the servant of YAHUAH.] The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of YAHUAH before his eyes.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ በራሱ የሚያስት ነገርን ይናገራል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ፍርሃት በዓይኖቹ ፊት የለም።

verses.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.am: በአንደበቱ ሸንግሎአልና፤ ኃጢአቱ ባገኘችው ጊዜ ይጠላታል።

verses.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.am: የአፉ ቃል ግፍና ሽንገላ ነው፤ ማስተዋልን በጎ ማድረግንም ተወ።

verses.en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.am: በመኝታው ጠማማነትን አሰበ፤ መልካም ባልሆነች መንገድ ቆሞአል፤ ክፋትን አይንቃትም።

verses.en: Thy mercy, O YAHUAH, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በሰማይ ነው፥ እውነትህም ወደ ደመናት ትደርሳለች።

verses.en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O YAHUAH, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.am: ጽድቅህም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ተራሮች፥ ፍርድህም እጅግ ጥልቅ ናት፤ አቤቱ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳን ታድናለህ።

verses.en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O YAHUAH! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን እንዴት አበዛህ! የሰው ልጆች በክንፎችህ ጥላ ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.am: ከቤትህ ጠል ይጠጣሉ፥ ከተድላም ፈሳሽ ታጠጣቸዋለህ።

verses.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.am: የሕይወት ምንጭ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና፤ በብርሃንህ ብርሃንን እናያለን።

verses.en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.am: ምሕረትህን በሚያውቁህ ላይ፥ ጽድቅህንም ልባቸው በቀና ላይ ዘርጋ።

verses.en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.am: የትዕቢት እግር አይምጣብኝ፥ የኃጢአተኞችም እጅ አያውከኝ።

verses.en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.am: ዓመፃን የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ከዚያ ወደቁ፤ ወድቀዋል፥ መቆምም አይችሉም።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.am: በክፉዎች ላይ አትቅና፥ ዓመፃንም በሚያደርጉ ላይ አትቅና፤

verses.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.am: እንደ ሣር ፈጥነው ይደርቃሉና፥ እንደ ለመለመ ቅጠልም ይረግፋሉና።

verses.en: Trust in YAHUAH, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ታመን፥ መልካምንም አድርግ፥ በምድርም ተቀመጥ፥ ታምነህም ተሰማራ።

verses.en: Delight thyself also in YAHUAH; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበልህ፥ የልብህንም መሻት ይሰጥሃል።

verses.en: Commit thy way unto YAHUAH; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.am: መንገድህን ለእግዚአብሔር አደራ ስጥ፥ በእርሱም ታመን፥ እርሱም ያደርግልሃል።

verses.en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.am: ጽድቅህን እንደ ብርሃን። ፍርድህንም እንደ ቀትር ያመጣል።

verses.en: Rest in YAHUAH, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዛ ተስፋም አድርገው። መንገድም በቀናችለትና ጥመትን በሚያደርግ ሰው አትቅና።

verses.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.am: ከቁጣ ራቅ መዓትንም ተው፤ እንዳትበድል አትቅና።

verses.en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon YAHUAH, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.am: ክፉ አድራጊዎች ይጠፋሉና፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ የሚያደርጉ ግን እነርሱ ምድርን ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.am: ገና ጥቂት፥ ኃጢአተኛም አይኖርም፤ ትፈልገዋለህ ቦታውንም አታገኝም።

verses.en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.am: ገሮች ግን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥ በብዙም ሰላም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቁን ይመለካከተዋል፥ ጥርሱንም በእርሱ ላይ ያንገጫግጫል።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይሥቅበታል፥ ቀኑ እንደሚደርስ አይቶአልና።

verses.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ሰይፋቸውን መዘዙ፥ ቀስታቸውንም ገተሩ ድሀውንና ችግረኛውን ይጥሉ ዘንድ ልበ ቅኖችንም ይወጉ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.am: ሰይፋቸው ወደ ልባቸው ይግባ፥ ቀስታቸውም ይሰበር።

verses.en: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.am: ለጻድቅ ያለው ጥቂት ከብዙ ከኃጢአተኞች ሀብት ይበልጣል።

verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but YAHUAH upholdeth the righteous.
verses.am: የኃጥአን ክንድ ትሰበራለችና፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ጻድቃንን ይደግፋቸዋል።

verses.en: YAHUAH knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.am: የንጹሓንን መንገድ እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል፥ ርስታቸውም ለዘላለም ነው፤

verses.en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.am: በክፉ ዘመንም አያፍሩም በራብ ዘመንም ይጠግባሉ።

verses.en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of YAHUAH shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.am: ኅጥአን ግን ይጠፋሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶች በከበሩና ከፍ ከፍ ባሉ ጊዜ እንደ ጢስ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ይበደራል አይከፍልምም፤ ጻድቅ ግን ይራራል ይሰጣልም።

verses.en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.am: እርሱን የሚባርኩት ምድርን ይወርሳሉና፤ የሚረግሙት ግን ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The steps of a good man are ordered by YAHUAH: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.am: የሰው አካሄድ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይጸናል፥ መንገዱንም ይወድዳል።

verses.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for YAHUAH upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.am: ቢወድቅም ለድንጋፄ አይጣልም፥ እግዚአብሔር እጁን ይዞ ይደግፈዋልና።

verses.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.am: ጐለመስሁ አረጀሁም፤ ጻድቅ ሲጣል፥ ዘሩም እህል ሲለምን አላየሁም።

verses.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ ይራራል ያበድርማል፥ ዘሩም በበረከት ይኖራል።

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.am: ከክፉ ሽሽ፥ መልካምንም አድርግ፤ ለዘላለምም ትኖራለህ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፍርዱን ይወድዳልና፥ ቅዱሳኑንም አይጥላቸውምና፤ ለዘላለምም ይጠብቃቸዋል ለንጹሓንም ይበቀልላቸዋል፤ የኅጥኣን ዘር ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.am: ጻድቃን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥ በእርስዋም ለዘላለም ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.am: የጻድቅ አፍ ጥበብን ያስተምራል፥ አንደበቱም ፍርድን ይናገራል።

verses.en: The law of his YAHUAH is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.am: የአምላኩ ሕግ በልቡ ውስጥ ነው፥ በእርምጃውም አይሰናከልም።

verses.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቁን ይመለከተዋል፥ ሊገድለውም ይወድዳል።

verses.en: YAHUAH will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን በእጁ አይተወውም፥ በተፋረደውም ጊዜ አያሸንፈውም።

verses.en: Wait on YAHUAH, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ደጅ ጥና፥ መንገዱንም ጠብቅ፥ ምድርንም ትወርስ ዘንድ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርግሃል፤ ኃጢአተኞችም ሲጠፉ ታያለህ።

verses.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.am: ኃጥአን ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ለምልሞ አየሁት።

verses.en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.am: ብመለስ ግን አጣሁት፤ ፈለግሁት ቦታውንም አላገኘሁም።

verses.en: Marqos the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.am: ቅንነትን ጠብቅ፥ ጽድቅንም እይ፤ ለሰላም ሰው ቅሬታ አለውና።

verses.en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.am: በደለኞች በአንድነት ይጠፋሉ። የኃጢአተኞች ቅሬታ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of YAHUAH: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.am: የጻድቃን መድኃኒታቸው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፤ በመከራቸውም ጊዜ መጠጊያቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይረዳቸዋል፥ ያድናቸዋልም፥ ከኃጢአተኞችም እጅ ያወጣቸዋል፥ ያድናቸዋል፥ በእርሱ ታምነዋልና።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, to bring to remembrance.] O YAHUAH, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣህ አትቅሠፈኝ፥ በመዓትህም አትገሥጸኝ።

verses.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.am: ፍላጾችህ ወግተውኛልና፥ እጅህንም አክብደህብኛልና።

verses.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.am: ከቍጣህ የተነሣ ለሥጋዬ ጤና የለውም፤ ከኃጢአቴም የተነሣ ለአጥንቶቼ ሰላም የላቸውም።

verses.en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.am: ኃጢአቴ በራሴ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና፥ እንደ ከባድ ሸክምም በላዬ ከብዶአልና።

verses.en: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.am: ከስንፍናዬ የተነሣ ቍስሌ ሸተተ በሰበሰም፤

verses.en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.am: እጅግ ጐሰቈልሁ ተዋረድሁም፥ ሁልጊዜም በትካዜ እመላለሳለሁ።

verses.en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ስድብን ተሞልታለችና፥ ለሥጋዬም ጤና የላትምና።

verses.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.am: ታመምሁ፤ እጅግም ተቸገርሁ፥ ከልቤ ውዝዋዜም የተነሣ ጮኽሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፈቃዴ ሁሉ በፊትህ ነው፥ ጭንቀቴም ከአንተ አይሰወርም።

verses.en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.am: ልቤ ደነገጠብኝ፥ ኃይሌም ተወችኝ፥ የዓይኖቼም ብርሃን ፈዘዘ።

verses.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.am: ወዳጆቼም ባልንጀሮቼም ከቍስሌ ገለል ብለው ቆሙ፥ ዘመዶቼም ርቀው ቆሙ።

verses.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.am: ነፍሴንም የሚሹአት በረቱብኝ፥ መከራዬንም የሚፈልጉ ከንቱን ተናገሩ፥ ሁልጊዜም በሽንገላ ይመክራሉ።

verses.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እንደማይሰማ ደንቆሮ አፉንም እንደማይከፍት ዲዳ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.am: እንደማይሰማ ሰው በአፉም ተግሣጽ እንደሌለው ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.en: For in thee, O YAHUAH, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ አንተ ትሰማኛለህ።

verses.en: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ በእኔ ላይ ደስ እንዳይላቸው ብያለሁና፥ እግሮቼም ቢሰናከሉ ራሳቸውን በእኔ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.am: እኔስ ወደ ማንከስ ቀርቤአለሁና፥ ቍስሌም ሁልጊዜም በፊቴ ነውና።

verses.en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.am: በደሌን እናገራለሁና፥ ስለ ኃጢአቴም እተክዛለሁ።

verses.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ሕያዋን ናቸው ይበረቱብኝማል፥ በጠማማነትም የሚጠሉኝ በዙ።

verses.en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.am: ጽድቅን ስለ ተከተልሁ፥ በበጎ ፋንታ ክፉን የሚመልሱልኝ ይጠሉኛል።

verses.en: Forsake me not, O YAHUAH: O my YAHUAH, be not far from me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አትጣለኝ፤ አምላኬ፥ ከኔ አትራቅ።

verses.en: Make haste to help me, O YAHUAH my salvation.
verses.am: አቤቱ መድኃኒቴ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, even to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Dawid.] I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.am: በአንደበቴ እንዳልስት መንገዴን እጠብቃለሁ፤ ኃጢአተኛ በፊቴ በተቃወመኝ ጊዜ በአፌ ላይ ጠባቂ አኖራለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.am: ከዝምታ የተነሣ እንደ ዲዳ ሆንሁ፥ ለበጎ እንኳ ዝም አልሁ፥ ቍስሌም ታደሰብኝ።

verses.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.am: ልቤም በውስጤ ሞቀብኝ፤ ከማሰቤም የተነሣ እሳት ነደደ፥ በአንደበቴም ተናገርሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍጻሜዬን አስታውቀኝ፥ የዘመኔ ቍጥሮች ምን ያህል እንደ ሆኑ፥ እኔ ምን ያህል ወደ ኋላ እንደምቀር አውቅ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ዘመኖቼን አስረጀሃቸው፤ አካሌም በፊትህ እንደ ኢምንት ነው። ሕያው የሆነ ሰው ሁሉ በእውነት ከንቱ ብቻ ነው።

verses.en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.am: በከንቱ ይታወካል እንጂ በእውነት ሰው እንደ ጣላ ይመላለሳል፤ ያከማቻል የሚሰበስብለትንም አያውቅም።

verses.en: And now, YAHUAH, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
verses.am: አሁንስ ተስፋዬ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር አይደለምን? ትዕግሥቴም ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.am: ከኃጢአቴ ሁሉ አድነኝ፥ ለሰነፎችም ስድብ አታድርገኝ።

verses.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
verses.am: አንተ ሠርተኸኛልና ዝም አልሁ አፌንም አልከፈትሁም።

verses.en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
verses.am: መቅሠፍትህን ከእኔ አርቅ፥ ከእጅህ ብርታት የተነሣ አልቄአለሁና።

verses.en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
verses.am: በተግሣጽህ ስለ ኃጢአቱ ሰውን ዘለፍኸው፥ ነፍሱም እንደ ሸረሪት ድር ታልቃለች፤ በእውነት ሰው ሁሉ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፥ ጩኸቴንም አድምጥ፥ ልቅሶዬንም ቸል አትበለኝ፤ እኔ በምድር ላይ መጻተኛ ነኝና፥ እንደ አባቶችም እንግዳ ነኝና።

verses.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.am: ወደማልመለስበት ሳልሄድ ዐርፍ ዘንድ ተወኝ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] I waited patiently for YAHUAH; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.am: ቆይቼ እግዚአብሔር ደጅ ጠናሁት፥ እርሱም ዘንበል አለልኝ ጩኽቴንም ሰማኝ።

verses.en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.am: ከጥፋት ጕድጓድ ከረግረግም ጭቃ አወጣኝ፥ እግሮቼንም በድንጋይ ላይ አቆማቸው፥ አረማመዴንም አጸና።

verses.en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our YAHUAH: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in YAHUAH.
verses.am: አዲስ ዝማሬን ለአምላካችን ምስጋና በአፌ ጨመረ፤ ብዙዎች ያያሉ ይፈሩማል፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: Blessed is that man that maketh YAHUAH his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የታመነ ወደ ትዕቢተኛና ወደ ሐሰተኛ ያልተመለከተ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: Many, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ያደረግኸው ተአምራት ብዙ ነው፥ አሳብህንም ምንም የሚመስለው የለም፤ ባወራም ብናገርም ከቍጥር ሁሉ በዛ።

verses.en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.am: መሥዋዕትንና ቍርባንን አልወደድህም፤ ሥጋን አዘጋጀህልኝ፤ የሚቃጠለውንና ስለ ኃጢአት የሚቀርበውን መሥዋዕት አልሻህም።

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አልሁ። እነሆ፥ መጣሁ፤ ስለ እኔ በመጽሐፍ ራስ ተጽፎአል፤

verses.en: I delight to do thy will, O my YAHUAH: yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ለማድረግ ወደድሁ፥ ሕግህም በልቤ ውስጥ ነው።

verses.en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O YAHUAH, thou knowest.
verses.am: በታላቅ ጉባኤ ጽድቅን አወራሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ከንፈሮቼን አልከለክልም፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጽድቄን ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.am: እውነትህንም በልቤ ውስጥ አልሰወርሁም፥ ማዳንህንም ተናገርሁ፤ ምሕረትህንና እውነትህን ከታላቅ ጉባኤ አልሰወርሁም።

verses.en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O YAHUAH: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ምሕረትህን ከእኔ አታርቅ፤ ቸርነትህና እውነትህ ዘወትር ይጠብቁኝ።

verses.en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.am: ቍጥር የሌላት ክፋት አግኝታኛለችና፤ ኃጢአቶቼ ያዙኝ፥ ማየትም ተስኖኛል ከራሴ ጠጕር ይልቅ በዙ፥ ልቤም ተወኝ።

verses.en: Be pleased, O YAHUAH, to deliver me: O YAHUAH, make haste to help me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ታድነኝ ዘንድ ፍቀድ፤ አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ለማጥፋት የሚወድዱ ይፈሩ፥ በአንድነትም ይጐስቍሉ፤ በእኔ ላይ ክፋትን ሊያደርጉ የሚወድዱ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ ይጐስቍሉም።

verses.en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.am: እሰይ እሰይ የሚሉኝ እፍረታቸውን ወዲያው ይከፈሉ።

verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, YAHUAH be magnified.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሚፈልጉህ ሁሉ በአንተ ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሤትም ያድርጉ፤ ሁልጊዜ ማዳንህን የሚወድዱ ዘወትር። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ይሁን ይበሉ።

verses.en: But I am poor and needy; yet YAHUAH thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኔ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝ፥ ጌታ ግን ያስብልኛል፤ አንተ ረዳቴና መድኃኒቴ ነህ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አትዘግይ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Blessed is he that considereth the poor: YAHUAH will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.am: ለችግረኛና ለምስኪን የሚያስብ ምስጉን ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር በክፉ ቀን ያድነዋል።

verses.en: YAHUAH will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቀዋል፥ ሕያውም ያደርገዋል፥ በምድር ላይም ያስመሰግነዋል፥ በጠላቶቹም እጅ አያሳልፈውም።

verses.en: YAHUAH will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በደዌው አልጋ ሳለ ይረዳዋል፤ መኝታውን ሁሉ በበሽታው ጊዜ ያነጥፍለታል።

verses.en: I said, YAHUAH, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.am: እኔስ። አቤቱ ማረኝ፤ አንተን በድያለሁና ነፍሴን ፈውሳት አልሁ።

verses.en: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.am: ጠላቶቼም በላዬ ክፋትን ይናገራሉ። መቼም ይሞታል ስሙስ መቼ ይሻራል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
verses.am: እኔን ለማየት ቢገባ ከንቱን ይናገራል፤ ልቡ ኃጢአትን ሰበሰበለት፤ ወደ ሜዳ ይወጣል ይናገራልም።

verses.en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.am: በላዬ በመተባበር ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ይሾካሾኩብኛል፥ በእኔ ላይም ክፋትን ያስባሉ።

verses.en: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.am: ክፉ ነገር መጣበት፤ ተኝቶአል ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይነሣም ይላሉ።

verses.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.am: ደግሞ የሰላሜ ሰው የታመንሁበት እንጀራዬን የበላ በእኔ ላይ ተረከዙን አነሣ።

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.am: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ ማረኝ እመልስላቸውም ዘንድ አስነሣኝ።

verses.en: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.am: ጠላቴ እልል አይልብኝምና ስለዚህ እንደ ወደድኸኝ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.am: እኔን ግን ስለ ቅንነቴ ተቀበልኸኝ፥ በፊትህም ለዘላለም አጸናኸኝ።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH of Yisra'el from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.am: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአሔር ይባረክ። አሜን አሜን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.] As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: ዋላ ወደ ውኃ ምንጭ እንደሚናፍቅ፥ አቤቱ፥ እንዲሁ ነፍሴ ወደ አንተ ትናፍቃለች።

verses.en: My soul thirsteth for YAHUAH, for the living YAHUAH: when shall I come and appear before YAHUAH?
verses.am: ነፍሴ ወደ ሕያው አምላክ ተጠማች፤ መቼ እደርሳለሁ? የአምላክንስ ፊት መቼ አያለሁ?

verses.en: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy YAHUAH?
verses.am: ዘወትር። አምላክህ ወዴት ነው? ሲሉኝ እንባዬ በቀንና በሌሊት ምግብ ሆነኝ።

verses.en: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of YAHUAH, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
verses.am: ይህን ሳስብ ነፍሴ በእኔ ውስጥ ፈሰሰች፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ምስጋና መኖሪያ ስፍራ እገባለሁና፤ በዓል የሚያደርጉ ሰዎች የደስታና ምስጋና ቃል አሰሙ።

verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in YAHUAH: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ለምን ታዝኛለሽ? ለምንስ ታውኪኛለሽ? የፊቴን መድኃኒት አምላኬን አመሰግነው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኚ።

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ነፍሴ በእኔ ውስጥ ታወከች፤ ስለዚህ በዮርዳኖስ ምድር በአርሞንኤምም በታናሹ ተራራ አስብሃለሁ።

verses.en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.am: በፍዋፍዋቴህ ድምፅ ቀላይ ቀላይን ትጠራታለች፤ ማዕበልህና ሞገድህ ሁሉ በላዬ አለፈ።

verses.en: Yet YAHUAH will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto YAHUAH of my life.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቀን ቸርነቱን ያዝዛል፥ በሌሊትም ዝማሬው በእኔ ዘንድ ይሆናል፤ የእኔ ስእለት ለሕይወቴ አምላክ ነው።

verses.en: I will say unto YAHUAH my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ መጠጊያዬ ነህ፤ ለምን ረሳኸኝ? ጠላቶቼ ሲያስጨንቁኝ ለምን አዝኜ እመላለሳለሁ? እለዋለሁ።

verses.en: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy YAHUAH?
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ሁልጊዜ። አምላክህ ወዴት ነው? ባሉኝ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼን እየቀለጣጠሙ ሰደቡኝ።

verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in YAHUAH: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ለምን ታዝኛለሽ? ለምንስ ታውኪኛለሽ? የፊቴን መድኃኒት አምላኬን አመሰግነው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኚ።

verses.en: Judge me, O YAHUAH, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍረድልኝ፥ ከጽድቅ ከራቁ ሕዝብም ክርክሬን ተከራከር፤ ከሸንጋይና ከግፈኛ ሰው አድነኝ።

verses.en: For thou art YAHUAH of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.am: አንተ አምላኬ ኃይሌም፥ ለምን ትተውኛለህ? ጠላቶቼ ሲያስጨንቁኝ ለምን አዝኜ እመላለሳለሁ?

verses.en: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
verses.am: ብርሃንህንና እውነትህን ላክ፤ እነርሱ ይምሩኝ፥ ወደ ቅድስናህ ተራራና ወደ ማደሪያህ ይውሰዱኝ።

verses.en: Then will I go unto the altar of YAHUAH, unto YAHUAH my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ፥ ጕልማስነቴንም ደስ ወዳሰኛት ወደ አምላኬ እገባለሁ፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ በበገና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in YAHUAH: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ለምን ታዝኛለሽ? ለምንስ ታውኪኛለሽ? የፊቴን መድኃኒት አምላኬን አመሰግነው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኚ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.] We have heard with our ears, O YAHUAH, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በጆሮአችን ሰማን፥ አባቶቻችንም በዘመናቸው በቀድሞ ዘመን የሠራኸውን ሥራ ነገሩን።

verses.en: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.am: እጅህ አሕዛብን አጠፋች፥ እነርሱንም ተከልህ፤ አሕዛብን ሣቀይኻቸው አሳደድኻቸውም።

verses.en: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.am: በሰይፋቸው ምድርን አልወረሱም ክንዳቸውም አላዳናቸው፤ ቀኝህና ክንድህ የፊትህም ብርሃን ነው እንጂ ወድደሃቸዋልና።

verses.en: Thou art my King, O YAHUAH: command deliverances for Ya'aqob.
verses.am: አምላኬና ንጉሤ አንተ ነህ፤ ለያዕቆብ መድኃኒትንህ እዘዝ።

verses.en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.am: በአንተ ጠላቶቻችንን እንወጋቸዋለን፥ በስምህም በላያችን የቆሙትን እናዋርዳቸዋለን።

verses.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.am: በቀስቴ የምታመን አይደለሁምና፥ ሰይፌም አያድነኝምና፤

verses.en: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ከጠላቶቻችን አዳንኸን፥ የሚጠሉንንም አሳፈርሃቸው።

verses.en: In YAHUAH we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር እንከብራለን፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም እናመሰግናለን።

verses.en: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.am: አሁን ግን ጠላኸን አሳፈርኸንም፥ ከሠራዊታችንም ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.en: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.am: ከጠላቶቻችንም ፊት ወደ ኋላችን መለስኸን፥ የሚጠሉንም ተነጣጠቁን።

verses.en: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.am: እንደ በጎች ሊበሉን ሰጠኸን፥ ወደ አሕዛብም በተንኸን።

verses.en: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን ያለ ዋጋ ሰጠህ፥ በመለወጣቸውም ትርፍ የለም።

verses.en: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.am: ለጎረቤቶቻችን ስድብ፥ በዙሪያችንም ላሉ መሣቂያና መዘበቻ አደረግኸን።

verses.en: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ምሳሌ፥ በሕዝብም ዘንድ የራስ መንቀሳቀሻ አደረግኸን።

verses.en: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.am: ጕስቍልናዬ ሁልጊዜም በፊቴ ነው፥ የፊቴም እፍረት ሸፈነኝ።

verses.en: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.am: ከሚሳደብና ከሚላገድ ቃል የተነሣ፥ ከጠላትና ከቂመኛ ፊት የተነሣ ነው።

verses.en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.am: ይህ ሁሉ በእኛ ላይ ደረሰ፥ አልረሳንህም፥ ኪዳንህንም አልወነጀልንም።

verses.en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.am: ልባችን ወደ ኋላው አልተመለሰም፥ ፍለጋችንም ከመንገድህ ፈቀቅ አላለም፤

verses.en: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.am: በክፉ ስፍራ አዋርደኸናልና፥ በሞት ጥላም ሰውረኸናልና።

verses.en: If we have forgotten the name of our YAHUAH, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.am: የአምላካችንን ስም ረስተንስ ቢሆን፥ እጃችንንም ወደ ሌላ አምላክ አንሥተንስ ቢሆን፥

verses.en: Shall not YAHUAH search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይህንን አይመረምርም ነበርን? እርሱ ልብ የሰወረውን ያውቃልና።

verses.en: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.am: ስለ አንተ ሁልጊዜም ተገድለናል፥ እንደሚታረዱም በጎች ሆነናል።

verses.en: Awake, why sleepest thou, O YAHUAH? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ንቃ፤ ለምንስ ትተኛለህ? ተነሥ፥ ለዘወትርም አትጣለን።

verses.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.am: ለምንስ ፊትህን ትሰውራለህ? መከራችንንና ችግራችንንስ ለምን ትረሳለህ?

verses.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.am: ነፍሳችን በመሬት ላይ ተጐሳቍላለችና፥ ሆዳችንም ወደ ምድር ተጣብቃለችና።

verses.en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥና እርዳን፥ ስለ ስምህም ተቤዠን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.] My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.am: ልቤ መልካም ነገርን አፈለቀ፥ እኔ ሥራዬን ለንጉሥ እነግራለሁ፤ አንደበቴ እንደ ፈጣን ጸሓፊ ብርዕ ነው።

verses.en: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore YAHUAH hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.am: ውበትህ ከሰው ልጆች ይልቅ ያምራል፤ ሞገስ በከንፈሮችህ ፈሰሰ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ባረከህ።

verses.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.am: ኃያል ሆይ፥ በቍንጅናህና በውበትህ ሰይፍህን በወገብህ ታጠቅ።

verses.en: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.am: ስለ ቅንነትና ስለ የዋህነት ስለ ጽድቅም አቅና ተከናወን ንገሥም፤ ቀኝህም በክብር ይመራሃል።

verses.en: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
verses.am: ኃያል ሆይ፥ ፍላጻዎችህ የተሳሉ ናቸው፥ እነርሱም በንጉሥ ጠላቶች ልብ ውስጥ ይገባሉ፥ አሕዛብም በበታችህ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Thy throne, O YAHUAH, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ዙፋንህ ለዘላለም ነው፤ የመንግሥትህ በትር የቅንነት በትር ነው።

verses.en: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore YAHUAH, thy YAHUAH, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.am: ጽድቅን ወደድህ ዓመፃንም ጠላህ፤ ስለዚህ ከባልንጀሮችህ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ የደስታ ዘይትን ቀባህ።

verses.en: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
verses.am: በልብሶችህ ሁሉ ከርቤና ሽቱ ዝባድም አሉ፤ ከዝሆን ጥርሶች አዳራሽ ደስ ያሰኙሃል።

verses.en: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.am: የንጉሦች ሴት ልጆች ለክብርህ ናቸው፤ በወርቅ ልብስ ተጐናጽፋና ተሸፋፍና ንግሥቲቱ በቀኝህ ትቆማለች።

verses.en: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስሚ እዪ ጆሮሽንም አዘንብዪ፤ ወገንሽን ያባትሽንም ቤት እርሺ፤

verses.en: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy YAHUAH; and worship thou him.
verses.am: ንጉሥ ውበትሽን ወድዶአልና፥ እርሱ ጌታሽ ነውና።

verses.en: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
verses.am: የጢሮስ ሴቶች ልጆች እጅ መንሻን ይዘው ይሰግዱለታል። የምድር ባለጠጎች አሕዛብ በፊትህ ይማለላሉ።

verses.en: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
verses.am: ለሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ልጅ ሁሉ ክብርዋ ነው፤ ልብስዋ የወርቅ መጐናጸፊያ ነው።

verses.en: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
verses.am: በኋላዋ ደናግሉን ለንጉሥ ይወስዳሉ፥ ባልንጀሮችዋንም ወደ አንተ ያቀርባሉ፤

verses.en: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
verses.am: በደስታና በሐሴት ይወስዱአቸዋል፥ ወደ ንጉሥ እልፍኝም ያስገቡአቸዋል።

verses.en: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.am: በአባቶችሽ ፋንታ ልጆች ተወለዱልሽ፥ በምድርም ሁሉ ላይ ገዥዎች አድርገሽ ትሾሚያቸዋለሽ።

verses.en: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.am: ለልጅ ልጅ ሁሉ ስምሽን ያሳስባሉ፤ ስለዚህ ለዓለምና ለዘላለም አሕዛብ ይገዙልሃል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.] YAHUAH is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.am: አምላካችን መጠጊያችንና ኃይላችን፥ ባገኘን በታላቅ መከራም ረዳታችን ነው።

verses.en: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምድር ብትነዋወጥ፥ ተራሮችም ወደ ባሕር ልብ ቢወሰዱ አንፈራም።

verses.en: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.am: ውኆቻቸው ጮኹ ተናወጡም፥ ተራሮችም ከኃይሉ የተነሣ ተናወጡ።

verses.en: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of YAHUAH, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.am: የወንዝ ፈሳሾች የእግዚአብሔርን ከተማ ደስ ያሰኛሉ፤ ልዑል ማደሪያውን ቀደሰ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: YAHUAH shall help her, and that right early.
verses.am: እግዚአሔር በመካከልዋ ነው አትናወጥም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ፈጥኖ ይረዳታል።

verses.en: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ተናወጡ መንግሥታትም ተመለሱ፤ እርሱ ቃሉን ሰጠ፥ ምድርም ተንቀጠቀጠች።

verses.en: YAHUAH of hosts is with us; YAHUAH of Ya'aqob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ መጠጊያችን ነው።

verses.en: Come, behold the works of YAHUAH, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ፥ በምድር ያደረገውንም ተኣምራት እንድታዩ ኑ።

verses.en: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.am: እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ጦርነት ይሽራል። ቀስትን ይሰብራል፥ ጦርንም ይቈርጣል በእሳትም ጋሻን ያቃጥላል።

verses.en: Be still, and know that I am YAHUAH: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.am: ዕረፉ፥ እኔም አምላክ እንደ ሆንሁ እወቁ፤ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ፥ በምድርም ላይ ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH of hosts is with us; YAHUAH of Ya'aqob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ መጠጊያችን ነው።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto YAHUAH with the voice of triumph.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ እጆቻችሁን አጨብጭቡ፥ በደስታ ቃልም ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልዑል ግሩምም ነውና፥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይም ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነውና።

verses.en: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.am: አሕዛብን ከእኛ በታች፥ ወገኖችንም ከእግራችን በታች አስገዛልን።

verses.en: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Ya'aqob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.am: ለርስቱ እኛን መረጠን፥ የወደደውን የያዕቆብን ውበት።

verses.en: YAHUAH is gone up with a shout, YAHUAH with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.am: አምላክ በእልልታ፥ እግዚአብሔር በመለከት ድምፅ ዐረገ።

verses.en: Sing praises to YAHUAH, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.am: ዘምሩ፥ ለአምላካችን ዘምሩ፤ ዘምሩ፥ ለንጉሣችን ዘምሩ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለምድር ሁሉ ንጉሥ ነውና፤ በማስተዋል ዘምሩ።

verses.en: YAHUAH reigneth over the heathen: YAHUAH sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ላይ ነገሠ፤ እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ዙፋን ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of YAHUAH of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto YAHUAH: he is greatly exalted.
verses.am: የምድር ኃይለኞች ለእግዚአብሔር ናቸውና የአሕዛብ አለቆች ወደ አብርሃም አምላክ ተሰበሰቡ፤ እርሱንም ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉት።

verses.en: [A Song and Psalm for the sons of Korah.] Great is YAHUAH, and greatly to be praised in the city of our YAHUAH, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ትልቅ ነው፤ በአምላካችን ከተማ በተቀደሰ ተራራ ምስጋናው ብዙ ነው።

verses.en: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.am: በሰሜን ወገን በመልካም ስፍራ የቆመ የምድር ሁሉ ደስታ የጽዮን ተራራ ነው፤ እርሱም የትልቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአዳራሾችዋ መጠጊያ ሆኖ ይታወቃል።

verses.en: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ነገሥታት ተከማችተው በአንድነት መጥተዋል።

verses.en: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.am: እነርሱስ አይተው ተደነቁ፥ ደነገጡ፥ ታወኩ።

verses.en: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.am: መንቀጥቀጥ እንደ ወላድ ምጥ በዚያ ያዛቸው።

verses.en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.am: በኃይለኛ ነፋስ የተርሴስን መርከቦች ትሰብራለህ።

verses.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of YAHUAH of hosts, in the city of our YAHUAH: YAHUAH will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.am: እንደ ሰማን እንዲሁ አየን በሠራዊት ጌታ ከተማ፥ በአምላካችን ከተማ፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ያጸናታል።

verses.en: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O YAHUAH, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሕዝብህ መካከል ምሕረትህን ተቀበልን።

verses.en: According to thy name, O YAHUAH, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንደ ስምህ እንዲሁም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ምስጋናህ ነው፤ ቀኝህ ጽድቅን የተሞላች ናት።

verses.en: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Yehudah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ፍርድህ የጽዮን ተራራ ደስ ይበለው፥ የአይሁድም ሴት ልጆች ሐሤት ያድርጉ።

verses.en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.am: ጽዮንን ክበቡአት፥ በዙሪያዋም ተመላለሱ፥ ግንቦችዋንም ቍጠሩ፤

verses.en: Marqos ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.am: በብርታትዋ ልባችሁን አኑሩ፤ አዳራሽዋን አስቡ፤ ለሚመጣው ትውልድ ትነግሩ ዘንድ።

verses.en: For this YAHUAH is our YAHUAH for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.am: ለዓለምና ለዘላለም ይህ አምላካችን ነው፥ እርሱም ለዘላለም ይመራናል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ ይህን ስሙ፤ በዓለም የምትኖሩትም ሁላችሁ፥ አድምጡ፤

verses.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.am: ዝቅተኞችና ከፍተኞች፥ ባለጠጎችና ድሆች በአንድነት።

verses.en: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
verses.am: አፌ ጥበብን ይናገራል፥ የልቤም አሳብ ማስተዋልን።

verses.en: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.am: ጆሮዬን ወደ ምሳሌ አዘነብላለሁ፥ በበገናም ምሥጢሬን እገልጣለሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.am: ኃጢአት ተረከዜን በከበበኝ ጊዜ በክፉ ቀን ለምን እፈራለሁ?

verses.en: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.am: በኃይላቸው የሚታመኑ፥ በባለጠግነታቸውም ብዛት የሚመኩ፤

verses.en: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to YAHUAH a ransom for him:
verses.am: ወንድም ወንድሙን አያድንም፥ ሰውም አያድንም፤ ቤዛውን ለእግዚአብሔር አይሰጥም፥

verses.en: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
verses.am: ለዘላለም እንዲኖር፥ ጥፋትንም እንዳያይ፤ የነፍሳቸው ለውጥ ከብሮአልና፥ ለዘላለምም ቀርቶአልና።

verses.en: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.am: ብልሃተኞች እንዲሞቱ፥ ሰነፎችችና ደንቆሮች በአንድነት እንዲጠፉ፥ ገንዘባቸውንም ለሌሎች እንዲተዉ አይቶአል።

verses.en: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
verses.am: በልባቸውም ቤታቸው ለዘላለም የሚኖር፥ ማደሪያቸውም ለልጆች ልጅ የሚሆን ይመስላቸዋል፤ በየአገራቸውም ስማቸው ይጠራል።

verses.en: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.am: ሰው ግን ክቡር ሆኖ ሳለ አያውቅም፤ እንደሚጠፉ እንስሶች መሰለ።

verses.en: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.am: ይህች መንገዳቸው መሰናክላቸው ናት፥ ከእነርሱም በኋላ የሚመጡ በአፋቸው እሺ ይላሉ።

verses.en: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.am: እንደ በጎች ወደ ሲኦል የሚሄዱ ናቸው፥ እረኛቸውም ሞት ነው፤ ቅኖችንም በማለዳ ይገዙአቸዋል፥ ውበታቸውም ከመኖሪያቸው ተለይታ በሲኦል ታረጃለች።

verses.en: But YAHUAH will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ይቀበለኛልና ነፍሴን ከሲኦል እጅ ይቤዣታል።

verses.en: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.am: የሰው ባለጠግነት የቤቱም ክብር በበዛ ጊዜ አትፍራ፥

verses.en: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.am: በሞተ ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ምንም አይወስድምና፥ ክብሩም ከእርሱ በኋላ አይወርድምና።

verses.en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
verses.am: በሕይወቱ ሳለ ነፍሱን ባርኮአልና ለሰውነቱ መልካም ብታደርግለት ያመሰግንሃል።

verses.en: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.am: ሆኖም ወደ አባቶቹ ትውልድ ይወርዳል፤ ለዘላለም ብርሃንን አያይም።

verses.en: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
verses.am: አእምሮ የሌለው ክቡር ሰው እንደሚጠፋ እንስሶች መሰለ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Asaph.] The mighty YAHUAH, even YAHUAH, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.am: የአማልክት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተናገረ፥ ከፀሓይም መውጫ ጀምሮ እስከ መግቢያዋ ድረስ ምድርን ጠራት።

verses.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, YAHUAH hath shined.
verses.am: ከክብሩ ውበት ከጽዮን እግዚአብሔር ግልጥ ሆኖ ይመጣል።

verses.en: Our YAHUAH shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
verses.am: አምላካችን ይመጣል ዝምም አይልም፤ እሳት በፊት ይቃጠላል፥ በዙሪያውም ብዙ ዐውሎ አለ።

verses.en: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.am: በላይ ያለውን ሰማይን ምድርንም በሕዝቡ ለመፍረድ ይጠራል፤

verses.en: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር ለመሥዋዕት ኪዳን የቆሙትን ቅዱሳኑን ሰብስቡለት።

verses.en: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for YAHUAH is judge himself. Selah.
verses.am: ሰማያት ጽድቁን ይናገራሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር ፈራጅ ነውና።

verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Yisra'el, and I will testify against thee: I am YAHUAH, even thy YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ፥ ስማኝ፥ ልንገርህ፤ እስራኤልም፥ ስማኝ፥ ልመስክርብህ፤ አምላክስ እኔ አምላክህ ነኝ።

verses.en: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
verses.am: ስለ ቍርባንህ የምዘልፍህ አይደለሁም፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትህ ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ ነው።

verses.en: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
verses.am: ከቤትህ ፍሪዳን ከመንጋህም አውራ ፍየልን አልወስድም፤

verses.en: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.am: የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ሁሉ በሺህ ተራራዎች ያሉ እንስሶችም የእኔ ናቸውና።

verses.en: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.am: የሰማይን አዕዋፍ ሁሉ አውቃለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳ አራዊትም በእኔ ዘንድ ናቸው።

verses.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.am: ብራብም ለአንተ አልነግርህም፥ ዓለምና ሞላው የእኔ ነውና።

verses.en: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.am: የፍሪዳውን ሥጋ እበላለሁን? የፍየሉንስ ደም እጠጣለሁን?

verses.en: Offer unto YAHUAH thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት ሠዋ፥ ለልዑልም ስእለትህን ስጥ፤

verses.en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.am: በመከራ ቀን ጥራኝ፥ አድንህማለሁ አንተም ታከብረኛለህ።

verses.en: But unto the wicked YAHUAH saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛውን ግን እግዚአብሔር አለው። ለምን አንተ ሕጌን ትናገራለህ? ኪዳኔንም በአፍህ ለምን ትወስዳለህ?

verses.en: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
verses.am: አንተስ ተግሣጼን ጠላህ፥ ቃሎቼንም ወደ ኋላህ ጣልህ።

verses.en: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.am: ሌባውን ባየህ ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ትሮጥ ነበር እድል ፈንታህንም ከአመንዝሮች ጋር አደረግህ።

verses.en: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
verses.am: አፍህ ክፋትን አበዛ፥ አንደበትህም ሽንገላን ተበተበ።

verses.en: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
verses.am: ተቀምጠህ ወንድምህን አማኸው፥ ለእናትህም ልጅ ዕንቅፋት አኖርህ።

verses.en: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
verses.am: ይህን አድርገህ ዝም አልሁህ፤ እኔ እንደ አንተ እሆን ዘንድ ጠረጠርህ፤ እዘልፍሃለሁ በፊትህም እቆማለሁ።

verses.en: Now consider this, ye that forget YAHUAH, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትረሱ እናንተ፥ ይህን አስተውሉ፤ አለዚያ ግን ይነጥቃል የሚያድንም የለም።

verses.en: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ምስጋና የሚሠዋ ያከብረኛል፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ለእርሱ የማሳይበት መንገድ ከዚያ አለ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid, when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.] Have mercy upon me, O YAHUAH, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቸርነትህ መጠን ማረኝ፤ እንደ ምሕረትህም ብዛት መተላለፌን ደምስስ።

verses.en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.am: ከበደሌ ፈጽሞ እጠበኝ፥ ከኃጢአቴም አንጻኝ፤

verses.en: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
verses.am: እኔ መተላለፌን አውቃለሁና፥ ኃጢአቴም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ ነውና።

verses.en: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
verses.am: አንተን ብቻ በደልሁ፥ በፊትህም ክፋትን አደረግሁ፥ በነገርህም ትጸድቅ ዘንድ በፍርድህም ንጹሕ ትሆን ዘንድ።

verses.en: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዓመፃ ተፀነስሁ፥ እናቴም በኃጢአት ወለደችኝ።

verses.en: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እውነትን ወደድህ፤ የማይታይ ስውር ጥበብን አስታወቅኸኝ።

verses.en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.am: በሂሶጵ እርጨኝ፥ እነጻማለሁ፤ እጠበኝ፥ ከበረዶም ይልቅ ነጭ እሆናለሁ።

verses.en: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.am: ሐሤትንና ደስታን አሰማኝ፥ የሰበርሃቸውም አጥንቶቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.am: ከኃጢአቴ ፊትህን መልስ፥ በደሌንም ሁሉ ደምስስልኝ።

verses.en: Create in me a clean heart, O YAHUAH; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ንጹሕ ልብን ፍጠርልኝ፥ የቀናውንም መንፈስ በውስጤ አድስ።

verses.en: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
verses.am: ከፊትህ አትጣለኝ፥ ቅዱስ መንፈስህንም ከእኔ ላይ አትውሰድብኝ።

verses.en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
verses.am: የማዳንህን ደስታ ስጠኝ፥ በእሽታ መንፈስም ደግፈኝ።

verses.en: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.am: ለሕግ ተላላፎች መንገድህን አስተምራለሁ፥ ኃጢአተኞችም ወደ አንተ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O YAHUAH, thou YAHUAH of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.am: የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ከደም አድነኝ፥ አንደበቴም በአንተ ጽድቅ ትደሰታለች።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከንፈሮቼን ክፈት፥ አፌም ምስጋናህን ያወራል።

verses.en: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.am: መሥዋዕትን ብትወድድስ በሰጠሁህ ነበር፤ የሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ደስ አያሰኝህም።

verses.en: The sacrifices of YAHUAH are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O YAHUAH, thou wilt not despise.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት የተሰበረ መንፈስ ነው፥ የተሰበርውንና የተዋረደውን ልብ እግዚአብሔር አይንቅም።

verses.en: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በውዴታህ ጽዮንን አሰማምራት፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጽሮች ሥራ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.am: የጽድቁን መሥዋዕት መባውንም የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በወደድህ ጊዜ፥ ያን ጊዜ በመሠዊያህ ላይ ፍሪዳዎችን ይሠዋሉ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, A Psalm of Dawid, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Sha'ul, and said unto him, Dawid is come to the house of Ahimelech.] Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of YAHUAH endureth continually.
verses.am: ኃያል ሆይ፥ በክፋት ለምን ትጓደዳለህ? ሁልጊዜስ በመተላለፍ?

verses.en: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.am: አንደበትህ ኃጢአትን ያስባል፤ እንደ ተሳለ ምላጭ ሽንገላን አደረግህ።

verses.en: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
verses.am: ከመልካም ይልቅ ክፋትን፥ ጽድቅንም ከመናገር ይልቅ ዓመፃን ወደድህ።

verses.en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
verses.am: የሚያጠፉ ቃልን ሁሉ፥ የሽንገላ ምላስን ወደድህ።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ያፈርስሃል፤ ከቤትህም ይነቅልሃል ያፈልስሃልም፥ ሥርህንም ከሕያዋን ምድር።

verses.en: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
verses.am: ጻድቃን አይተው ይፈራሉ፤ በእርሱም ይሥቃሉ እንዲህም ይላሉ።

verses.en: Lo, this is the man that made not YAHUAH his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ረዳቱ ያላደረገ፥ በባለጠግነቱም ብዛት የታመነ፥ በከንቱ ነገርም የበረታ ያ ሰው እነሆ።

verses.en: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of YAHUAH: I trust in the mercy of YAHUAH for ever and ever.
verses.am: እኔስ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ለመለመ እንደ ወይራ ዛፍ ነኝ፤ ለዓለምና ለዘላለም በእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት ታመንሁ።

verses.en: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
verses.am: አድርገህልኛልና ለዘላለም አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በቅዱሳንህም ዘንድ መልካም ነውና ስምህን ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, A Psalm of Dawid.] The fool hath said in his heart, There is no YAHUAH. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
verses.am: ሰነፍ በልቡ። አምላክ የለም ይላል። ረከሱ በበደላቸውም ጐሰቈሉ፤ በጎ ነገርን የሚያደርጋት የለም።

verses.en: YAHUAH looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሚያስተውል እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ እንዳለ ያይ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ የሰው ልጆችን ተመለከተ።

verses.en: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.am: ሁሉ በደሉ፥ አብረውም ረከሱ፤ አንድ ስንኳ በጎን ነገር የሚያደርጋት የለም።

verses.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሕዝቤን እንጀራ እንደሚበላ የሚበሉ ግፍ አድራጊዎች ሁሉ አያውቁምን? እግዚአብሔርንም አይጠሩትም።

verses.en: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for YAHUAH hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because YAHUAH hath despised them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የግብዞችን አጥንቶች በትኖአልና። በዚያ የሚያስፈራ ሳይኖር እጅግ ፈሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ንቆአቸዋልና አሳፈርሃቸው።

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Yisra'el were come out of Zion! When YAHUAH bringeth back the captivity of his people, Ya'aqob shall rejoice, and Yisra'el shall be glad.
verses.am: መድኃኒትን ከጽዮን ለእስራኤል ማን በሰጠ! እግዚአብሔር የሕዝቡን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ፥ ያዕቆብ ደስ ይለዋል እስራኤልም ሐሤት ያደርጋል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of Dawid, when the Ziphims came and said to Sha'ul, Doth not Dawid hide himself with us?] Save me, O YAHUAH, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በስምህ አድነኝ፥ በኃይልህም ፍረድልኝ።

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ የአፌንም ቃል አድምጥ፤

verses.en: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set YAHUAH before them. Selah.
verses.am: እንግዶች ቁመውብኛልና፥ ኃያላንም ነፍሴን ሽተዋታልና። እግዚአብሔርን በፊታቸው አላደረጉትም።

verses.en: Behold, YAHUAH is mine helper: YAHUAH is with them that uphold my soul.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛል፥ ጌታዬም ለነፍሴ ደጋፊዋ ነው።

verses.en: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.am: ክፋትን ወደ ጠላቶቼ ይመልሳታል፤ በእውነትህም አጥፋቸው።

verses.en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O YAHUAH; for it is good.
verses.am: ከፈቃዴ እሠዋልሃለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ መልካም ነውና ስምህን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.en: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
verses.am: ከመከራ ሁሉ አድኖኛልና፥ ዓይኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አይታለችና።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of Dawid.] Give ear to my prayer, O YAHUAH; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን አድምጥ፥ ልመናዬንም ቸል አትበል።

verses.en: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.am: ተመልከተኝ ስማኝም። በኀዘኔ ተቅበዘበዝሁ ተናወጥሁም፤

verses.en: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.am: ከጠላት ድምፅ ከዓመፀኛም ግፍ የተነሣ፤ ዓመፃን በላዬ ጥለውብኛልና፥ በቁጣም ጠልተውኛልና።

verses.en: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.am: ልቤ በላዬ ተናወጠብኝ፥ የሞት ድንጋጤም ወደቀብኝ።

verses.en: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.am: ፍርሃትና እንቅጥቅጥ መጡብኝ፥ ጨለማም ሸፈነኝ።

verses.en: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.am: በርሬ ዐርፍ ዘንድ እንደ ርግብ ክንፍን ማን በሰጠኝ!

verses.en: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ኰብልዬ በራቅሁ በምድረ በዳም በተቀመጥሁ፤

verses.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.am: ከዐውሎና ከብርቱ ንፋስ ሸሽቼ በፈጠንሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: Destroy, O YAHUAH, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ግፍንና ጠብን በከተማ ውስጥ አይቼአለሁና አስጥማቸው እንደበታቸውንም ቍረጥ።

verses.en: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.am: በቀንና በሌሊት በቅጥርዋ ይከብቡአታል፤ ዓመፃና ድካም ኃጢአትም በመካከልዋ ነው፤

verses.en: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.am: ተንኰልና ሽንገላ ከአደባባይዋ አይርቁም።

verses.en: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.am: ጠላትስ ቢሰድበኝ፥ በታገሥሁ ነበር፤ የሚጠላኝም ራሱን በላዬ ከፍ ከፍ ቢያደርግ፥ ከእርሱ በተሸሸግሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ እኩያዬ ሰው፥ ባልንጀራዬና የልቤ ወዳጅ፤

verses.en: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of YAHUAH in company.
verses.am: መብልን ከእኔ ጋር በአንድነት ያጣፈጥህ፤ በአንድ ልብ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተራመድን።

verses.en: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.am: ሞት ይምጣባቸው፤ በሕይወት ሳሉ ወደ ሲኦል ይውረዱ፤ ክፋት በማደሪያቸውና በመካከላቸው ነውና።

verses.en: As for me, I will call upon YAHUAH; and YAHUAH shall save me.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማኝ።

verses.en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.am: በማታና በጥዋት በቀትርም እናገራለሁ እጮኽማለሁ፥ ቃሌንም ይሰማኛል።

verses.en: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ ብዙ ነበሩና ከሚቃረቡኝ ነፍሴን በሰላም አድናት።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not YAHUAH.
verses.am: ቤዛ የላቸውምና፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አልፈሩትምና ከጥንት ጀምሮ የነበረ እግዚአብሔር ሰምቶ ያጐሰቍላቸዋል።

verses.en: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር ሰላም በነበሩት ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ ኪዳኑንም አረከሱ።

verses.en: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.am: አፉ ከቅቤ ይልቅ ለዘበ፥ በልቡ ግን ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ ቃሎቹም ከዘይት ይልቅ ለሰለሱ፥ እነርሱ ግን እንደ ተመዘዘ ሰይፍ ናቸው።

verses.en: Cast thy burden upon YAHUAH, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.am: ትካዜህን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ጣል፥ እርሱም ይደግፍሃል፤ ለጻድቁም ለዘላለም ሁከትን አይሰጠውም።

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ወደ ሞት ጕድጓድ ታወርዳቸዋለህ፤ የደም ሰዎችና ሸንጋዮች ዘመናቸው ግማሽ አይሞላም፤ እኔ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ እታመንሃለሁ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of Dawid, when the Philistines took him in Gath.] Be merciful unto me, O YAHUAH: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሰው ረግጦኛልና ማረኝ፤ ሁልጊዜም በሰልፍ አስጨንቆኛል።

verses.en: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.am: የሚዋጉኝ በዝተዋልና ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ጠላቶቼ ረገጡኝ።

verses.en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ፈራሁ በአንተም ታመንሁ።

verses.en: In YAHUAH I will praise his word, in YAHUAH I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቃሉን አመሰግናለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፥ አልፈራም፤ ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?

verses.en: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ ቃሎቼን ያጸይፉብኛል፤ በእኔ ላይም የሚመክሩት ሁሉ ለክፉ ነው።

verses.en: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.am: ይሸምቁብኛል ይሸሽጉኝማል፥ እነርሱም ተረከዜን ይመለካከታሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ነፍሴን ይሸምቁባታል።

verses.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: በምንም ምን አታድናቸውም፤ አሕዛብን በቍጣ ትጥላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ሕይወቴን ነገርሁህ፤ እንባዬን እንደ ትእዛዝህ በፊተህ አኖርህ።

verses.en: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for YAHUAH is for me.
verses.am: በጠራሁህ ጊዜ ጠላቶቼ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሳሉ፤ አንተ አምላኬ እንደ ሆንህ እነሆ፥ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: In YAHUAH will I praise his word: in YAHUAH will I praise his word.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቃሉን አመሰግናለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቃሉን አከብራለሁ።

verses.en: In YAHUAH have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፥ አልፈራም ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?

verses.en: Thy vows are upon me, O YAHUAH: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የምስጋና ስእለት የምሰጥህ ከእኔ ዘንድ ነው፤

verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before YAHUAH in the light of the living?
verses.am: ነፍሴን ከሞት፥ እግሮቼን ከመውደቅ አድነሃልና፥ በሕያዋን ብርሃን እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አሰኘው ዘንድ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of Dawid, when he fled from Sha'ul in the cave.] Be merciful unto me, O YAHUAH, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
verses.am: ማረኝ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረኝ፥ ነፍሴ አንተን ታምናለችና፤ ጉዳት እስክታልፍ ድረስ በክንፎችህ ጥላ እታመናለሁ።

verses.en: I will cry unto YAHUAH most high; unto YAHUAH that performeth all things for me.
verses.am: ወደሚረዳኝ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ልዑል እግዚአብሔር እጮኻለሁ።

verses.en: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. YAHUAH shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.am: ከሰማይ ልኮ አዳነኝ፥ ለረገጡኝም ውርደትን ሰጣቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ቸርነቱንና እውነቱን ላከ።

verses.en: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ከአንበሶች መካከል አዳናት። ደንግጬ ተኛሁ፤ የሰው ልጆች ጥርሳቸው ጦርና ፍላጻ፥ አንደበታቸው የተሳለ ሾተል ነው።

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O YAHUAH, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ክብርህም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ትሁን።

verses.en: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
verses.am: ለእግሮቼ ወጥመድን አዘጋጁ፥ ነፍሴንም አጐበጡአት፤ ጕድጓድ በፊቴ ቈፈሩ፥ በእርሱም ወደቁ።

verses.en: My heart is fixed, O YAHUAH, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.am: ልቤ ጨካኝ ነው፥ አቤቱ፥ ልቤ ጨካኝ ነው፤ እቀኛለሁ፥ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.am: ክብሬ ይነሣ፥ በገናና መሰንቆም ይነሡ፤ እኔም ማልጄ እነሣለሁ።

verses.en: I will praise thee, O YAHUAH, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በወገኖችም ዘንድ እዘምርልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ እስከ ሰማይ ድረስ ከፍ ብላለችና፥ እውነትህም እስከ ደመናት ድረስ።

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O YAHUAH, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ክብርህም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ትሁን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of Dawid.] Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.am: በእውነት ጽድቅን ብትናገሩስ፥ የሰው ልጆች ሆይ፥ በቅን ትፈርዳላችሁ፤

verses.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.am: በልባችሁ በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ትሠራላችሁና፥ እጆቻችሁም ግፍን ይታታሉና።

verses.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.am: ኅጥኣን ከማኅፀን ጀምረው ተለዩ፤ ከሆድም ጀምረው ሳቱ፥ ሐሰትንም ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.am: ቍጣቸው እንደ እባብ መርዝ ነው፥ እንደ ምድር አውሬም ጆሮዋ የተደፈነ ነው፥

verses.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.am: አዋቂ ሲደግምባት የአስማተኛውን ቃል እንደማትሰማ።

verses.en: Break their teeth, O YAHUAH, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጥርሳቸውን በአፋቸው ውስጥ ይሰብራል፤ እግዚአብሔር የአንበሶቹን መንጋጋቸውን ያደቅቃል።

verses.en: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.am: እንደሚፈስስ ውኃ ይቀልጣሉ፤ እስኪያደክማቸው ድረስ ፍላጾቹን ይገትራል።

verses.en: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.am: እንደሚቀልጥ ሰም ያልቃሉ፤ እሳት ወደቀች፥ ፀሐይንም አላዩአትም።

verses.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.am: እሾኻችሁ ሳይታወቅ በትር ሆነ፤ ሕያዋን ሳላችሁ በመዓቱ ይነጥቃችኋል።

verses.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.am: ጻድቅ በቀልን ባየ ጊዜ ደስ ይለዋል፤ በኃጢአተኛው ደምም እጁን ይታጠባል።

verses.en: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a YAHUAH that judgeth in the earth.
verses.am: ሰውም። በእውነት ለጻድቅ ፍሬ አለው፤ በእውነት በምድር ላይ የሚፈርድ አምላክ አለ ይላል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of Dawid; when Sha'ul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.] Deliver me from mine enemies, O my YAHUAH: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ከጠላቶቼ አድነኝ፤ በላዬም ከቆሙት አስጥለኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.am: ከግፍ አድራጊዎች ታደገኝ፥ ከደም ሰዎችም አድነኝ።

verses.en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ነፍሴን ሸምቀውባታልና፥ ብርቱዎችም በላዬ ተሰበሰቡ። አቤቱ፥ በበደሌም አይደለም፥ በኃጢአቴም አይደለም።

verses.en: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.am: ያለ በደል ሮጥሁ ተዘጋጀሁም፤ ተነሥ፥ ተቀበለኝ፥ እይም።

verses.en: Thou therefore, O YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.am: አንተም አቤቱ፥ የኃያላን አምላክ፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ፥ አሕዛብን ሁሉ ትጐበኛቸው ዘንድ ተነሥ፤ ዓመፅ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ አትማራቸው።

verses.en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.am: ማታ ይመለሱ እንደ ውሾችም ይራቡ፥ በከተማም ይዙሩ።

verses.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአፋቸው አሰምተው ይናገራሉ፤ ሰይፍም በከንፈሮቻቸው አለ፤ ማን ይሰማል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.am: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ ትሥቅባቸዋለህ፥ አሕዛብንም ሁሉ ትንቃቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for YAHUAH is my defence.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያዬ ነውና ኃይሌን ወደ አንተ አስጠጋለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH of my mercy shall prevent me: YAHUAH shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.am: የአምላኬ ቸርነቱ ይገናኘኛል አምላኬ በጠላቶቼ ላይ ያሳየኛል።

verses.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O YAHUAH our shield.
verses.am: ሕግህን እንዳይረሱ አትግደላቸው፤ አቤቱ ጋሻዬ፥ በኃይልህ በትናቸው አውርዳቸውም።

verses.en: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.am: ስለ አፋቸው ኃጢአት ስለ ከንፈራቸውም ቃል፥ መርገምንና ሐሰትን ስለሚናገሩ፥ በትዕቢታቸው ይጠመዱ።

verses.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that YAHUAH ruleth in Ya'aqob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.am: በቍጣ አጥፋቸው፥ እንዳይኖሩም አጥፋቸው፤ የያዕቆብም አምላክ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ እንዲገዛ ይወቁ።

verses.en: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.am: ማታ ይመለሱ እንደ ውሾችም ይራቡ፥ በከተማም ይዙሩ።

verses.en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.am: እነርሱም መብል ለመፈለግ ይበተኑ፤ ያልጠገቡ እንደ ሆነም ያንጐረጕራሉ።

verses.en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ለኃይልህ እቀኛለሁ፤ በምሕረትህም ማልዶ ደስ ይለኛል፤ በመከራዬ ቀን መጠጊያዬና አምባዬ ሆነኸኛልና።

verses.en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for YAHUAH is my defence, and YAHUAH of my mercy.
verses.am: ረዳቴ ሆይ፥ ለአንተ ለአምላኬ እዘምራለሁ፤ አንተ፥ አምላኬ፥ መጠጊያዬ ምሕረቴም ነህና።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of Dawid, to teach; when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.] O YAHUAH, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጣልኸን አፈረስኸንም፤ ተቈጣኸን ይቅርም አልኸን።

verses.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.am: ምድርን አናወጥሃት አወክሃትም፤ ተናውጣለችና ቍስልዋን ፈውስ።

verses.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.am: ለሕዝብህ ጭንቅን አሳየሃቸው፥ አስደንጋጩንም ወይን አጠጣኸን።

verses.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.am: ከቀስት ፊት ያመልጡ ዘንድ፥ ለሚፈሩህ ምልክትን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.am: ወዳጆችህ እንዲድኑ በቀኝህ አድን፥ አድምጠኝም።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ተናገረ፤ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሴኬምንም እካፈላለሁ፥ የሱኮትንም ሸለቆ እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Yehudah is my lawgiver;
verses.am: ገለዓድ የእኔ ነው፥ ምናሴም የእኔ ነው፤ ኤፍሬም የራሴ መጠጊያ ነው። ይሁዳ ንጉሤ ነው፤

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.am: ሞዓብ መታጠቢያዬ ነው፥ በኤዶምያስ ላይ ጫማዬን እዘረጋለሁ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ይገዙልኛል።

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.am: ወደ ጽኑ ከተማ ማን ይወስደኛል? ማንስ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ይመራኛል?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O YAHUAH, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O YAHUAH, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የጣልኸን አንተ አይደለህምን? አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከሠራዊታችን ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.am: በመከራችን ረድኤትን ስጠን የሰውም ማዳን ከንቱ ነው።

verses.en: Through YAHUAH we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይልን እናደርጋለን እርሱ የሚያስጨንቁንን ያዋርዳቸዋልና።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Neginah, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear my cry, O YAHUAH; attend unto my prayer.
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ልመናዬን ስማ፥ ጸሎቴንም አድምጥ።

verses.en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.am: ልቤ ተስፋ በቈረጠ ጊዜ ከምድር ዳርቻ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ፤ በድንጋይ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አደረግኸኝ።

verses.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.am: ጽኑ ግንብ በጠላት ፊት ተስፋዬም ሆነኸኛልና መራኸኝ።

verses.en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.am: በድንኳንህ ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ፤ በክንፎችህም ጥላ እጋረዳለሁ፤

verses.en: For thou, O YAHUAH, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ስእለቴን ሰምተሃልና፤ ስምህንም ለሚፈሩ ርስትህን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
verses.am: ለንጉሥ ከቀን በላይ ቀን ትጨምራለህ፥ ዓመታቱም ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: He shall abide before YAHUAH for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ ምሕረትንና እውነትን አዘጋጅለት።

verses.en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ለስምህ ለዘላለም እዘምራለሁ ስእለቴን ሁልጊዜ እፈጽም ዘንድ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Dawid.] Truly my soul waiteth upon YAHUAH: from him cometh my salvation.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ለእግዚአብሔር የምትገዛ አይደለችምን? መድኃኒቴ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ናትና።

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.am: እርሱ አምላኬ መድኃኒቴም ነውና፤ እርሱ መጠጊያዬ ነው፥ እጅግም አልታወክም።

verses.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.am: እስከ መቼ በሰው ላይ ትቆማላችሁ? እናንተ ሁላችሁ እንዳዘነበለ ግድግዳ እንደ ፈረሰም ቅጥር ትገድላላችሁ።

verses.en: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክብሬን ይሽሩ ዘንድ መከሩ፥ ሐሰትንም ይወድዳሉ፤ በአፋቸው ይባርካሉ፥ በልባቸውም ይረግማሉ።

verses.en: My soul, wait thou only upon YAHUAH; for my expectation is from him.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ አንቺ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዢ፥ ተስፋዬ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ናትና።

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.am: እርሱ አምላኬ መድኃኒቴም ነውና፤ እርሱ መጠጊያዬ ነው፤ አልታወክም።

verses.en: In YAHUAH is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in YAHUAH.
verses.am: መድኃኒቴና ክብሬ በእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የረድኤቴ አምላክ ተስፋዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: YAHUAH is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.am: የሕዝብ ማኅበር ሁላችሁ፥ በእርሱ ታመኑ፥ ልባችሁንም በፊቱ አፍስሱ፤ እግዚአብሔር ረዳታችን ነው።

verses.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሰው ልጆች ከንቱ ናቸው፥ የሰው ልጆችም ሐሰተኞች ናቸው፤ በሚዛንም ይበድላሉ፥ እነርሱስ በፍጹም ከንቱ ናቸው።

verses.en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.am: ዓመፃን ተስፋ አታድርጉ፥ ቅሚያንም አትተማመኑት፤ ባለጠግነት ቢበዛ ልባችሁ አይኵራ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አንድ ጊዜ ተናገረ፥ እኔም ይህን ብቻ ሰማሁ፤ ኃይል የእግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.en: Also unto thee, O YAHUAH, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትም ያንተ ነው፤ አንተ ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ ሥራው ፍዳውን ትሰጣለህና።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, when he was in the wilderness of Yehudah.] O YAHUAH, thou art my YAHUAH; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ወደ አንተ እገሠግሣለሁ፤ ነፍሴ አንተን ተጠማች፥ ሥጋዬ አንተን እንዴት ናፈቀች እንጨትና ውኃ በሌለበት በምድረ በዳ።

verses.en: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.am: ኃይልህንና ክብርህን አይ ዘንድ እንዲሁ በመቅደስ ውስጥ ተመለከትሁህ።

verses.en: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ ከሕይወት ይሻላልና ከንፈሮቼ ያመሰግኑሃል።

verses.en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.am: እንዲህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በአንተም ስም እጆቼን አነሣለሁ።

verses.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.am: ነፍሴ በቅቤና በስብ እንደሚጠግቡ ትጠግባለች፥ ከንፈሮቼም ስምህን በደስታ ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.en: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.am: በመኝታዬም አስብሃለሁ፥ በማለዳም እናገርልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.am: ረዳቴ ሆነኸኛልና፥ በክንፎችህም ጥላ ደስ ይለኛልና።

verses.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በኋላህ ተከታተለች፥ እኔንም ቀኝህ ተቀበለችኝ።

verses.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ነፍሴን ለከንቱ ፈለጓት፤ ወደ ምድር ጥልቅ ይገባሉ።

verses.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.am: ለሰይፍ እጅ አልፈው ይሰጣሉ፥ የቀበሮም እድል ፈንታ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: But the king shall rejoice in YAHUAH; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.am: ንጉሥ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለዋል፤ በእርሱ የሚምል ሁሉ ይከብራል፥ ሐሰትን የሚናገር አፍ ይዘጋልና።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear my voice, O YAHUAH, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ በለመንሁ ጊዜ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ ከጠላትም ፍርሃት ነፍሴን አድን።

verses.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.am: ከክፉዎች ሸንጎ ከዓመፀኞችም ብዛት ሰውረኝ።

verses.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.am: እንደ ሰይፍ ምላሳቸውን አሰሉ፤ መራራ ነገርን ለማድረግ፥

verses.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.am: ንጹሕንም በስውር ለመንደፍ ቀስትን ገተሩ፤ ድንገት ይነድፉታል አይፈሩምም።

verses.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.am: ለእነርሱ ለራሳቸው ክፉ ነገርን አጸኑ፤ ወጥመድን ይሰውሩ ዘንድ ተማከሩ፤ ማንስ ያየናል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.am: ዓመፃን ፈልጓት፥ ሲፈትኑም አለቁ፤ የሰው የውስጥ አሳቡና ልቡ የጠለቀ ነው፥

verses.en: But YAHUAH shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከፍ ከፍ ይላል። የድንገትም ፍላጻ፤ ያቈስላቸዋል፤

verses.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.am: አንደበታቸው ያሰናክላቸዋል፥ የሚያዩአቸውም ሁሉ ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of YAHUAH; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.am: ሰዎች ሁሉ ፈሩ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ ተናገሩ፥ ሥራውንም አስተዋሉ።

verses.en: The righteous shall be glad in YAHUAH, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.am: ጻድቅ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለዋል፥ በእርሱም ይታመናል፤ ልባቸውም የቀና ሁሉ እልል ይላሉ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of Dawid.] Praise waiteth for thee, O YAHUAH, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በጽዮን ለአንተ ምስጋና ይገባል፥ ለአንተም ጸሎት ይቀርባል።

verses.en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.am: ሥጋ ሁሉ ጸሎትን ወደምትሰማ ወደ አንተ ይመጣል።

verses.en: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.am: የዓመፃ ነገር በረታብን፤ ኃጢአታችንንስ አንተ ይቅር ትላለህ።

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.am: አንተ የመረጥኸው በአደባባዮችህም ለማደር የተቀበልኸው ምስጉን ነው፤ ከቤትህ በረከት እንጠግባለን።

verses.en: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O YAHUAH of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.am: ቤተ መቅደስህ ቅዱስ ነው በጽድቅም ድንቅ ነው። በምድር ዳርቻ ሁሉና በሩቅ ባሕር ውስጥ ላሉ ተስፋቸው የሆንህ፥ አምላካችንና መድኃኒታችን ሆይ፥ ስማን።

verses.en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.am: በጉልበትህ ተራሮችን አጸናሃቸው፥ በኃይልም ታጥቀሃል።

verses.en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
