verses.am: የባሕሩን ጥልቀት የሞገድንም ጩኸት ታናውጣለህ።

verses.en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.am: ከተአምራትህ የተነሣ አሕዛብ ይደነግጣሉ፥ በምድር ዳርቻም የሚኖሩ ይፈራሉ፤ የጥዋትንና የማታን መውጫ ደስ ታሰኛቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of YAHUAH, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.am: ምድርን ጐበኘሃት አጠጣሃትም፥ ብልጥግናዋንም እጅግ አበዛህ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ወንዝ ውኃን የተመላ ነው፤ ምግባቸውን አዘጋጀህ እንዲሁ ታሰናዳለህና።

verses.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.am: ትልምዋን ታረካለህ፥ ቦይዋንም ታስተካክላለህ፤ በነጠብጣብ ታለሰልሳታለህ፥ ቡቃያዋንም ትባርካለህ።

verses.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.am: በቸርነትህ ዓመትን ታቀዳጃለህ፥ ምድረ በዳውም ስብን ይጠግባል።

verses.en: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.am: የምድረ በዳ ተራሮች ይረካሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም በደስታ ይታጠቃሉ።

verses.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.am: ማሰማርያዎች መንጎችን ለበሱ፥ ሸለቆችም በእህል ተሸፈኑ፤ በደስታ ይጮኻሉ ይዘምራሉም።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Song or Psalm.] Make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH, all ye lands:
verses.am: በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥

verses.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.am: ለስሙም ዘምሩ፥ ለምስጋናውም ክብርን ስጡ።

verses.en: Say unto YAHUAH, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ በሉት። ሥራህ ግሩም ነው፤ ኃይልህ ብዙ ሲሆን ጠላቶች ዋሹብህ።

verses.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.am: በምድር ያሉ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሰግዳሉ፥ ለአንተም ይዘምራሉ፥ ለስምህም ይዘምራሉ።

verses.en: Come and see the works of YAHUAH: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.am: ኑ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እዩ፤ ከሰው ልጆች ይልቅ በምክር ግሩም ነው።

verses.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.am: ባሕርን የብስ አደረጋት፥ ወንዙንም በእግር ተሻገሩ፤ በዚያ በእርሱ ደስ ይለናል።

verses.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.am: በኃይሉ ለዘላለም ይገዛል፤ ዓይኖቹ ወደ አሕዛብ ይመለከታሉ፤ ዓመፀኞች ራሳቸውን ከፍ ከፍ አያድርጉ።

verses.en: O bless our YAHUAH, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ አምላካችንን ባርኩ፥ የምስጋናውንም ድምፅ አሰሙ።

verses.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.am: ነፍሴን በሕይወት ያኖራታል፥ እግሮቼንም ለመናወጥ አልሰጠም።

verses.en: For thou, O YAHUAH, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፈትነኸናልና፥ ብርንም እንደሚያነጥሩት አንጥረኸናልና።

verses.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.am: ወደ ወጥመድ አገባኸን፥ በጀርባችንም መከራን አኖርህ።

verses.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.am: በራሳችን ላይ ሰውን አስረገጥኸን፤ በእሳትና በውኃ መካከል አለፍን፥ ወደ ዕረፍትም አወጣኸን።

verses.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.am: ከዕጣንና ከወጠጤዎች ጋር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ፍሪዳን አቀርባለሁ፤ ላሞችንና ፍየሎችን እሠዋልሃለሁ።

verses.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.am: ከዕጣንና ከወጠጤዎች ጋር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ፍሪዳን አቀርባለሁ፤ ላሞችንና ፍየሎችን እሠዋልሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሁሉ፥ ኑ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ለነፍሴ ያደረገላትን ልንገራችሁ።

verses.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear YAHUAH, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.am: በአፌ ወደ እርሱ ጮኽሁ፥ በአንደበቴም አመሰገንሁት።

verses.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.am: በልቤስ በደልን አይቼ ብሆን ጌታ አይሰማኝም ነበር።

verses.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, YAHUAH will not hear me:
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ሰማኝ፤ የልመናዬን ድምፅ አደመጠ።

verses.en: But verily YAHUAH hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.am: ጸሎቴን ያልከለከለኝ ምሕረቱንም ከእኔ ያላራቀ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
[To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song.] YAHUAH be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይማረን ይባርከንም፥ ፊቱንም በላያችን ያብራ፤

verses.en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ማዳንህን፥ መንገድህንም በምድር እናውቅ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O YAHUAH; let all the people praise thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ያመስግኑህ፥ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመስግኑህ።

verses.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.am: ለአሕዛብ በቅን ትፈርድላቸዋለህና፥ አሕዛብንም በምድር ላይ ትመራለህና አሕዛብ ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሤትም ያድርጉ።

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O YAHUAH; let all the people praise thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ያመስግኑህ፥ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመስግኑህ።

verses.en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and YAHUAH, even our own YAHUAH, shall bless us.
verses.am: ምድር ፍሬዋን ሰጠች፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችንም ይባርከናል።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይባርከናል፥ የምድርም ዳርቻ ሁሉ ይፈሩታል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm or Song of Dawid.] Let YAHUAH arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይነሣ፥ ጠላቶቹም ይበተኑ፥ የሚጠሉትም ከፊቱ ይሽሹ።

verses.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ጢስ እንደሚበንን እንዲሁ ይብነኑ፤ ሰም በእሳት ፊት እንደሚቀልጥ፥ እንዲሁ ኅጥኣን ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይጥፉ።

verses.en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before YAHUAH: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.am: ጻድቃንም ደስ ይበላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሐሤት ያድርጉ፥ በደስታም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ ለስሙም ዘምሩ፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ለወጣም መንገድ አድርጉ፤ ስሙ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በፊቱም ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ በፊቱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is YAHUAH in his holy habitation.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅዱስ ቦታው ለድሀ አደጎች አባት፥ ለባልቴቶችም ዳኛ ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ብቸኞችን በቤት ያሳድራቸዋል፥ እስረኞችንም በኃይሉ ያወጣቸዋል፤ ዓመፀኞች ግን በምድረ በዳ ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሕዝብም ፊት በወጣህ ጊዜ፥ በምድረ በዳም ባለፍህ ጊዜ፥ ምድር ተናወጠች፥

verses.en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of YAHUAH: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of YAHUAH, YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ከሲና አምላክ ፊት፥ ከእስራኤል አምላክ ፊት ሰማያትም አንጠበጠቡ።

verses.en: Thou, O YAHUAH, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሞገስን ዝናብ ለርስትህ አዘነብህ፥ በደከመም ጊዜ አንተ አጸናኸው።

verses.en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O YAHUAH, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.am: እንስሶችህ በውስጡ አደሩ፤ አቤቱ፥ በቸርነትህ ለድሆች አዘጋጀህ።

verses.en: YAHUAH gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቃሉን ሰጠ፤ የሚያወሩት ብዙ ሠራዊት ናቸው።

verses.en: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ነገሥታት ፈጥነው ይሸሻሉ፤ በቤትም የምትኖር ምርኮን ተካፈለች።

verses.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.am: በርስቶች መካከል ብታድሩ፥ ከብር እንደ ተሠሩ እንደ ርግብ ክንፎች፥ በቅጠልያ ወርቅም እንደ ተለበጡ ላባዎችዋ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
verses.am: ሰማያዊ ንጉሥ በላይዋ ባዘዘ ጊዜ፥ በሰልሞን ላይ በረዶ ዘነበ።

verses.en: The hill of YAHUAH is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ተራራ የለመለመ ተራራ ነው፤ የጸና ተራራና የለመለመ ተራራ ነው።

verses.en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which YAHUAH desireth to dwell in; yea, YAHUAH will dwell in it for ever.
verses.am: የጸኑ ተራራዎች ለምን ይነሣሉ? እግዚአብሔር ይህን ተራራ ያድርበት ዘንድ ወደደው፤ በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ያድርበታል።

verses.en: The chariots of YAHUAH are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: YAHUAH is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሰረገላዎች የብዙ ብዙ ሺህ ናቸው፤ ጌታ በመቅደሱ በሲና በመካከላቸው ነው።

verses.en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that YAHUAH might dwell among them.
verses.am: ወደ ላይ ዓረግህ፥ ምርኮን ማረክህ፥ ስጦታንም ለሰዎች ሰጠህ፥ ደግሞም ለዓመፀኞች በዚያ ያድሩ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even YAHUAH of our salvation. Selah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ቡሩክ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር በየዕለቱ ቡሩክ ነው፤ የመድኃኒታችን አምላክ ይረዳናል።

verses.en: He that is our YAHUAH is YAHUAH of salvation; and unto YAHUAH belong the issues from death.
verses.am: አምላካችንስ የደኅንነት አምላክ ነው፤ ከሞት መውጣትም ከእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: But YAHUAH shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር የጠላቶቹን ራስ፥ በኃጢአት የሚሄድንም የጠጕሩን አናት ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.en: YAHUAH said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። ከባሳን አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከባሕርም ጥልቅ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥

verses.en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.am: እግሮችህ በደም ይረገጡ ዘንድ፥ የውሾችህ ምላስ በጠላቶች ላይ ይሆን ዘንድ።

verses.en: They have seen thy goings, O YAHUAH; even the goings of my YAHUAH, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.am: የአምላኬ የንጉሥ መንገድ በመቅደሱ፥ አቤቱ፥ መንገድህ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.am: አለቆች ቀደሙ፥ መዘምራንም ተከተሉ፤ ከበሮን በሚመቱ በቈነጃጅት መካከል።

verses.en: Bless ye YAHUAH in the congregations, even YAHUAH, from the fountain of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በጉባኤ፥ ጌታችንንም በእስራኤል ምንጭ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Yehudah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.am: ወጣቱ ብንያም በጕልበቱ በዚያ አለ፥ ገዦቻቸው የይሁዳ አለቆች የዛብሎን አለቆችና የንፍታሌምም አለቆች።

verses.en: Thy YAHUAH hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O YAHUAH, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃይልህን እዘዝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ይህንም ለእኛ የሠራኸውን አጽናው።

verses.en: Because of thy temple at Yerushalayim shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም ስላለው መቅደስህ ነገሥታት እጅ መንሻን ለአንተ ያመጣሉ።

verses.en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
verses.am: በሸምበቆ ውስጥ ያሉትን አራዊት፥ በአሕዛብ ውስጥ ያሉትን የበሬዎችንና የወይፈኖችን ጉባኤ ገሥጽ፥ እንደ ብር የተፈተኑት አሕዛብ እንዳይዘጉ፤ ሰልፍን የሚወድዱትን አሕዛብን በትናቸው።

verses.en: Princes shall come out of Mitsrayim; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: መኳንንት ከግብጽ ይመጣሉ፤ ኢትዮጵያ እጆችዋን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ትዘረጋለች።

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto YAHUAH; Selah:
verses.am: የምድር ነገሥታት፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ፥ ለጌታም ዘምሩ።

verses.en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
verses.am: በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ሰማየ ሰማያት ለወጣ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፤ የኃይል ቃል የሆነ ቃሉን፥ እነሆ፥ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: Ascribe ye strength unto YAHUAH: his excellency is over Yisra'el, and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ክብርን ስጡ፤ ግርማው በእስራኤል ላይ፥ ኃይሉም በደመናት ላይ ነው።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: YAHUAH of Yisra'el is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅዱሳኑ ላይ ድንቅ ነው፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እርሱ ኃይልን ብርታትንም ለሕዝቡ ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይመስገን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, A Psalm of Dawid.] Save me, O YAHUAH; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ውኃ እስከ ነፍሴ ደርሶብኛልና አድነኝ።

verses.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.am: በጥልቅ ረግረግ ጠለቅሁ መቋሚያም የለኝም። ወደ ጥልቅ ባሕር ገባሁ ማዕበልም አሰጠመኝ።

verses.en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my YAHUAH.
verses.am: በጩኸት ደከምሁ ጕሮሮዬም ሰለለ፤ አምላኬን ስጠብቅ ዓይኖቼ ፈዘዙ።

verses.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.am: በከንቱ የሚጠሉኝ ከራሴ ጠጕር በዙ፤ በዓመፅ ያሚያሳድዱኝ ጠላቶቼ በረቱ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ ያልቀማሁትን መለስሁ።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ስንፍናዬን ታውቃለህ፥ ኃጢአቴም ከአንተ አልተሰወረም።

verses.en: Let not them that wait on thee, O YAHUAH of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: አቤቱ የሠራዊት አምላክ፥ ተስፋ የሚያደርጉህ በእኔ አይፈሩ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ የሚሹህ በእኔ አይነወሩ።

verses.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.am: ስለ አንተ ስድብን ታግሻለሁና፥ እፍረትም ፊቴን ሸፍናለችና።

verses.en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
verses.am: ለወንድሞቼ እንደ ሌላ፥ ለእናቴ ልጆችም እንደ እንግዳ ሆንሁባቸው፥

verses.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.am: የቤትህ ቅንዓት በልታኛለችና፥ የሚሰድቡህም ስድብ በላዬ ወድቆአልና።

verses.en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.am: ነፍሴን በጾም አስመረርሁአት፥ ለስድብም ሆነብኝ።

verses.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.am: ማቅ ለበስሁ ምሳሌም ሆንሁላቸው።

verses.en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.am: በደጅ የሚቀመጡ በእኔ ይጫወታሉ፤ ወይን የሚጠጡ እኔን ይዘፍናሉ።

verses.en: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O YAHUAH, in an acceptable time: O YAHUAH, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በመልካሙ ጊዜ ጸሎቴ ወደ አንተ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ በምሕረትህ ብዛት በማዳንህም እውነት አድምጠኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.am: እንዳይውጠኝ ከረግረግ አውጣኝ፤ ከሚጠሉኝና ከጥልቅ ውኃ አስጥለኝ።

verses.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.am: የውኃው ማዕበል አያስጥመኝ፥ ጥልቁም አይዋጠኝ፥ ጕድጓድም አፉን በእኔ ላይ አይዝጋ።

verses.en: Hear me, O YAHUAH; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ መልካም ናትና ስማኝ። እንደ ርኅራኄህም ብዛት ወደ እኔ ተመልከት፤

verses.en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.am: ከባሪያህም ፊትህን አትሰውር፤ ተጨንቄአለሁና ፈጥነህ አድምጠኝ።

verses.en: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ተመልክተህ ተቤዣት፤ ስለ ጠላቶቼም አድነኝ።

verses.en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.am: አንተ ስድቤን እፍረቴንም ነውሬንም ታውቃለህ፤ የሚያስጨንቁኝ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ስድብንና ኃሣርን ታገሠች፤ አስተዛዛኝም ተመኘሁ አላገኘሁም። የሚያጽናናኝም አጣሁ።

verses.en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.am: ለመብሌ ሐሞት ሰጡኝ፥ ለጥማቴም ሆምጣጤ አጠጡኝ።

verses.en: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.am: ማዕዳቸው በፊታቸው ለወጥመድ ለፍዳ ለዕንቅፋት ትሁንባቸው፤

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.am: ዓይኖቻቸው እንዳያዩ ይጨልሙ፥ ጀርባቸውም ዘወትር ይጕበጥ።

verses.en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.am: መዓትህን በላያቸው አፍስስ፥ የቍጣህ መቅሠፍትም ያግኛቸው።

verses.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.am: ማደሪያቸው በረሃ ትሁን፥ በድንኳኖቻቸውም የሚቀመጥ አይገኝ፤

verses.en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.am: አንተ የቀሠፍኸውን እነርሱ አሳድደዋልና፥ በቍስሌም ላይ ጥዝጣዜ ጨመሩብኝ።

verses.en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.am: በኃጢአታቸው ላይ ኃጢአትን ጨምርባቸው፥ በጽድቅህም አይግቡ።

verses.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.am: ከሕያዋን መጽሐፍ ይደምሰሱ፥ ከጻድቃንም ጋር አይጻፉ።

verses.en: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O YAHUAH, set me up on high.
verses.am: እኔ ችግረኛና ቍስለኛ ነኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ የፊትህ መድኃኒት ይቀበለኝ።

verses.en: I will praise the name of YAHUAH with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም በዝማሬ አመሰግናለሁ፥ በምስጋናም ከፍ ከፍ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: This also shall please YAHUAH better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.am: ቀንድና ጥፍር ካበቀለ ከእምቦሳ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.en: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: ችግረኞች ያያሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉ ሕያዋንም ሁኑ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ችግረኞችን ሰምቶአልና፥ እስረኞቹንም አልናቀምና።

verses.en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.am: ሰማይና ምድር ባሕርም በእርስዋም የሚንቀሳቀስ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑታል።

verses.en: For YAHUAH will save Zion, and will build the cities of Yehudah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ያድናታልና፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ይሠራልና፤ በዚያም ይቀመጣሉ ይወርሱአትማል።

verses.en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.am: የባሪያዎቹ ዘር ይኖሩባታል። ስሙንም የሚወድዱ በዚያ ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid, to bring to remembrance.] Make haste, O YAHUAH, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለማዳን ተመልከት፤ አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.am: ነፍሴን የሚሹአት ይፈሩ ይጐስቍሉም፥ ክፉንም የሚመክሩብኝ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ ይፈሩም።

verses.en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.am: እንኳ እንኳ የሚሉኝ አፍረው ወዲያው ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let YAHUAH be magnified.
verses.am: የሚሹህ ሁሉ በአንተ ሐሤት ያድርጉ ደስ ይበላቸው፤ ማዳንህን የሚወድዱ ሁልጊዜ። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው ይበሉ።

verses.en: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O YAHUAH: thou art my help and my deliverer; O YAHUAH, make no tarrying.
verses.am: እኔ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ እርዳኝ፤ ረዳቴ ታዳጊዬም አንተ ነህ፤ አቤቱ፥ አትዘግይ።

verses.en: In thee, O YAHUAH, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘላለም አልፈር።

verses.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.am: በጽድቅህ አስጥለኝ ታደገኝም፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል አድነኝም።

verses.en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.am: በጠንካራ ቦታ ታድነኝ ዘንድ አምላክና መሸሸጊያ ሁነኝ፤ ኃይሌ መጠጊያዬ አንተ ነህና።

verses.en: Deliver me, O my YAHUAH, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ ከኃጢአተኛ እጅ፥ ከዓመፀኛና ከግፈኛም እጅ አድነኝ።

verses.en: For thou art my hope, O YAHUAH: thou art my trust from my youth.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህና፥ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምረህ መታመኛዬ ነህና።

verses.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
verses.am: ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ተደገፍሁ፥ ከእናቴም ሆድ ጀምሮ አንተ መሸሸጊያዬ ነህ፤ ሁልጊዜም ዝማሬዬ ለአንተ ነው።

verses.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
verses.am: ለብዙዎች መደነቂያ ሆንሁ፤ አንተ ግን ብርቱ መጠጊያዬ ነህ።

verses.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
verses.am: አፌን ምስጋና ምላ ሁልጊዜ ክብርህንና ግርማህን እዘምር ዘንድ።

verses.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.am: በእርጅናዬ ዘመን አትጣለኝ፥ ጕልበቴም ባለቀ ጊዜ አትተወኝ።

verses.en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.am: ጠላቶቹ በላዬ ተናግረዋልና፤ ነፍሴንም የሚሹአት በአንድነት ተማክረዋልና፥ እንዲህም አሉ።

verses.en: Saying, YAHUAH hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ትቶታል፤ የሚያድነው የለምና ተከትላችሁ ያዙት።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, be not far from me: O my YAHUAH, make haste for my help.
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.am: ነፍሴን የሚቃወሙአት ይፈሩ ይጥፉም፥ ጕዳቴንም የሚፈልጉ እፍረትንና ኃሣርን ይልበሱ።

verses.en: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ፥ በምስጋናህም ሁሉ ላይ እጨምራለሁ።

verses.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.am: ሥራን አላውቅምና አፌ ጽድቅህን ሁልጊዜም ማዳንህን ይናገራል።

verses.en: I will go in the strength of YAHUAH: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል እገባለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ ጽድቅህን ብቻ አስባለሁ።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምረህ አስተማርኸኝ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ተአምራትህን እነግራለሁ።

verses.en: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O YAHUAH, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
verses.am: እስካረጅም እስክሸመግልም ድረስ፥ ለሚመጣ ትውልድም ሁሉ ክንድህን ኃይልህንም ጽድቅህንም እስክነግር ድረስ፥ አቤቱ፥ አትተወኝ።

verses.en: Thy righteousness also, O YAHUAH, is very high, who hast done great things: O YAHUAH, who is like unto thee!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ አርያም ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አደረግህ፤ አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.am: ብዙ ጭንቀትንና መከራን አሳይተኸኛልና፥ ተመለስህ ሕያውም አደረግኸኝ፤ ከምድር ጥልቅም እንደ ገና አወጣኸኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.am: ጽድቅህንም አብዛው፥ ተመልሰህም ደስ አሰኘኝ፥ ከጥልቅም እንደ ገና አወጣኸኝ።

verses.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my YAHUAH: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እኔም በበገና ስለ እውነትህ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ አምላክ ሆይ፥ በመሰንቆ እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.am: ዝማሬን ባቀርብሁልህ ጊዜ ከንፈሮቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ አንተ ያዳንሃትም ነፍሴ።

verses.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.am: ጕዳቴን የሚሹ ባፈሩና በተነወሩ ጊዜ አንደበቴ ደግሞ ሁልጊዜ ጽድቅህን ይናገራል።

verses.en: [A Psalm for Shelomoh.] Give the king thy judgments, O YAHUAH, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍርድህን ለንጉሥ ስጥ፥ ጽድቅህንም ለንጉሥ ልጅ፥

verses.en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን በጽድቅ፥ ችግረኞችህንም በፍርድ ይዳኝ ዘንድ።

verses.en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.am: ተራሮችና ኰረብቶች ለሕዝብህ ሰላምን ይቀበሉ።

verses.en: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.am: ለችግረኞች ሕዝብ በጽድቅ ትፈርዳለህ የድሆችንም ልጆች ታድናለህ፤ ክፉውንም ታዋርደዋለህ።

verses.en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.am: ፀሐይ በሚኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ፥ በጨረቃም ፊት ለፊት ለልጅ ልጅ ይኖራል።

verses.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.am: እንደ ዝናብ በታጨደ መስክ ላይ፥ በምድርም ላይ እንደሚንጠባጠብ ጠብታ ይወርዳል።

verses.en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.am: በዘመኑም ጽድቅ ያብባል፥ ጨረቃም እስኪያልፍ ድረስ ሰላም ብዙ ነው።

verses.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.am: ከባሕር እስከ ባሕር ድረስ፥ ከወንዝም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ይገዛል።

verses.en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.am: በፊቱም ኢትዮጵያ ይሰግዳሉ፥ ጠላቶቹም አፈር ይልሳሉ።

verses.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.am: የተርሴስና የደሴቶች ነገሥታት ስጦታን ያመጣሉ፤ የዓረብና የሳባ ነገሥታት እጅ መንሻን ያቀርባሉ።

verses.en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.am: ነገሥታት ሁሉ ይሰግዱለታል። አሕዛብም ሁሉ ይገዙለታል።

verses.en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.am: ችግረኛውን ከቀማኛው እጅ፥ ረዳት የሌለውንም ምስኪን ያድነዋልና።

verses.en: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.am: ለችግረኛና ለምስኪን ይራራል፥ የችግረኞችንም ነፍስ ያድናል።

verses.en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.am: ከግፍና ከጭንቀት ነፍሳቸውን ያድናል፤ ስማቸው በፊቱ ክቡር ነው።

verses.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.am: እርሱ ይኖራል ከዓረብም ወርቅ ይሰጡታል፤ ሁልጊዜም ወደ እርሱ ይጸልያሉ፥ ዘወትርም ይባርኩታል።

verses.en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.am: በምድር ውስጥ በተራሮች ላይ መጠጊያ ይሆናል፤ ፍሬውም ከሊባኖስ ይልቅ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ እንደ ምድር ሣር በከተማ ይበቅላል።

verses.en: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.am: ስሙ ለዘላለም ቡሩክ ይሆናል፥ ከፀሐይም አስቀድሞ ስሙ ይኖራል፤ የምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ በእርሱ ይባረካሉም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑታል።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.am: ብቻውን ተአምራትን የሚያደርግ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.en: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.am: የምስጋናው ስም ለዓለምና ለዘላለም ይባረክ፤ ምስጋናውም ምድርን ሁሉ ይምላ። ይሁን፤ ይሁን።

verses.en: The prayers of Dawid the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.am: የእሴይ ልጅ የዳዊት መዝሙር ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Asaph.] Truly YAHUAH is good to Yisra'el, even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.am: ልባቸው ለቀና ለእስራኤል እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ቸር ነው።

verses.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እግሮቼ ሊሰናከሉ፥ አረማመዴም ሊወድቅ ትንሽ ቀረ።

verses.en: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.am: የኃጢአተኞችን ሰላም አይቼ በዓመፀኞች ቀንቼ ነበርና።

verses.en: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
verses.am: ለሞታቸው መጣጣር የለውምና፤ ኃይላቸውም ጠንካራ ነውና።

verses.en: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.am: እንደ ሰው በድካም አልሆኑም፥ ከሰው ጋርም አልተገረፉም።

verses.en: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ትዕቢት ያዛቸው፤ ኃጢአትንና በደልን ተጐናጸፉአት።

verses.en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.am: ዓይናቸው ስብ ስለ ሆነ ወጣ፤ ልባቸውም ከምኞታቸው ይልቅ አገኘ።

verses.en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.am: አስበው ክፉ ነገርን ተናገሩ። ከፍ ከፍ ብለውም በዓመፃ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.am: አፋቸውን በሰማይ አኖሩ፥ አንደበታቸውም በምድር ውስጥ ተመላለሰ።

verses.en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሕዝቤ ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ፤ ፍጹም ጊዜም በላያቸው ይገኛል፤

verses.en: And they say, How doth YAHUAH know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ያውቃል? በልዑልስ ዘንድ በውኑ እውቀት አለ? ይላሉ።

verses.en: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ ኃጢአተኞች ይደሰታሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ባለጠግነታቸውን ያበዛሉ።

verses.en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.am: እንዲህም አልሁ። በውኑ ልቤን በከንቱ አጸደቅሁ፥ እጆቼንም በንጽሕና በከንቱ አጠብሁ።

verses.en: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜም የተገረፍሁ ሆንሁ፥ መሰደቤም በማለዳ ነው።

verses.en: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ብዬ ብናገር ኖሮ፥ እነሆ፥ የልጆችህን ትውልድ በበደልሁ ነበር።

verses.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
verses.am: አውቅም ዘንድ አሰብሁ፥ ይህ ግን በፊቴ ችግር ነበረ።

verses.en: Until I went into the sanctuary of YAHUAH; then understood I their end.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅደስ እስክገባ ድረስ፥ ፍጻሜአቸውንም እስካስተውል ድረስ።

verses.en: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.am: በድጥ ስፍራ አስቀመጥኻቸው፥ ወደ ጥፋትም ጣልኻቸው።

verses.en: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.am: እንዴት ለጥፋት ሆኑ! በድንገት አለቁ ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም ጠፉ።

verses.en: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O YAHUAH, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.am: ከሕልም እንደሚነቃ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስትነቃ ምልክታቸውን ታስነውራለህ።

verses.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.am: ልቤ ነድዶአልና፥ ኵላሊቴም ቀልጦአልና፤

verses.en: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
verses.am: እኔ የተናቅሁ ነኝ አላውቅሁምም፥ በአንተ ዘንድም እንደ እንስሳ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ዘወትር ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፥ ቀኝ እጄንም ያዝኸኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.am: በአንተ ምክር መራኸኝ፤ ከክብር ጋር ተቀበልኸኝ።

verses.en: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
verses.am: በሰማይ ያለኝ ምንድር ነው? በምድርስ ውስጥ ከአንተ ዘንድ ምን እሻለሁ?

verses.en: My flesh and my heart faileth: but YAHUAH is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.am: የልቤ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ልቤና ሥጋዬ አለቀ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታዬ ነው።

verses.en: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከአንተ የሚርቁ ይጠፋሉና ከአንተ ርቀው የሚያመነዝሩትንም ሁሉ አጠፋኻቸው።

verses.en: But it is good for me to draw near to YAHUAH: I have put my trust in YAHUAH, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.am: ለእኔ ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅረብ ይሻለኛል፤ መታመኛዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው በጽዮን ልጅ በሮች ምስጋናህን ሁሉ እናገር ዘንድ።

verses.en: [Maschil of Asaph.] O YAHUAH, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ምን ለዘወትር ጣልኸኝ? በማሰማርያህ በጎች ላይስ ቍጣህን ስለ ምን ተቈጣህ?

verses.en: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.am: አስቀድመህ የፈጠርሃትን ማኅበርህን፥ የተቤዤሃትንም የርስትህን በትር፥ በእርስዋ ያደርህባትን የጽዮንን ተራራ አስብ።

verses.en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.am: ጠላት በቅዱሳንህ ላይ እንደ ከፋ መጠን፥ ሁልጊዜም በትዕቢታቸው ላይ እጅህን አንሣ።

verses.en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.am: ጠላቶችህ በበዓል መካከል ተመኩ፤ የማያውቁትንም ምልክት ምልክታቸው አደረጉ።

verses.en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.am: እንደ ላይኛው መግቢያ ውስጥ በዱር እንዳሉም እንጨቶች፥ በመጥረቢያ በሮችዋን ሰበሩ።

verses.en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.am: እንዲሁ በመጥረቢያና በመዶሻ ሰበሩአት።

verses.en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.am: መቅደስህን በእሳት አቃጠሉ፤ የስምህንም ማደሪያ በምድር ውስጥ አረከሱ።

verses.en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of YAHUAH in the land.
verses.am: አንድ ሆነው በልባቸው በየሕዝባቸው። ኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን በዓሎች ከምድር እንሻር አሉ።

verses.en: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.am: ምልክታችንን አናይም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ነቢይ የለም፤ እስከ መቼ እንዲኖር የሚያውቅ በኛ ዘንድ የለም።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጠላት እስከ መቼ ይሳደባል? ስምህን ጠላት ሁልጊዜ ያቃልላልን?

verses.en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
verses.am: ቀኝህንም በብብትህ መካከል፥ እጅህንም ፈጽመህ ለምን ትመልሳለህ?

verses.en: For YAHUAH is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ከዓለም አስቀድሞ ንጉሥ ነው፥ በምድርም መካከል መድኃኒትን አደረገ።

verses.en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.am: አንተ ባሕርን በኃይልህ አጸናሃት፤ አንተ የእባቦችን ራስ በውኃ ውስጥ ሰበርህ።

verses.en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.am: አንተም የዘንዶውን ራሶች ቀጠቀጥህ፤ ለኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ምግባቸውን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.am: አንተ ምንጮቹንና ፈሳሾቹን ሰነጠቅህ፤ አንተ ሁልጊዜ የሚፈስሱትን ወንዞች አደረቅህ።

verses.en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.am: ቀኑ የአንተ ነው ሌሊቱም የአንተ ነው፤ አንተ ፀሓዩንና ጨረቃውን አዘጋጀህ።

verses.en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.am: አንተ የምድርን ዳርቻ ሁሉ ሠራህ፤ በጋንም ክረምትንም አንተ አደረግህ።

verses.en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O YAHUAH, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.am: ይህን ፍጥረትህን አስብ። ጠላት እግዚአብሔርን ተላገደ፥ ሰነፍ ሕዝብም ስሙን አስቈጣ።

verses.en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.am: የምትገዛልህን ነፍስ ለአራዊት አትስጣት፤ የችግረኞችህን ነፍስ ለዘወትር አትርሳ።

verses.en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.am: ወደ ኪዳንህ ተመልከት፥ የምድር የጨለማ ስፍራዎች በኅጥኣን ቤቶች ተሞልተዋልና።

verses.en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.am: ችግረኛ አፍሮ አይመለስ፤ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ስምህን ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ በቀልህንም ተበቀል፤ ሰነፎች ሁልጊዜም የተላገዱህን አስብ።

verses.en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.am: የባሪያዎችህን ቃል አትርሳ፤ የጠላቶችህ ኵራት ሁልጊዜ ወደ አንተ ይወጣል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm or Song of Asaph.] Unto thee, O YAHUAH, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እናመሰግንሃለን እናመሰግንሃለን ስምህንም እንጠራለን፤ ተኣምራትህን ሁሉ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.am: ጊዜውን ስቀበል እኔ በቅን እፈርዳለሁ።

verses.en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.am: ምድርና በእርስዋ ውስጥ የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ቀለጡ፥ እኔም ምሰሶችዋን አጠናሁ።

verses.en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.am: ዓመፀኞችን። አትበድሉ አልኋቸው፥ ኃጢአተኞችንም። ቀንዳችሁን አታንሡ፤

verses.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.am: ቀንዳችሁን እስከ ላይ አታንሡ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ዓመፅን አትናገሩ።

verses.en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.am: ክብር ከምሥራቅ ወይም ከምዕራብ ወይም ከምድረ በዳ የለምና፤

verses.en: But YAHUAH is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፈራጅ ነውና ይህን ያዋርዳል ይህንም ያከብራል።

verses.en: For in the hand of YAHUAH there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.am: ጽዋ በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ነውና፤ ያልተቀላቀለ የወይን ጠጅ ሞላበት፤ ከዚህ ወደዚያ አገላበጠው፥ ነገር ግን አተላው አልፈሰሰም፤ የምድር ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ ይጠጡታል።

verses.en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ለዘላለም ደስ ይለኛል፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ ዝማሬን አቀርባለሁ።

verses.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.am: የኅጥኣንን ቀንዶች ሁሉ እሰብራለሁ፤ የጻድቃን ቀንዶች ግን ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song of Asaph.] In Yehudah is YAHUAH known: his name is great in Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በይሁዳ ታወቀ፥ ስሙም በእስራኤል ታላቅ ነው።

verses.en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.am: ስፍራው በሳሌም፥ ማደሪያውም በጽዮን ነው።

verses.en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.am: በዚያም የቀስትን ኃይል፥ ጋሻን ሰይፍን ሰልፍንም ሰበረ፤ በዚያም ቀንዶችን ሰበረ።

verses.en: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.am: አንተ በዘላለም ተራሮች ሆነህ በድንቅ ታበራለህ።

verses.en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.am: ልበ ሰነፎች ሁሉ ደነገጡ፥ እንቅልፋቸውንም አንቀላፉ፤ ባለጠጎች ሁሉ በእነርሱ እጅ ምንም አላገኙም።

verses.en: At thy rebuke, O YAHUAH of Ya'aqob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከተግሣጽህ የተነሣ ፈረሰኞች ሁሉ አንቀላፉ።

verses.en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አንተ ግሩም ነህ፤ ቍጣህን ማን ይቃወማል?

verses.en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.am: ፍርድን ከሰማይ አሰማህ፤ ምድር ፈራች ዝምም አለች፥

verses.en: When YAHUAH arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.am: ልበ የዋሃን ያድን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ለፍርድ በተነሣ ጊዜ።

verses.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.am: ሰው በፈቃዱ ያመሰግንሃልና፥ ከሕሊናቸው ትርፍም በዓልህን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: Vow, and pay unto YAHUAH your YAHUAH: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.am: ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለትን ክፈሉ፤ በዙሪያው ያሉ ሁሉ እጅ መንሻን ለሚያስፈራው ያገባሉ።

verses.en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.am: የመኳንንትን ነፍስ ያወጣል፤ በምድርም ነገሥታት ዘንድ ያስፈራል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.] I cried unto YAHUAH with my voice, even unto YAHUAH with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.am: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ ቃሌም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ እርሱም አደመጠኝ።

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I sought YAHUAH: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን እግዚአብሔርን ፈለግሁት፤ እጆቼ በሌሊት በፊቱ ናቸው፥ አላረፍሁምም፥ ነፍሴም መጽናናትን አልቻለችም።

verses.en: I remembered YAHUAH, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አሰብሁት ደስ አለኝም፤ ተናገርሁ፥ ነፍሴም ፈዘዘች።

verses.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼ እንዲተጉ ያዝሃቸው፤ ደነገጥሁ አልተናገርሁም።

verses.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.am: የዱሮውን ዘመን አሰብሁ፤ የዘላለሙን ዓመታት አሰብሁ፤ አጠናጠንሁም

verses.en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.am: በሌሊት ከልቤ ጋር ተጫወትሁ፥ ነፍሴንም አነቃቃኋት።

verses.en: Will YAHUAH cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይጥላልን? እንግዲህስ ቸርነቱን አይጨምርምን?

verses.en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.am: ለዘላለምስ ምሕረቱ ለልጅ ልጅ ተቈረጠችን? የተናገረውስ ቃል አልቆአልን?

verses.en: Hath YAHUAH forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርስ ሞገሱን ረሳን? በቍጣውስ ምሕረቱን ዘጋውን?

verses.en: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.am: ይህ ድካሜ ነው አልሁ፥ የልዑል ቀኝ እንደ ተለወጠ።

verses.en: I will remember the works of YAHUAH: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ አስታወስሁ፤ የቀደመውን ተአምራትህን አስታወሳለሁና፤

verses.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.am: በምግባርህም ሁሉ እናገራለሁ፥ በሥራህም እጫወታለሁ።

verses.en: Thy way, O YAHUAH, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a YAHUAH as our YAHUAH?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህ በመቅደስ ውስጥ ነው፤ እንደ አምላካችን ያለ ታላቅ አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thou art YAHUAH that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.am: ተኣምራትን የምታደርግ አምላክ አንተ ነህ። ለሕዝብህ ኃይልን አስታወቅሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Ya'aqob and Yoseph. Selah.
verses.am: የያዕቆብንና የዮሴፍን ልጆች፥ ሕዝብህን በክንድህ አዳንሃቸው።

verses.en: The waters saw thee, O YAHUAH, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ውኆች አዩህ፥ ውኆችም አይተውህ ፈሩ፤ ጥልቆች ተነዋወጡ፥ ውኆችም ጮኹ።

verses.en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.am: ደመኖች ድምፅን ሰጡ፥ ፍላጾችህም ወጡ።

verses.en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.am: የነጐድጓድህ ድምፅ በዐውሎ ነበረ፤ መብረቆች ለዓለም አበሩ፤ ምድር ተናወጠች ተንቀጠቀጠችም።

verses.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.am: መንገድህ በባህር ውስጥ ነው፥ ፍለጋህም በብዙ ውኆች ነው፥ አረማመድህም አልታወቀም።

verses.en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Mosheh and Aaron.
verses.am: በሙሴና በአሮን እጅ ሕዝብህን እንደ በጎች መራሃቸው።

verses.en: [Maschil of Asaph.] Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ሕጌን አድምጡ፤ ጆሮአችሁንም ወደ አፌ ቃል አዘንብሉ።

verses.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.am: አፌን በምሳሌ እከፍታለሁ፤ ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ፥ ያለውንም ተምሳሊት እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.am: የሰማነውንና ያውቅነውን፥ አባቶቻችንም የነገሩንን፥ ለሚመጣ ትውልድ ከልጆቻቸው አልሰወሩም።

verses.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of YAHUAH, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋናና ኃይሉን ያደረገውንም ተኣምራት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: For he established a testimony in Ya'aqob, and appointed a law in Yisra'el, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.am: ለልጆቻቸው ያስታውቅ ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን ያዘዘውን ምስክር በያዕቆብ አቆመ፥ በእስራኤልም ሕግን ሠራ፤

verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.am: የሚመጣ፥ ትውልድ የሚወለዱም ልጆች ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ ተነሥተው ለልጆቻቸው ይነግራሉ፤

verses.en: That they might set their hope in YAHUAH, and not forget the works of YAHUAH, but keep his commandments:
verses.am: ተስፋቸውን በእግዚአብሔር እንዲያደርጉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እንዳይረሱ፥ ትእዛዙንም እንዲጠብቁ፤

verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንደ አባቶቻቸው እንዳይሆኑ ጠማማና የምታስመርር ትውልድ፥ ልብዋን ያላቀናች ትውልድ፥ ነፍስዋ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያልታመነች።

verses.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.am: የኤፍሬም ልጆች ለሰልፍ ታጥቀው ቀስትንም ገትረው በሰልፍ ቀን ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: They kept not the covenant of YAHUAH, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ኪዳን አልጠበቁም፥ በሕጉም ለመመላለስ እንቢ አሉ፤

verses.en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.am: መልካም ሥራውንና ያሳያቸውን ተኣምራቱን ረሱ፥

verses.en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Mitsrayim, in the field of Zoan.
verses.am: በግብጽ አገርና በጣኔዎስ በረሃ በአባቶቻቸው ፊት የሠራውን ተኣምራት።

verses.en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.am: ባሕርን ከፍሎ አሳለፋቸው፤ ውኆችን እንደ ክምር አቆመ።

verses.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.am: ቀን በደመና መራቸው፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ በእሳት ብርሃን።

verses.en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.am: ዓለቱን በምድረ በዳ ሰነጠቀ፤ ከጥልቅ እንደሚገኝ ያህል በብዙ አጠጣቸው።

verses.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.am: ውኃን ከጭንጫ አወጣ፥ ውኃንም እንደ ወንዞች አፈሰሰ።

verses.en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይበድሉት ዘንድ እንደ ገና ደገሙ፥ ልዑልንም በምድረ በዳ አስቈጡት።

verses.en: And they tempted YAHUAH in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.am: ለነፍሳቸው መብልን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን በልባቸው ፈተኑት።

verses.en: Yea, they spake against YAHUAH; they said, Can YAHUAH furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ ብለው አሙት። እግዚአብሔር በምድረ በዳ ማዕድን ያሰናዳ ዘንድ ይችላልን?

verses.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.am: ዓለቱን መታ፤ ውኆችም ወጡ፥ ወንዞችም ጐረፉ፤ እንጀራን መስጠትስ ይችላልን? ለሕዝቡስ ማዕድን ያዘጋጃልን?

verses.en: Therefore YAHUAH heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Ya'aqob, and anger also came up against Yisra'el;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ በያዕቆብም ላይ እሳት ነደደ፥ መዓትም በእስራኤል ላይ መጣ፤

verses.en: Because they believed not in YAHUAH, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር አላመኑምና፥ በመድኃኒቱም አልተማመኑምና።

verses.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.am: ደመናውንም ከላይ አዘዘ፥ የሰማይንም ደጆች ከፈተ፤

verses.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.am: ይበሉም ዘንድ መናን አዘነበላቸው፥ የሰማይንም እንጀራ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.am: የመላክትንም እንጀራ ሰው በላ ስንቅንም እስኪተርፋቸው ላከላቸው።

verses.en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.am: ከሰማይ የምሥራቅን ነፋስ አስነሣ፥ በኃይሉም የደቡብን ነፋስ አመጣ፤

verses.en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.am: ሥጋን እንደ አፈር፥ የሚበርሩትንም ወፎች እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ አዘነበላቸው፤

verses.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.am: በሰፈራቸው መካከል፥ በድንኳናቸውም ዙሪያ ወደቀ።

verses.en: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.am: በሉ እጅግም ጠገቡ፤ ምኞታቸውንም ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.am: ከወደዱትም አላሳጣቸውም፤ መብላቸውም ገና በአፋቸው ሳለ፥

verses.en: The wrath of YAHUAH came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Yisra'el.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በላያቸው መጣ፥ ከእነርሱም ከፍ ያሉትን ገደለ፥ የእስራኤልንም ምርጦች አሰናከለ።

verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር እንደ ገና በደሉ፥ ተኣምራቱንም አላመኑም፤

verses.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.am: ቀኖቻቸውም በከንቱ አለቁ፥ ዓመቶቻቸውም በችኰላ።

verses.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after YAHUAH.
verses.am: በገደላቸውም ጊዜ ወዲያው ፈለጉት፤ ተመለሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ገሠገሡ፤

verses.en: And they remembered that YAHUAH was their rock, and the high YAHUAH their redeemer.
verses.am: ረዳታቸውም እግዚአብሔር፥ መድኃኒታቸውም ልዑል አምላክ እንደ ሆነ አሰቡ።

verses.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መሓሪ ነው፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር አላቸው፥ አላጠፋቸውምም፤ ቍጣውንም መመለስ አበዛ፥ መዓቱንም ሁሉ አላቃጠለም።

verses.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መሓሪ ነው፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር አላቸው፥ አላጠፋቸውምም፤ ቍጣውንም መመለስ አበዛ፥ መዓቱንም ሁሉ አላቃጠለም።

verses.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.am: ወጥቶ የማይመለስ መንፈስ፥ ሥጋም እንደ ሆኑ አሰበ።

verses.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ምን ያህል አስቈጡት፥ በበረሃም አሳዘኑት።

verses.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.am: ተመለሱ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ፈተኑት፥ የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ አሳዘኑት።

verses.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted YAHUAH, and limited the Holy One of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እነርሱም እጁን አላሰቡም፥ ከጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ያዳነበትን ቀን፥

verses.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.am: በግብጽ ያደረገውን ተኣምራቱን፥ በጣኔዎስም በረሃ ያደረገውን ድንቁን።

verses.en: How he had wrought his signs in Mitsrayim, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.am: ወንዞቻቸውንም ወደ ደም ለወጠ፥ ምንጮቻቸውን ደግሞ እንዳይጠጡ።

verses.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.am: ዝንቦችንም በላያቸው ሰደደባቸው፥ በሉአቸውም፤ በጓጉንቸርም አጠፋቸው።

verses.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.am: ፍሬያቸውን ለኩብኩባ፥ ሥራቸውንም ለአንበጣ ሰጠ።

verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.am: ወይናቸውን በበረዶ፥ በለሳቸውንም በአመዳይ አጠፋ።

verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.am: እንስሶቻቸውን ለበረዶ፥ ሀብታቸውንም ለእሳት ሰጠ።

verses.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.am: የመዓቱን መቅሠፍት በላያቸው ሰደደ፤ መቅሠፍትን መዓትንም መከራንም በክፉዎች መላእክት ሰደደ።

verses.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.am: ለቍጣው መንገድን ጠረገ፤ ነፍሳቸውንም ከሞት አላዳናትም፥ እንስሶቻቸውንም በሞት ውስጥ ዘጋ፤

verses.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.am: በኵሮቻቸውን ሁሉ በግብጽ፥ የድካማቸውንም መጀመሪያ በካም ድንኳኖች ገደለ።

verses.en: And smote all the firstborn in Mitsrayim; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ግን እንደ በጎች አሰማራቸው፥ እንደ መንጋም በምድረ በዳ መራቸው።

verses.en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.am: በተስፋም መራቸው አልፈሩምም፥ ጠላቶቻቸውንም ባሕር ደፈናቸው።

verses.en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደሱም ተራራ አገባቸው፥ ቀኙ ወደ ፈጠረችው ወደዚህች ተራራ፤

verses.en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.am: ከፊታቸውም አሕዛብን አባረረ፥ ርስቱንም በገመድ አካፈላቸው፥ የእስራኤልንም ወገኖች በቤታቸው አኖረ።

verses.en: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Yisra'el to dwell in their tents.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ልዑል እግዚአብሔርን ፈተኑት አስቈጡትም፥ ምስክሩንም አልጠበቁም፤

verses.en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high YAHUAH, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.am: ተመለሱም እንደ አባቶቻቸውም ከዱ፤ እንደ ጠማማ ቀስትም ተገለበጡ፤

verses.en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.am: በኰረብታ መስገጃዎቻቸውም አስቈጡት፥ በተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውም አስቀኑት።

verses.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፥ እስራኤልንም እጅግ ናቀ፤

verses.en: When YAHUAH heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Yisra'el:
verses.am: የሴሎምን ማደሪያ ተዋት በሰዎች መካከል ያደረገባትን ድንኳኑን፤

verses.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.am: ኃይላቸውን ለምርኮ፥ ሽልማቱንም በጠላት እጅ ሰጠ።

verses.en: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም በጦር ውስጥ ዘጋቸው፥ ርስቱንም ቸል አላቸው።

verses.en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.am: ጕልማሶቻቸውን እሳት በላቸው፥ ቈነጃጅቶቻቸውም አላዘኑም፤

verses.en: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.am: ካህናቶቻቸውም በሰይፍ ወደቁ፥ ባልቴቶቻቸውም አላለቀሱላቸውም።

verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእንቅልፍ እንደሚነቃ ተነሣ፥ የወይን ስካር እንደ ተወው እንደ ኃያልም ሰው፤

verses.en: Then YAHUAH awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.am: ጠላቶቹንም በኋላቸው መታ፤ የዘላለምን ኀሣር ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.am: የዮሴፍንም ድንኳን ተዋት፥ የኤፍሬምንም ወገን አልመረጠውም፤

verses.en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Yoseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.am: የይሁዳን ወገን ግን መረጠ፥ የወደደውን የጽዮንን ተራራ።

verses.en: But chose the tribe of Yehudah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.am: መቅደሱን እንደ አርያም ሠራ፥ ለዘላለምም በምድር ውስጥ መሠረታት።

verses.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.am: ዳዊትንም ባሪያውን መረጠው፥ ከበጎቹም መንጋ ውስጥ ወሰደው፤

verses.en: He chose Dawid also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Ya'aqob his people, and Yisra'el his inheritance.
So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
[A Psalm of Asaph.] O YAHUAH, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Yerushalayim on heaps.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ወደ ርስትህ ገቡ፤ የቅድስናህንም መቅደስ አረከሱ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም እንደ መደብ አደረጉአት።

verses.en: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.am: የባሪያዎችህንም በድኖች ለሰማይ ወፎች መብል አደረጉ፥ የጻድቃንህንም ሥራ ለምድር አራዊት፤

verses.en: Their blood have they shed like water round about Yerushalayim; and there was none to bury them.
verses.am: ደማቸውንም በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ እንደ ውኃ አፈሰሱ፥ የሚቀብራቸውም አጡ።

verses.en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.am: ለጎረቤቶቻችንም ስድብ ሆንን፥ በዙሪያችንም ላሉ ሣቅና ዘበት።

verses.en: How long, YAHUAH? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ለዘላለም ትቈጣለህ? ቅንዓትህም እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል?

verses.en: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.am: ስምህን በማይጠሩ መንግሥታት ላይ በማያውቁህም አሕዛብ ላይ መዓትህን አፍስስ፤

verses.en: For they have devoured Ya'aqob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.am: ያዕቆብን በልተውታልና፥ ስፍራውንም ባድማ አድርገዋልና።

verses.en: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.am: የቀደመውን በደላችንን አታስብብን፥ ምሕረትህ በቶሎ ታግኘን፥ እጅግ ተቸግረናልና።

verses.en: Help us, O YAHUAH of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
verses.am: አምላካችንና መድኃኒታችን ሆይ፥ እርዳን፤ ስለ ስምህ ክብር፥ አቤቱ፥ ታደገን፥ ስለ ስምህም ኃጢአታችንን አስተሰርይልን።

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their YAHUAH? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
verses.am: አሕዛብ፥ አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? እንዳይሉ፥ የፈሰሰውን የባሪያዎችህን ደም በቀል በዓይኖቻችን ፊት አሕዛብ ያወቁ፤

verses.en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.am: የእስረኞች ጩኸት ወደ ፊትህ ይግባ፤ እንደ ክንድህም ታላቅነት ሊገደሉ የተፈረደባቸውን አድን።

verses.en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የተዘባበቱብህን መዘባበታቸውን ለጎረቤቶቻችን ሰባት እጥፍ በብብታቸው ክፈላቸው።

verses.en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.am: እኛ ሕዝብህ ግን፥ የማሰማርያህም በጎች፥ ለዘላለም እናመሰግንሃለን፤ ለልጅ ልጅም ምስጋናህን እንናገራለን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.] Give ear, O Shepherd of Yisra'el, thou that leadest Yoseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.am: ዮሴፍን እንደ መንጋ የምትመራ፥ የእስራኤል ጠባቂ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ፤ በኪሩቤል ላይ የምትቀመጥ፥ ተገለጥ።

verses.en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
verses.am: በኤፍሬምና በብንያም በምናሴም፤ ኃይልህን አንሣ እኛንም ለማዳን ና።

verses.en: Turn us again, O YAHUAH, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ በባሪያህ ጸሎት ላይ እስከ መቼ ትቈጣለህ?

verses.en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.am: የእንባ እንጀራን ትመግበናለህ፥ እንባም በስፍር ታጠጣናለህ።

verses.en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.am: ለጎረቤቶቻችን ክርክር አደረግኸን፥ ጠላቶቻችንም በላያችን ተሣለቁብን።

verses.en: Turn us again, O YAHUAH of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Mitsrayim: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.am: ከግብጽ የወይን ግንድ አመጣህ፤ አሕዛብን አባረርህ እርስዋንም ተከልህ።

verses.en: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.am: በፊትዋም ስፍራን አዘጋጀህ፥ ሥሮችዋንም ተከልህ ምድርንም ሞላች።

verses.en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.am: ጥላዋ ተራሮችን ከደነ፥ ጫፎችዋም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ዝግባ ሆኑ።

verses.en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.am: ቅርንጫፎችዋንም እስከ ባሕር፥ ቡቃያዋንም እስከ ወንዙ ዘረጋች።

verses.en: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.am: አጥርዋን ለምን አፈረስህ? መንገድ አላፊም ሁሉ ይቀጥፋታል።

verses.en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.am: የዱር እርያ አረከሳት፥ የአገር አውሬም ተሰማራባት።

verses.en: Return, we beseech thee, O YAHUAH of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ተመለስ፤ ከሰማይ ተመልከት፥ እይም፥ ይህችንም የወይን ግንድ ጐብኝ።

verses.en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.am: በሰው ልጅ ለአንተ ያጸናኸውን ቀኝህ የተከላትን አንሣ።

verses.en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.am: በእሳት ተቃጥላለች ተነቅላማለች፤ ከፊትህ ተግሣጽም የተነሣ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.am: ለአንተ ባጸናኸው በሰው ልጅ ላይ፥ በቀኝህ ሰው ላይ እጅህ ትሁን።

verses.en: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.am: ከአንተም አንራቅ፤ አድነን ስምህንም እንጠራለን።

verses.en: Turn us again, O YAHUAH of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph.] Sing aloud unto YAHUAH our strength: make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: በረድኤታችን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ እልል በሉ።

verses.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.am: ዝማሬውን አንሡ ከበሮንም ስጡ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን በገና ከመሰንቆ ጋር፤

verses.en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.am: በመባቻ ቀን በከፍተኛው በዓላችን ቀን መለከትን ንፉ፤

verses.en: For this was a statute for Yisra'el, and a law of YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ሥርዓቱ ነውና፥ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ፍርድ።

verses.en: This he ordained in Yoseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Mitsrayim: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.am: ከግብጽ በወጣ ጊዜ ለዮሴፍ ምስክር አቆመው። ያላወቅሁትን ቋንቋ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.am: ጫንቃውን ከሸክም፥ እጆቹንም በቅርጫት ከመገዛት አራቅሁ።

verses.en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.am: በመከራህ ጊዜ ጠራኸኝ አዳንሁህም፥ በተሰወረ ዐውሎም መለስሁልህ፥ በክርክር ውኃ ዘንድም ፈተንሁህ።

verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Yisra'el, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ስማኝ እነግርሃለሁም፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እመሰክርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.am: አንተስ ብትሰማኝ ሌላ አምላክ አይሆንልህም፥ ለሌላ አምላክም አትሰግድም።

verses.en: I am YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, which brought thee out of the land of Mitsrayim: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.am: ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣሁህ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ነኝና፤ አፍህን አስፋ እሞላዋለሁም።

verses.en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Yisra'el would none of me.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ግን ቃሌን አልሰሙኝም፥ እስራኤልም አላዳመጠኝም።

verses.en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.am: እንደ ልባቸው ሥራ ተውኋቸው፥ በልባቸውም አሳብ ሄዱ።

verses.en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Yisra'el had walked in my ways!
verses.am: ሕዝቤስ ሰምቶኝ ቢሆን፥ እስራኤልም በመንገዴ ሄደው ቢሆን፤

verses.en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.am: ጠላቶቻቸውን ፈጥኜ ባዋረድኋቸው ነበር፥ በሚያስጨንቋቸውም ላይ እጄን በጣልሁ ነበር፤

verses.en: The haters of YAHUAH should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶችም በተገዙለት ነበር፥ ዘመናቸውም ለዘላለም በሆነ ነበር፤

verses.en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.am: ከስንዴም ስብ ባበላቸው ነበር፥ ከዓለቱም ማር ባጠገባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Asaph.] YAHUAH standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the elohim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአማልክት ማኅበር ቆመ፥ በአማልክትም መካከል ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.am: እስከ መቼ ሐሰትን ትፈርዳላችሁ? እስከ መቼ ለኃጢአተኞች ፊት ታደላላችሁ?

verses.en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.am: ለድሆችና ለድሀ አደጎች ፍረዱ፤ ለችግረኛውና ለምስኪኑ ጽድቅ አድርጉ፤

verses.en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.am: ብቸኛውንና ችግረኛውን አድኑ፤ ከኃጢአተኞችም እጅ አስጥሉአቸው።

verses.en: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.am: አያውቁም፥ አያስተውሉም፤ በጨለማ ውስጥ ይመላለሳሉ፤ የምድር መሠረቶች ሁሉ ተናወጡ።

verses.en: I have said, Ye are elohim; and all of you are children of the most High.
verses.am: እኔ ግን። አማልክት ናችሁ፥ ሁላችሁም የልዑል ልጆች ናችሁ፤

verses.en: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንደ ሰው ትሞታላችሁ፥ ከአለቆችም እንደ አንዱ ትወድቃላችሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፥ በምድር ላይ ፍርድ፥ አንተ አሕዛብን ሁሉ ትወርሳለህና።

verses.en: [A Song or Psalm of Asaph.] Keep not thou silence, O YAHUAH: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው? አቤቱ፥ ዝም አትበል፥ ቸልም አትበል።

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጠላቶችህ ጮኽዋልና፥ የሚጠሉህም ራሳቸውን አንሥተዋልና።

verses.en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን በምክር ሸነገሉአቸው፥ በቅዱሳንህም ላይ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Yisra'el may be no more in remembrance.
verses.am: ኑ ከሕዝብ እናጥፋቸው፥ ደግሞም የእስራኤል ስም አይታሰብ አሉ።

verses.en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.am: አንድ ሆነው በአንተ ላይ ተማከሩ፤ በአንተ ላይ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ፤

verses.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.am: የኤዶማውያን ድንኳኖች እስማኤላውያንም፥ ሞዓብም አጋራውያንም፥

verses.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.am: ጌባል አሞንም አማሌቅም፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከጢሮስ ሰዎች ጋር፤

verses.en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.am: አሦርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተባበረ፥ ለሎጥ ልጆችም ረዳት ሆኑአቸው።

verses.en: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.am: እንደ ምድያምና እንደ ሲሣራ፥ በቂሶንም ወንዝ እንደ ኢያቢስ አድርግባቸው።

verses.en: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.am: በዓይንዶር ጠፉ፥ እንደ ምድርም ጕድፍ ሆኑ።

verses.en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.am: አለቆቻቸውን እንደ ሔሬብና እንደ ዜብ፥ ታላላቆቻቸውንም እንደ ዛብሄልና እንደ ስልማና አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of YAHUAH in possession.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ እንወርሳለን የሚሉትን።

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እንደ ትቢያ በነፋስ ፊትም እንደ ገለባ አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.am: እሳት ዱርን እንደሚያቃጥል፥ ነበልባልም ተራሮች እንደሚያነድድ፥

verses.en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.am: እንዲሁ በቍጣህ አሳድዳቸው፥ በመቅሠፍትህም አስደንግጣቸው።

verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: ፊታቸውን እፍረት ሙላው፥ አቤቱ፥ ስምህንም ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.am: ይፈሩ ለዘላለሙም ይታወኩ፤ ይጐስቍሉ ይጥፉም።

verses.en: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is YAHUAH, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.am: ስምህም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ፥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይም አንተ ብቻ ልዑል እንደ ሆንህ ይወቁ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] How amiable are thy tabernacles, O YAHUAH of hosts!
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ ማደሪያዎችህ እንደምን የተወደዱ ናቸው!

verses.en: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of YAHUAH: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነፍሴ የእግዚአብሔርን አደባባዮች ትወድዳለች ትናፍቅማለች፤ ልቤም ሥጋዬም በሕያው አምላክ ደስ ተሰኘ።

verses.en: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O YAHUAH of hosts, my King, and my YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወፍ ለእርስዋ ቤትን አገኘች፥ ዋኖስም ጫጩቶችዋን የምታኖርበት ቤት አገኘች፤ የሠራዊት አምላክ ንጉሤም አምላኬም ሆይ፥ እርሱ መሠዊያህ ነው።

verses.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.am: በቤትህ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ የተመሰገኑ ናቸው፤ ለዓለምና ለዘላለምም ያመሰግኑሃል።

verses.en: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እርዳታው ከአንተ ዘንድ የሆነለት፥ በልቡም የላይኛውን መንገድ የሚያስብ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.am: በልቅሶ ሸለቆ ውስጥ በወሰነው ስፍራ የሕግ መምህር በረከትን ይሰጣልና።

verses.en: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከኃይል ወደ ኃይል ይሄዳሉ፤ የአማልክት አምላክ በጽዮን ይታያል።

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O YAHUAH of Ya'aqob. Selah.
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ።

verses.en: Behold, O YAHUAH our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መታመናችንን እይልን፥ ወደ ቀባኸውም ፊት ተመልከት።

verses.en: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my YAHUAH, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.am: ከአእላፍ ይልቅ በአደባባዮችህ አንዲት ቀን ትሻላለች፤ በኃጥኣን ድንኳኖች ከመቀመጥ ይልቅ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እጣል ዘንድ መረጥሁ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH is a sun and shield: YAHUAH will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ምሕረትንና እውነትን ስለ ወደደ፥ ሞገስንና ክብርን ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር በቅንነት የሚሄዱትን ከመልካም ነገር አያሳጣቸውም።

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ በአንተ የታመነ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] YAHUAH, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለምድርህ ሞገስን አደረግህ፥ የያዕቆብንም ምርኮ መለስህ።

verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.am: የሕዝብህን ኃጢአት አስቀረህ፥ አበሳቸውንም ሁሉ ከደንህ።

verses.en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.am: መዓትህንም ሁሉ አስወገድህ፤ ከቍጣህ መቅሠፍት ተመለስህ።

verses.en: Turn us, O YAHUAH of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.am: የመድኃኒታችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ መልሰን፥ ቍጣህንም ከእኛ መልስ።

verses.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.am: በውኑ ለዘላለም ትቈጣናለህን? ቍጣህንስ ለልጅ ልጅ ታስረዝማለህን?

verses.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ትመለሳለህ ታድነንማለህ፤ ሕዝቡም በአንተ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Shew us thy mercy, O YAHUAH, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን አሳየን፥ አቤቱ፥ መድኃኒትህንም ስጠን።

verses.en: I will hear what YAHUAH will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ የሚናገረውን እሰማለሁ፤ ሰላምን ለሕዝቡና ለቅዱሳኑ ልባቸውንም ወደ እርሱ ለሚመልሱ ይናገራልና።

verses.en: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክብር በምድራችን ያድር ዘንድ ማዳኑ ለሚፈሩት ቅርብ ነው፤

verses.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.am: ምሕረትና እውነት ተገናኙ፤ ጽድቅና ሰላም ተስማሙ።

verses.en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.am: እውነት ከምድር በቀለች፥ ጽድቅም ከሰማይ ተመለከተች።

verses.en: Yea, YAHUAH shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጎ ነገርን ይሰጣል፥ ምድራችንም ፍሬዋን ትሰጣለች።

verses.en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.am: ጽድቅ በፊቱ ይሄዳል፥ ፍለጋውንም በመንገድ ውስጥ ያኖራል።

verses.en: [A Prayer of Dawid.] Bow down thine ear, O YAHUAH, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል አድምጠኝም፥ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝና።

verses.en: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my YAHUAH, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.am: ቅዱስ ነኝና ነፍሴን ጠብቅ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተን የታመነውን ባሪያህን አድነው።

verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O YAHUAH: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቀኑን ሁሉ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁና ማረኝ።

verses.en: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O YAHUAH, do I lift up my soul.
verses.am: የባሪያህን ነፍስ ደስ አሰኛት፥ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁና።

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነህና፥ ምሕረትህም ለሚጠሩህ ሁሉ ብዙ ነውና።

verses.en: Give ear, O YAHUAH, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን አድምጥ፥ የልመናዬንም ድምፅ ስማ።

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.am: ትመልስልኛለህና በመከራዬ ቀን ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: Among the elohim there is none like unto thee, O YAHUAH; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከአማልክት የሚመስልህ የለም፥ እንደ ሥራህም ያለ የለም።

verses.en: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O YAHUAH; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.am: ያደረግሃቸው አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይመጣሉ፥ አቤቱ፥ በፊትህም ይሰግዳሉ፥ ስምህንም ያከብራሉ፤

verses.en: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art YAHUAH alone.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ድንቅ የምታደርግ አንተ ታላቅ ነህና፥ አንተም ብቻህን ታላቅ አምላክ ነህና።

verses.en: Teach me thy way, O YAHUAH; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን ምራኝ፥ በእውነትህም እሄዳለሁ፤ ስምህን ለመፍራት ልቤ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: I will praise thee, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም ስምህን አከብራለሁ፤

verses.en: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ በእኔ ላይ ታላቅ ናትና፥ ነፍሴንም ከታችኛይቱ ሲኦል አድነሃታልና።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ዓመፀኞች በእኔ ላይ ተነሥተዋል፥ የክፉዎችንም ማኅበር ነፍሴን ፈለጉአት፤ በፊታቸውም አላደረጉህም።

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, art a YAHUAH full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ግን መሓሪና ርኅሩኅ አምላክ ነህ፤ መዓትህ የራቀ ምሕረትህም እውነትህም የበዛ፤

verses.en: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ተመልከት ማረኝም፤ ለባሪያህ ኃይልህን ስጥ፥ የሴት ባሪያህንም ልጅ አድን።

verses.en: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, YAHUAH, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.am: ምልክትንም ለመልካም ከእኔ ጋር አድርግ፤ የሚጠሉኝ ይዩ ይፈሩም፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ረድተኸኛልና፥ አጽንተኸኛልምና።

verses.en: [A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah.] His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.am: መሠረቶቹ በተቀደሱ ተራሮች ናቸው፤

verses.en: YAHUAH loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ ድንኳኖች ይልቅ፥ እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ደጆች ይወድዳቸዋል።

verses.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of YAHUAH. Selah.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ከተማ ሆይ፥ በአንቺ የተከበረ ነገር ይባላል።

verses.en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babel to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.am: የሚያውቁኝን ረዓብንና ባቢሎንን አስባቸዋለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ጢሮስም የኢትዮጵያም ሕዝብ፥ እነዚህ በዚያ ተወለዱ።

verses.en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.am: ሰው እናታችን ጽዮን ይላል፥ በውስጥዋም ሰው ተወለደ፤ እርሱ ራሱም ልዑል መሠረታት።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ፥ በውስጥዋም ለተወለዱት አለቆችዋ በመጽሐፍ ይነግራቸዋል።

verses.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.am: በአንቺ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ደስ እንደሚላቸው ይነግራቸዋል።

verses.en: [A Song or Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.] O YAHUAH of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ፥ በቀንና በሌሊት በፊትህ ጮኽሁ፤

verses.en: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.am: ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትግባ፥ ጆሮህንም ወደ ጩኸቴ አዘንብል፤

verses.en: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.am: ነፍሴ መከራን ጠግባለችና፥ ሕይወቴም ወደ ሲኦል ቀርባለችና።

verses.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
verses.am: ወደ ጓድጓድ ከሚወርዱ ጋር ተቈጠርሁ፥ ረዳትም እንደሌለው ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.am: ለዘላለም እንደማታስባቸው፥ እንደ ተገደሉና በመቃብር ውስጥ እንደ ተጣሉ፥ በሙታን ውስጥ እንዳሉ የተጣልሁ ሆንሁ፤ እነርሱም ከእጅህ ተለዩ።

verses.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.am: በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ውስጥ፥ በታችኛው ጕድጓድ አስቀመጥኸኝ።

verses.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ ቍጣህ ጸና፥ መቅሠፍትህን ሁሉ በእኔ ላይ አመጣህ።

verses.en: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.am: የሚያውቁኝን ከእኔ አራቅህ፤ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ርኵስ አደረግኸኝ፤ ያዙኝ፥ መውጫም የለኝም።

verses.en: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: YAHUAH, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼም በመከራ ፈዘዙ፤ አቤቱ፥ ሁልጊዜ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፥ እጆቼንም ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፥

verses.en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
verses.am: በውኑ ለሙታን ተኣምራት ታደርጋለህን? የሞቱትስ ተነሥተው ያመሰግኑሃልን?

verses.en: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.am: በመቃብርስ ውስጥ ቸርነትህን፥ እውነትህንስ በጥፋት ስፍራ ይናገራሉን?

verses.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.am: ተአምራትህ በጨለማ፥ ጽድቅህንም በመርሳት ምድር ትታወቃለችን?

verses.en: But unto thee have I cried, O YAHUAH; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ግን ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ በጥዋት ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትደርሳለች።

verses.en: YAHUAH, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ለምን ትጥላለህ? ፊትህንስ ከእኔ ለምን ትሰውራለህ?

verses.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.am: እኔ ከታናሽነቴ ችግረኛ ለሞትም የቀረብሁ ነኝ፤ ከፍ ከፍ ካልሁ በኋላ ግን ተዋረድሁ ተናቅሁም።

verses.en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.am: መቅሠፍትህ በላዬ አለፈ፥ ግርማህም አስደነገጠኝ።

verses.en: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ እንደ ውኃ ከበቡኝ፥ በአንድነትም ያዙኝ።

verses.en: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.am: ወዳጄንና ባልንጀራዬን ዘመዶቼንም ከመከራ የተነሣ ከእኔ አራቅህ።

verses.en: [Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.] I will sing of the mercies of YAHUAH for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን ለዘላለም እዘምራለሁ፥ እውነትህንም በአፌ ለልጅ ልጅ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.am: እንዲህ ብለሃልና። ምሕረት ለዘላለም ይመሠረታል፥ እውነትህም በሰማይ ይጸናል።

verses.en: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto Dawid my servant,
verses.am: ከመረጥሁት ጋር ቃል ኪዳኔን አደረግሁ፥ ለባሪያዬም ለዳዊት ማልሁ።

verses.en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.am: ዘርህን ለዘላለም አዘጋጃለሁ፥ ዙፋንህንም ለልጅ ልጅ እመሠርታለሁ።

verses.en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O YAHUAH: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሰማያት ተኣምራትህን እውነትህንም ደግሞ በቅዱሳን ማኅበር ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.en: For who in the heaven can be compared unto YAHUAH? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto YAHUAH?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በሰማይ የሚተካከለው ማን ነው? ከአማልክትስ ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን ማን ይመስለዋል?

verses.en: YAHUAH is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.am: በቅዱሳን ምክር እግዚአብሔር ክቡር ነው፤ በዙሪያው ባሉት ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅና ግሩም ነው።

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, who is a strong YAHUAH like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.am: አቤቱ የሠራዊት አምላክ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው? አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብርቱ ነህ፥ እውነትህም ይከብብሃል።

verses.en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.am: የባሕርን ኃይል አንተ ትገዛለህ፥ የሞገዱንም መናወጥ አንተ ዝም ታሰኘዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.am: አንተ ረዓብን እንደ ተገደለ አዋረድኸው፥ በኃይልህም ክንድ ጠላቶችህን በተንሃቸው።

verses.en: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.am: ሰማያት የአንተ ናቸው፥ ምድርም የአንተ ናት፤ ዓለምንና ሞላውም አንተ መሠረትህ።

verses.en: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.am: ሰሜንና ደቡብን አንተ ፈጠርህ፤ ታቦርና አርሞንዔም በስምህ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.am: ክንድህ ከኃይልህ ጋር ነው፤ እጅህ በረታች ቀኝህም ከፍ ከፍ አለች።

verses.en: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.am: የዙፋንህ መሠረት ጽድቅና ፍርድ ነው፤ ምሕረትና እውነት በፊትህ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O YAHUAH, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.am: እልልታ የሚያውቅ ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ በፊትህ ብርሃን ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.am: በስምህ ቀኑን ሁሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ በጽድቅህም ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ፤

verses.en: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.am: የኃይላቸው ትምክሕት አንተ ነህና፥ በሞገስህም ቀንዳችን ከፍ ከፍ ይላልና።

verses.en: For YAHUAH is our defence; and the Holy One of Yisra'el is our king.
verses.am: ረድኤታችን ከእግዚአብሔር ከንጉሣችንም ከእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነውና።

verses.en: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜ ለልጆችህ በራእይ ተናገርህ እንዲህም አልህ። ረድኤቴን በኃይል ላይ አኖርሁ፤ ከሕዝቤ የተመረጠውን ከፍ ከፍ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: I have found Dawid my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.am: ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን አገኘሁት፥ ቅዱስ ዘይትም ቀባሁት።

verses.en: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.am: እጄም ትረዳዋለች፥ ክንዴም ታጸናዋለች።

verses.en: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.am: ጠላት በእርሱ ላይ አይጠቀምም፥ የዓመፃ ልጅም መከራ አይጨምርበትም።

verses.en: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.am: ጠላቶቹን ከፊቱ አጠፋለሁ፥ የሚጠሉትንም አዋርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.am: እውነቴና ምሕረቴም ከእርሱ ጋር ነው፥ በስሜም ቀንዱ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.am: እጁን በባሕር ላይ ቀኙንም በወንዞች ላይ አኖራለሁ።
