verses.en: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my YAHUAH, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.am: እርሱ። አባቴ አንተ ነህ፥ አምላኬ የመድኃኒቴም መጠጊያ ይላል።

verses.en: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.am: እኔም ደግሞ በኵሬ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ከምድር ነገሥታትም ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.am: ለዘላለምም ምሕረቴን ለእርሱ እጠብቃለሁ፥ ኪዳኔም በእርሱ ዘንድ የታመነ ነው።

verses.en: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.am: ዘሩንም ለዓለምና ለዘላለም፥ ዙፋኑንም እንደ ሰማይ ዘመን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.am: ልጆቹ ግን ሕጌን ቢተዉ፥ በፍርዴም ባይሄዱ፤

verses.en: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.am: ሥርዓቴንም ቢያረክሱ፥ ትእዛዜንም ባይጠብቁ፤

verses.en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.am: ኃጢአታቸውን በበትር፥ በደላቸውንም በመቅሠፍት እጐበኛታለሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.am: ምሕረቴን ግን ከእርሱ አላርቅም፥ በእውነቴም አልበድልም፤

verses.en: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.am: ኪዳኔንም አላረክስም፥ ከከንፈሬም የወጣውን አልለውጥም።

verses.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto Dawid.
verses.am: ዳዊትን እንዳልዋሸው አንድ ጊዜ በቅዱስነቴ ማልሁ።

verses.en: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.am: ዘሩ ለዘላለም፥ ዙፋኑም በፊቴ እንደ ፀሐይ ይኖራል።

verses.en: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.am: ለዘላለም እንደ ጨረቃ ይጸናል፤ ምስክርነቱ በሰማይ የታመን ነው።

verses.en: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ናቅኸው ጣልኸውም፥ የቀባኸውንም ጣልኸው።

verses.en: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.am: የባሪያህንም ኪዳን አፈረስህ፥ መቅደሱንም በምድር አረከስህ።

verses.en: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.am: ቅጥሩን ሁሉ ጣልህ፥ አምባዎቹንም አጠፋህ።

verses.en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.am: መንገድ አላፊም ሁሉ ተናጠቀው፥ ለጎረቤቶቹም ስድብ ሆነ።

verses.en: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.am: የጠላቶቹንም ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ አደረግህ፥ ጠላቶቹንም ሁሉ ደስ አሰኘህ።

verses.en: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.am: የሰይፉንም ረድኤት መለስህ፥ በሰልፍም ውስጥ አልደገፍኸውም።

verses.en: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.am: ከንጽሕናውም ሻርኸው፥ ዙፋኑንም በምድር ጣልህ።

verses.en: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.am: የዙፋኑንም ዘመን አሳነስህ፥ በእፍረትም ሸፈንኸው።

verses.en: How long, YAHUAH? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ለዘላለም ፊትህን ትመልሳለህ? እስከ መቼስ ቍጣህ እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል?

verses.en: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.am: ችሎታዬ ምን እንደ ሆነ አስብ፤ በውኑ የሰውን ልጅ ሁሉ ለከንቱ ፈጠርኸውን?

verses.en: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.am: ሕያው ሆኖ የሚኖር፥ ሞትንስ የማያይ ማን ነው? ነፍሱንስ ከሲኦል እጅ የሚያድን ማን ነው?

verses.en: YAHUAH, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto Dawid in thy truth?
verses.am: ለዳዊት በእውነት የማልህ፥ አቤቱ፥ የቀድሞ ምሕረትህ ወዴት ነው?

verses.en: Remember, YAHUAH, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የባሪያዎችህን ስድብ፥ በብብቴ ብዙ አሕዛብን የተቀበልሁትን፥

verses.en: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O YAHUAH; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጠላቶችህን የሰደቡትን የቀባኸውን ዘመን የሰደቡትን አስብ።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይባረክ። ይሁን ይሁን።

verses.en: [A Prayer of Mosheh the man of YAHUAH.] YAHUAH, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ለትውልድ ሁሉ መጠጊያ ሆንህልን።

verses.en: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art YAHUAH.
verses.am: ተራሮች ሳይወለዱ፥ ምድርም ዓለምም ሳይሠሩ፥ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.am: ሰውን ወደ ኅሳር አትመልስም፤ የሰው ልጆች ሆይ፥ ተመለሱ ትላለህ፤

verses.en: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verses.am: ሺህ ዓመት በፊትህ እንዳለፈች እንደ ትናንት ቀን፥ እንደ ሌሊትም ትጋት ነውና።

verses.en: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.am: ዘመኖች የተናቁ ይሆናሉ፥ በማለዳም እንደ ሣር ያልፋል።

verses.en: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.am: ማልዶ ያብባል ያልፋልም፥ በሠርክም ጠውልጎና ደርቆ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.am: እኛ በቍጣህ አልቀናልና፥ በመዓትህም ደንግጠናልና።

verses.en: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.am: የተሰወረውን ኃጢአታችንን በፊትህ ብርሃን፥ በደላችንንም በፊትህ አስቀመጥህ።

verses.en: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
verses.am: ዘመናችን ሁሉ አልፎአልና፥ እኛም በመዓትህ አልቀናልና፤ ዘመኖቻችንም እንደ ሸረሪት ድር ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.am: የዘመኖቻችንም ዕድሜ ሰባ ዓመት፥ ቢበረታም ሰማንያ ዓመት ነው፤ ቢበዛ ግን ድካምና መከራ ነው፤ ከእኛ ቶሎ ያልፋልና፥ እኛም እንገሠጻለንና።

verses.en: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
verses.am: የቍጣህን ጽናት ማን ያውቃል? ከቍጣህ ግርማ የተነሣ አለቁ።

verses.en: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.am: በልብ ጥበብን እንድንማር፥ ቀኝህን እንዲህ አስታውቀን።

verses.en: Return, O YAHUAH, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ፥ እስከ መቼስ ነው? ስለ ባሪያዎችህም ተምዋገት።

verses.en: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.am: በማለዳ ምሕረትህን እንጠግባለን፤ በዘመናችን ሁሉ ደስ ይለናል ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.am: መከራ ባሳየኸን ዘመን ፈንታ፥ ክፉም ባየንባቸው ዘመኖች ፋንታ ደስ ይለናል።

verses.en: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.am: ባሪያዎችህንና ሥራህን እይ፥ ልጆቻቸውንም ምራ።

verses.en: And let the beauty of YAHUAH our YAHUAH be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.am: የአምላካችን የእግዚአብሔር ብርሃን በላያችን ይሁን። የእጆቻችንንም ሥራ በላያችን አቅና።

verses.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.am: በልዑል መጠጊያ የሚኖር ሁሉን በሚችል አምላክ ጥላ ውስጥ ያድራል።

verses.en: I will say of YAHUAH, He is my refuge and my fortress: my YAHUAH; in him will I trust.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ መታመኛዬ ነህ እለዋለሁ፤ አምላኬና መሸሸጊያዬ ነው፥ በእርሱም እታመናለሁ።

verses.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.am: እርሱ ከአዳኝ ወጥመድ ከሚያስደነግጥም ነገር ያድንሃልና።

verses.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.am: በላባዎቹ ይጋርድሃል፥ በክንፎቹም በታች ትተማመናለህ፤ እውነት እንደ ጋሻ ይከብብሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.am: ከሌሊት ግርማ፥ በቀን ከሚበርር ፍላጻ፥

verses.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.am: በጨለማ ከሚሄድ ክፉ ነገር፥ ከአደጋና ከቀትር ጋኔን አትፈራም።

verses.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.am: በአጠገብህ ሺህ በቀኝህም አሥር ሺህ ይወድቃሉ፤ ወደ አንተ ግን አይቀርብም።

verses.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.am: በዓይኖችህ ብቻ ትመለከታለህ፥ የኃጥኣንንም ብድራት ታያለህ።

verses.en: Because thou hast made YAHUAH, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህና፤ ልዑልን መጠጊያህ አደረግህ።

verses.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.am: ክፉ ነገር ወደ አንተ አይቀርብም፥ መቅሠፍትም ወደ ቤትህ አይገባም።

verses.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.am: በመንገድህ ሁሉ ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝዛቸዋልና፤

verses.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.am: እግርህም በድንጋይ እንዳትሰናከል በእጆቻቸው ያነሡሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.am: በተኵላና በእባብ ላይ ትጫማለህ፤ አንበሳውንና ዘንዶውን ትረግጣለህ።

verses.en: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.am: በእኔ ተማምኖአልና አስጥለዋለሁ፤ ስሜንም አውቆአልና እጋርደዋለሁ።

verses.en: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.am: ይጠራኛል እመልስለትማለሁ፥ በመከራውም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋራ እሆናለሁ፤ አድነዋለሁ አከብረውማለሁ።

verses.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.am: ረጅምን ዕድሜ አጠግበዋለሁ፥ ማዳኔንም አሳየዋለሁ።

verses.en: [A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day.] It is a good thing to give thanks unto YAHUAH, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ማመስገን መልካም ነው፥ ልዑል ሆይ፥ ለስምህም ዝማሬ ማቅረብ፤

verses.en: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.am: በማለዳ ምሕረትን፥ በሌሊትም እውነትህን ማውራት

verses.en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.am: አሥር አውታር ባለው በበገና፥ ከምስጋና ጋርም በመሰንቆ።

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሥራህ ደስ አሰኝተኸኛልና፤ በእጅህም ሥራ ደስ ይለኛልና።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ እጅግ ትልቅ ነው፥ አሳብህም እጅግ ጥልቅ ነው።

verses.en: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ሰው አያውቅም። ልብ የሌለውም ይህን አያስተውለውም።

verses.en: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች እንደ ሣር ሲበቅሉ ዓመፃ የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ሲለመልሙ፥ ለዘላለም ዓለም እንዲጠፋ ነው።

verses.en: But thou, YAHUAH, art most high for evermore.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ግን ለዘላለም ልዑል ነህ፤

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies, O YAHUAH, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ጠላቶችህ ይጠፋሉና፥ ዓመፃንም የሚሠሩ ሁሉ ይበተናሉና።

verses.en: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.am: ቀንዴ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ ሽምግልናዬም በዘይት ይለመልማል።

verses.en: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.am: ዓይኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አየች፥ ጆሮዬም በእኔ ላይ በቆሙ በክፉዎች ላይ ሰማች።

verses.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.am: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘንባባ ያፈራል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ያድጋል።

verses.en: Those that be planted in the house of YAHUAH shall flourish in the courts of our YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ተተክለዋል፥ በአምላካችንም አደባባይ ውስጥ ይበቅላሉ።

verses.en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ በለመለመ ሽምግልና ያፈራሉ ደስተኞችም ሆነው ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: To shew that YAHUAH is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.am: አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ ይነግራሉ፥ በእርሱም ዘንድ ዓመፃ የለም።

verses.en: YAHUAH reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; YAHUAH is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፥ ክብርንም ለበሰ፤ እግዚአብሔር ኃይልን ለበሰ፥ ታጠቀም፤ ዓለምን እንዳትናወጥ አጸናት።

verses.en: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
verses.am: ዙፋንህ ከጥንት ጀምሮ የተዘጋጀ ነው፥ አንተም ከዘላለም ነህ።

verses.en: The floods have lifted up, O YAHUAH, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወንዞች ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ፥ ወንዞች ቃሎቻቸውን ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.am: ከብዙ ውኆች ድምፅ ከባሕርም ታላቅ ሞገድ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔር በከፍታው ድንቅ ነው።

verses.en: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O YAHUAH, for ever.
verses.am: ምስክርህ እጅግ የታመነ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ እስከ ረጅም ዘመን ድረስ ለቤትህ ቅድስና ይገባል።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, to whom vengeance belongeth; O YAHUAH, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የበቀል አምላክ ነው። የበቀል አምላክ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.am: የምድር ፈራጅ ሆይ፥ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ለትዕቢተኞች ፍዳቸውን ክፈላቸው።

verses.en: YAHUAH, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአተኞች እስከ መቼ? ኃጢአተኞች እስከ መቼ ይጓደዳሉ?

verses.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.am: ይከራከራሉ፥ ዓመፃንም ይናገራሉ፤ ዓመፃንም የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: They break in pieces thy people, O YAHUAH, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብን አዋረዱ፥ ርስትህንም አስቸገሩ።

verses.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.am: ባልቴቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን ገደሉ፥ ስደተኛውንም ገደሉ።

verses.en: Yet they say, YAHUAH shall not see, neither shall YAHUAH of Ya'aqob regard it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አያይም፥ የያዕቆብ አምላክ አያስተውልም አሉ።

verses.en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.am: የሕዝብ ደንቆሮች ሆይ፥ አስተውሉ፤ ሰነፎችማ መቼ ይጠበባሉ?

verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.am: ጆሮን የተከለው አይሰማምን? ዓይንን የሠራው አያይምን?

verses.en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.am: አሕዛብንስ የሚገሥጸው፥ ለሰውም እውቀት የሚያስተምረው እርሱ አይዘልፍምን?

verses.en: YAHUAH knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.am: የሰዎች አሳብ ከንቱ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል።

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O YAHUAH, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥልምና፥ ርስቱንም አይተውምና

verses.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥልምና፥ ርስቱንም አይተውምና

verses.en: For YAHUAH will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.am: ፍርድ ወደ ጽድቅ እስኪመልስ ድረስ ልበ ቅኖችም ሁሉ ይከተሉአታል።

verses.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.am: በክፉዎች ላይ ለእኔ የሚቆም ማን ነው? ዓመፃንስ በሚያደርጉ ላይ ለእኔ የሚከራከር ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የረዳኝ ባይሆን ነፍሴ ለጥቂት ጊዜ በሲኦል ባደረች ነበር።

verses.en: Unless YAHUAH had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.am: እግሮቼ ተሰናከሉ ባልሁ ጊዜ፥ አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ ረዳኝ።

verses.en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O YAHUAH, held me up.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለልቤ እንደ መከራዋ ብዛት ማጽናናትህ ነፍሴን ደስ አሰኛት።

verses.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.am: በሕግ ላይ ዓመፅን የሚሠራ የዓመፅ ዙፋን ከአንተ ጋር አንድ ይሆናልን?

verses.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.am: የጻድቅን ነፍስ ያደቡባታል፥ በንጹሕ ደምም ይፈርዳሉ።

verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያ ሆነኝ፥ አምላኬ የተስፋዬም ረዳት ነው።

verses.en: But YAHUAH is my defence; and my YAHUAH is the rock of my refuge.
verses.am: እንደ በደላቸውም እንደ ክፋታቸውም ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላቸዋል፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, YAHUAH our YAHUAH shall cut them off.
O come, let us sing unto YAHUAH: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.am: ኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበለን፤ ለአምላክ ለመድኃኒታችን እልል እንበል።

verses.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.am: በምስጋና ወደ ፊቱ እንድረስ፥ በዝማሬም ለእርሱ እልል እንበል፤

verses.en: For YAHUAH is a great YAHUAH, and a great King above all elohim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ አምላክ ነውና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነውና።

verses.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥላቸውም፤ የምድር ዳርቻዎችም በእጁ ውስጥ ናቸው፥ የተራሮች ከፍታዎች የእርሱ ናቸው።

verses.en: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.am: ባሕር የእርሱ ናት እርሱም አደረጋት፥ የብስንም እጆቹ ሠሩአት።

verses.en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before YAHUAH our maker.
verses.am: ኑ፥ እንስገድ ለእርሱም እንገዛ፤ በእርሱ ባደረገን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንበርከክ፤

verses.en: For he is our YAHUAH; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.am: እርሱ አምላካችን ነውና፥ እኛ የማሰማርያው ሕዝብ የእጁም በጎች ነንና።

verses.en: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ እንደ ተፈታተኑት እንዳስቈጡት ጊዜ፥ ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙ ልባችሁን አታጽኑ።

verses.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.am: የተፈታተኑኝ አባቶቻችሁ ፈተኑኝ ሥራዬንም አዩ።

verses.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.am: ያችን ትውልድ አርባ ዓመት ተቈጥቻት ነበር። ሁልጊዜ ልባቸው ይስታል፥ እነርሱም መንገዴን አላወቁም አልሁ።

verses.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.am: ወደ ዕረፍቴም እንዳይገቡ በቁጣዬ ማልሁ።

verses.en: O sing unto YAHUAH a new song: sing unto YAHUAH, all the earth.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ ምስጋናን አመስግኑ፤ ምድር ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ ስሙንም ባርኩ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም ማዳኑን አውሩ።

verses.en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.am: ክብሩን ለአሕዛብ ተኣምራቱንም ለወገኖች ሁሉ ንገሩ፤

verses.en: For YAHUAH is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all elohim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ምስጋናውም ብዙ ነውና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ የተፈራ ነውና።

verses.en: For all the elohim of the nations are idols: but YAHUAH made the heavens.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ አማልክት ሁሉ አጋንንት ናቸውና፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ሰማያትን ሠራ።

verses.en: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.am: ምስጋናና ውበት በፊቱ፥ ቅዱስነትና ግርማ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ናቸው።

verses.en: Give unto YAHUAH, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto YAHUAH glory and strength.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ወገኖች፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ ክብርና ምስጋናን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤

verses.en: Give unto YAHUAH the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.am: ለስሙ የሚገባ ክብርን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤ ቍርባን ያዙ ወደ አደባባዮችም ግቡ።

verses.en: O worship YAHUAH in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.am: በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ፤ ምድር ሁሉ በፊቱ ትነዋወጥ።

verses.en: Say among the heathen that YAHUAH reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል። እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ በሉ። እንዳይናወጥም ዓለሙን እርሱ አጸናው፥ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.am: ሰማያት ደስ ይበላቸው፥ ምድርም ሐሤትን ታድርግ፤ ባሕርና ሞላዋ ይናወጡ፤

verses.en: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.am: በረሃ በእርስዋም ያሉ ሁሉ ሐሤትን ያድርጉ፤ የዱር ዛፎች ሁሉ በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይላቸዋል፤

verses.en: Before YAHUAH: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.am: ይመጣልና፤ በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና፤ እርሱም ዓለምን በጽድቅ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: YAHUAH reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፤ ምድር ሐሤትን ታድርግ፥ ብዙ ደሴቶችም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.am: ደመና ጭጋግም በዙሪያው ናቸው፤ ጽድቅና ፍርድ የዙፋኑ መሠረት ናቸው።

verses.en: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.am: እሳት በፊቱ ይሄዳል፥ ጠላቶቹንም በዙሪያው ያቃጥላል።

verses.en: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.am: መብረቆቹ ለዓለም አበሩ፤ ምድር አየችና ተናወጠች።

verses.en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of YAHUAH, at the presence of YAHUAH of the whole earth.
verses.am: ተራሮችም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት፥ ከምድር ሁሉ ጌታ ፊት እንደ ሰም ቀለጡ።

verses.en: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.am: ሰማያት የእርሱን ጽድቅ አወሩ፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ክብሩን አዩ።

verses.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye elohim.
verses.am: ለተቀረጸ ምስል የሚሰግዱ ሁሉ፥ በጣዖቶቻቸውም የሚመኩ ይፈሩ፤ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ ስገዱለት።

verses.en: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Yehudah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ፍርድህ ጽዮን ሰምታ ደስ አላት፥ የይሁዳም ሴት ልጆች ደስ አላቸው፤

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all elohim.
verses.am: አንተ፥ እግዚአብሔር፥ በምድር ላይ ሁሉ ልዑል ነህና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ እጅግ ከፍ ከፍ ብለሃልና።

verses.en: Ye that love YAHUAH, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትወዱ፥ ክፋትን ጥሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር የቅዱሳኑን ነፍሶች ይጠብቃል፥ ከኃጥኣንም እጅ ያድናቸዋል።

verses.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.am: ብርሃን ለጻድቃን፥ ደስታም ለልበ ቅኖች ወጣ።

verses.en: Rejoice in YAHUAH, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.am: ጻድቃን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ለቅድስናውም መታሰቢያ አመስግኑ።

verses.en: [A Psalm.] O sing unto YAHUAH a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ ምስጋናን አመስግኑ፥ እግዚአብሔር ተኣምራትን አድርጎአልና፤ ቀኙ የተቀደሰም ክንዱ ለእርሱ ማዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ማዳኑን አስታወቀ፥ በአሕዛብም ፊት ጽድቁን ገለጠ።

verses.en: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Yisra'el: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለያዕቆብ ምሕረቱን ለእስራኤልም ቤት እውነቱን አሰበ፤ የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ የአምላካችንን ማዳን አዩ።

verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፤ አመስግኑ፥ ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ዘምሩም።

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በመሰንቆ፥ በመሰንቆና በዝማሬ ድምፅ ዘምሩ።

verses.en: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before YAHUAH, the King.
verses.am: በዋሽንትና በመለከት ድምፅ በንጉሥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እልል በሉ።

verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.am: ባሕርና ሞላዋ፥ ዓለምም በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ይናወጡ።

verses.en: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.am: ወንዞችም በአንድነት በእጅ ያጨብጭቡ፤ ተራሮች ደስ ይበላቸው፥ በምድር ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና።

verses.en: Before YAHUAH; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.am: ለዓለምም በጽድቅ ለአሕዛብም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: YAHUAH reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፥ አሕዛብ ይደንግጡ፤ በኪሩቤል ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ምድር ትናወጥ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ታላቅ ነው፤ እርሱም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አለ።

verses.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.am: ግሩምና ቅዱስ ነውና ሁሉ ታላቅ ስምህን ያመስግኑ።

verses.en: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Ya'aqob.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ክብር ፍርድን ይወድዳል፤ አንተ ቅንነትን አጸናህ፥ ለያዕቆብ ፍርድንና ጽድቅን አንተ አደረግህ።

verses.en: Exalt ye YAHUAH our YAHUAH, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.am: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉት፥ ቅዱስ ነውና ወደ እግሩ መረገጫ ስገዱ።

verses.en: Mosheh and Aaron among his priests, and Shemu'el among them that call upon his name; they called upon YAHUAH, and he answered them.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮን በካህናቱ ዘንድ፥ ሳሙኤልም ስሙን በሚጠሩት ዘንድ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔርን ጠሩት፥ እርሱም መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.am: በደመና ዓምድም ተናገራቸው፤ ምስክሩንና የሰጣቸውን ትእዛዝ ጠበቁ።

verses.en: Thou answeredst them, O YAHUAH our YAHUAH: thou wast a YAHUAH that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላክችን ሆይ፥ አንተ ሰማሃቸው፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ማርሃቸው፥ ሥራቸውን ሁሉ ግን ተበቀልሃቸው።

verses.en: Exalt YAHUAH our YAHUAH, and worship at his holy hill; for YAHUAH our YAHUAH is holy.
verses.am: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉት፥ በቅዱስ ተራራውም ስገዱ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነውና።

verses.en: [A Psalm of praise.] Make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH, all ye lands.
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥

verses.en: Serve YAHUAH with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.am: በደስታም ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዙ፥ በሐሤትም ወደ ፊቱ ግቡ።

verses.en: Know ye that YAHUAH he is YAHUAH: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ እወቁ፤ እርሱ ሠራን እኛም አይደለንም፤ እኛስ ሕዝቡ የማሰማርያውም በጎች ነን።

verses.en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.am: ወደ ደጆቹ በመገዛት፥ ወደ አደባባዮቹም በምስጋና ግቡ፤ አመስግኑት፥ ስሙንም ባርኩ፤

verses.en: For YAHUAH is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም፥ እውነቱም ለልጅ ልጅ ነውና።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O YAHUAH, will I sing.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትንና ፍርድን እቀኝልሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.am: እዘምራለሁ፥ ንጹሕ መንገዱንም አስተውላለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ መቼ ትመጣለህ? በቤቴ መካከል በልቤ ቅንነት እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.am: በዓይኔ ፊት ክፉን ነገር አላኖርሁም፤ ሕግ ተላላፊዎችን ጠላሁ።

verses.en: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.am: ጠማማ ልብም አልተጠጋኝም፤ ክፉ ከእኔ በራቀ ጊዜ አላወቅሁም።

verses.en: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.am: ባልንጀራውን በቀስታ የሚያማን እርሱን አሳደድሁ፤ በዓይኑ ትዕቢተኛ የሆነውና ልቡ የሚሳሳው ከእኔ ጋር አይተባበርም።

verses.en: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ይኖሩ ዘንድ፤ ዓይኖቼ በምድር ምእመናን ላይ ናቸው፤ በቀና መንገድ የሚሄድ እርሱ ያገለግለኛል።

verses.en: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.am: ትዕቢትን የሚያደርግ በቤቴ መካከል አይኖርም፤ ዓመፅን የሚናገር በዓይኔ ፊት አይቀናም።

verses.en: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ዓመፃ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ከተማ አጠፋቸው ዘንድ፥ የምድርን ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ በማለዳ እገድላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: [A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before YAHUAH.] Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ ጩኸቴም ወደ አንተ ይድረስ።

verses.en: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን ፊትህን ከኔ አትመልስ፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፤ በጠራሁህ ቀን ፈጥነህ ስማኝ።

verses.en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.am: ዘመኔ እንደ ጢስ አልቃለችና፥ አጥንቶቼም እንደ መቃጠያ ተቃጥለዋልና።

verses.en: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.am: እህል መብላት ተረስቶኛልና ተቀሠፍሁ ልቤም እንደ ሣር ደረቀ።

verses.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.am: ከጩኸቴ ድምፅ የተነሣ አጥንቶቼ ከሥጋዬ ጋር ተጣበቁ።

verses.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.am: እንደ ምድረ በዳ እርኩም መሰልሁ፤ በፈረሰ ቤት እንዳለ እንደ ጕጕት ሆንሁ።

verses.en: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.am: ተጋሁ፥ በሰገነትም እንደሚኖር ብቸኛ ድንቢጥ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ሁልጊዜ ይሰድቡኛል፥ የሚያሳድዱኝም ተማማሉብኝ።

verses.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.am: አመድን እንደ እህል ቅሜአለሁና፥ መጠጤንም ከእንባዬ ጋር ቀላቅያለሁና፥

verses.en: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.am: ከቍጣህና ከመዓትህም የተነሣ፤ አንሥተኸኛልና፥ ጥለኸኝማልና።

verses.en: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.am: ዘመኖቼ እንደ ጥላ አዘንብለዋል፤ እኔም እንደ ሣር ደርቄአለሁ።

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ለዘላለም ትኖራለህ፥ መታሰቢያህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.am: አንተ ተነሥ ጽዮንንም ይቅር በላት፥ የምሕረትዋ ጊዜ ነውና፥ ዘመንዋም ደርሶአልና፤

verses.en: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.am: ባሪያዎችህም ድንጋዮችዋን ወድደዋልና፥ ለመሬትዋም አዝነዋልና።

verses.en: So the heathen shall fear the name of YAHUAH, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ስምህን፥ ነገሥታትም ሁሉ ክብርህን ይፈራሉ፤

verses.en: When YAHUAH shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ይሠራታልና፥ በክብሩም ይገለጣልና።

verses.en: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.am: ወደ ችግረኞች ጸሎት ተመለከተ፥ ልመናቸውንም አልናቀም።

verses.en: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይህ ለሚመጣ ትውልድ ይጻፍ፥ የሚፈጠርም ሕዝብ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል ይላል፤

verses.en: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did YAHUAH behold the earth;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከመቅደሱ ከፍታ ሆኖ ተመልክቶአልና፥ ከሰማይ ሆኖ ምድርን አይቶአልና፤

verses.en: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.am: የእስረኞችን ጩኸት ይሰማ ዘንድ፥ ሊገድሉ የተፈረደባቸውን ያድን ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To declare the name of YAHUAH in Zion, and his praise in Yerushalayim;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም በጽዮን ምስጋናውንም በኢየሩሳሌም ይናገሩ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve YAHUAH.
verses.am: አሕዛብ በአንድነት በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ መንግሥታትም ለእግዚአብሔር ይገዙ ዘንድ።

verses.en: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.am: በኃይሉ ጎዳና መለሰለት። የዘመኔን አነስተኛነት ንገረኝ።

verses.en: I said, O my YAHUAH, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.am: በዘመኔ እኵሌታ አትውሰደኝ፤ ዓመቶችህ ለልጅ ልጅ ናቸው።

verses.en: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ከጥንት ምድርን መሠረትህ፥ ሰማያትም የእጅህ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.am: እነርሱ ይጠፋሉ፥ አንተ ግን ትኖራለህ፤ ሁላቸው እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ፥ እንደ መጐናጸፊያም ትለውጣቸዋለህ፥ ይለወጡማል፤

verses.en: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ያው አንተ ነህ፥ ዓመቶችህም ከቶ አያልቁም።

verses.en: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.am: የባሪያዎችህም ልጆች ይኖራሉ፥ ዘራቸውም ለዘላለም ትጸናለች።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Bless YAHUAH, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፥ አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ፥ የተቀደሰ ስሙን።

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፥ ምስጋናውንም ሁሉ አትርሺ፤

verses.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.am: ኃጢአትሽን ሁሉ ይቅር የሚል፥ ደዌሽንም ሁሉ የሚፈውስ፥

verses.en: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.am: ሕይወትሽን ከጥፋት የሚያድናት፥ በምሕረቱና በቸርነቱ የሚከልልሽ፥

verses.en: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.am: ምኞትሽን ከበረከቱ የሚያጠግባት፥ ጕልማስነትሽን እንደ ንስር ያድሳል።

verses.en: YAHUAH executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ አድራጊ ነው፤ ለተበደሉ ሁሉ ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: He made known his ways unto Mosheh, his acts unto the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ለሙሴ መንገዱን አስታወቀ፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆችም አደራረጉን።

verses.en: YAHUAH is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነው፥ ከቍጣ የራቀ ምሕረቱም የበዛ።

verses.en: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜም አይቀሥፍም፥ ለዘላለምም አይቈጣም።

verses.en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.am: እንደ ኃጢአታችን አላደረገብንም፥ እንደ በደላችንም አልከፈለንም።

verses.en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.am: ሰማይ ከምድር ከፍ እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ምሕረቱን በሚፈሩት ላይ አጠነከረ።

verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.am: ምሥራቅ ከምዕራብ እንደሚርቅ፥ እንዲሁ ኃጢአታችንን ከእኛ አራቀ።

verses.en: Like as a father pitieth his children, so YAHUAH pitieth them that fear him.
verses.am: አባት ለልጆቹ እንደሚራራ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ለሚፈሩት ይራራል፤

verses.en: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.am: ፍጥረታችንን እርሱ ያውቃልና፤ አቤቱ፥ እኛ አፈር እንደ ሆንን አስብ።

verses.en: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.am: ሰውስ ዘመኑ እንደ ሣር ነው፤ እንደ ዱር አበባ እንዲሁ ያብባል፤

verses.en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.am: ነፋስ በነፈሰበት ጊዜ ያልፋልና፥ ስፍራውንም ደግሞ አያውቀውምና።

verses.en: But the mercy of YAHUAH is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት ግን ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም በሚፈሩት ላይ፥ ጽድቁም በልጅ ልጆች ላይ ነው፤

verses.en: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኑን በሚጠብቁ፥ ትእዛዙንም ያደርጉአት ዘንድ በሚያስቡ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ዙፋኑን በሰማይ አዘጋጀ፥ መንግሥቱም ሁሉን ትገዛለች።

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.am: ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ፥ ብርቱዎችና ኃያላን፥ የቃሉንም ድምፅ የምትሰሙ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

verses.en: Bless ye YAHUAH, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ ፈቃዱን የምታደርጉ አገልጋዮቹ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless YAHUAH, O my soul.
verses.am: ፍጥረቶቹ ሁሉ በግዛቱ ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ።

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O my soul. O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተ እጅግ ታላቅ ነህ፤ ክብርንና ግርማን ለበስህ።

verses.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.am: ብርሃንን እንደ ልብስ ለበስህ፤ ሰማይንም እንደ መጋረጃ ዘረጋህ፤

verses.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.am: እልፍኙን በውኃ የሚሠራ፥ ሰረገላውን ደመና የሚያደርግ፥ በነፋስ ክንፍም የሚሄድ፥

verses.en: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.am: መላእክቱን መንፈስ የሚያደርግ፥ አገልጋዮቹንም የእሳት ነበልባል።

verses.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.am: ለዘላለም እንዳትናወጥ ምድርን በመሠረትዋ ላይ መሠረታት።

verses.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.am: በጥልቅ እንደ ልብስ ከደንሃት፥ በተራሮችም ላይ ውኆች ይቆማሉ።

verses.en: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.am: ከዘለፋህም ይሸሻሉ፥ ከነጐድጓድህም ድምፅ ይደነግጣሉ፤

verses.en: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.am: ወደ ተራሮች ይወጣሉ፥ ወደ ቈላዎች ወዳዘጋጀህላቸው ስፍራ ይወርዳሉ፤

verses.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.am: እንዳያልፉትም ድንበር አደረግህላቸው ምድርን ይከድኑ ዘንድ እንዳይመለሱ።

verses.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.am: ምንጮችን ወደ ቈላዎች ይልካል፤ በተራሮች መካከል ውኆች ያልፋሉ፤

verses.en: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.am: የዱር አራዊትን ሁሉ ያጠጣሉ፥ የበረሃ አህያዎችም ጥማታቸውን ይረካሉ።

verses.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.am: የሰማይም ወፎች በእነርሱ ዘንድ ያድራሉ፥ በድንጋዩ ስንጥቅ መካከልም ይጮኻሉ።

verses.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.am: ተራሮችን ከላይ የሚያጠጣቸው፤ ከሥራህ ፍሬ ምድር ትጠግባለች።

verses.en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.am: እንጀራን ከምድር ያወጣ ዘንድ ለምለሙን ለሰው ልጆች ጥቅም፥ ሣርንም ለእንስሳ ያበቅላል።

verses.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
verses.am: ወይን የሰውን ልብ ደስ ያሰኛል፥ ዘይትም ፊትን ያበራል፥ እህልም የሰውን ጕልበት ያጠነክራል።

verses.en: The trees of YAHUAH are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ዛፎች እርሱም የተከላቸው የሊባኖስ ዝግባዎች ይጠግባሉ።

verses.en: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.am: በዚያም ወፎች ይዋለዳሉ፥ የሽመላ ቤትም የእነርሱ ጎረቤት ነው።

verses.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.am: ረጃጅም ተራራዎች ለዋላዎች፥ ድንጋዮችም ለእሽኮኮች መሸሻ ናቸው።

verses.en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.am: ጨረቃን ለጊዜዎች አደረገ፤ ፀሐይም መግቢያውን ያውቃል።

verses.en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.am: ጨለማ ታደርጋለህ ሌሊትም ይሆናል፤ በእርሱም የዱር አራዊት ሁሉ ይወጡበታል።

verses.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from YAHUAH.
verses.am: የአንበሳ ግልገሎች ለመንጠቅ ይጮኻሉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ምግባቸውን ይሻሉ።

verses.en: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.am: ፀሐይ ስትወጣ ይሰበሰባሉ በየዋሻቸውም ይተኛሉ።

verses.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.am: ሰው ወደ ተግባሩ፥ እስኪመሽም ድረስ ወደ ሥራው ይወጣል።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ እጅግ ብዙ ነው፤ ሁሉን በጥበብ አደረግህ፥ ምድርም ከፍጥረትህ ተሞላች።

verses.en: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.am: ይህች ባሕር ታላቅና ሰፊ ናት፤ በዚያ ስፍራ ቍጥር የሌለው ተንቀሳቃሽ፥ ታላላቆችና ታናናሾች እንስሶች አሉ።

verses.en: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜ መርከቦች ይሄዳሉ፥ በዚያም ላይ የፈጠርኸው ዘንዶ ይጫወትበታል።

verses.en: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
verses.am: ምግባቸውን በየጊዜው ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ እነዚህ ሁሉ አንተን ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.am: በሰጠሃቸውም ጊዜ ይሰበስባሉ፤ እጅህን ትከፍታለህ፥ ከመልካም ነገርም ይጠግባሉ።

verses.en: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.am: ፊትህን ስትሰውር ይደነግጣሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውን ታወጣለህ ይሞታሉም፥ ወደ አፈራቸውም ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.am: መንፈስህን ትልካለህ ይፈጠራሉም፥ የምድርንም ፊት ታድሳለህ።

verses.en: The glory of YAHUAH shall endure for ever: YAHUAH shall rejoice in his works.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ለዘላለም ይሁን፤ እግዚአብሔር በሥራው ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.am: ምድርን ያያል እንድትንቀጠቀጥም ያደርጋል፤ ተራሮችን ይዳስሳል ይጤሳሉም።

verses.en: I will sing unto YAHUAH as long as I live: I will sing praise to my YAHUAH while I have my being.
verses.am: በሕይወቴ ሳለሁ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ፥ ለአምላኬም በምኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in YAHUAH.
verses.am: ቃሌ ለእርሱ ይጣፍጠው፥ እኔም በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou YAHUAH, O my soul. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኅጥኣን ከምድር ይጥፉ፤ ዓመፀኞች እንግዲህ አይገኙ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ ስሙንም ጥሩ፥ ለአሕዛብም ሥራውን አውሩ።

verses.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.am: ተቀኙለት፥ ዘምሩለት፥ ተአምራቱንም ሁሉ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: በቅዱስ ስሙ ተጓደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ ልብ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.en: Seek YAHUAH, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉት ትጸናላችሁም፤ ሁልጊዜ ፊቱን ፈልጉ።

verses.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹ የአብርሃም ዘር፥ ለእርሱም የተመረጣችሁ የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ፥ የሠራትን ድንቅ አስቡ፥ ተአምራቱን የአፉንም ፍርድ።

verses.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Ya'aqob his chosen.
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹ የአብርሃም ዘር፥ ለእርሱም የተመረጣችሁ የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ፥ የሠራትን ድንቅ አስቡ፥ ተአምራቱን የአፉንም ፍርድ።

verses.en: He is YAHUAH our YAHUAH: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.am: እርሱ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ነው፤ ፍርዱ በምድር ሁሉ ነው።

verses.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኑን ለዘላለም፥ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ያዘዘውን ቃሉን አሰበ፥

verses.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Yitschaq;
verses.am: ለአብርሃም ያደረገውን፥ ለይስሐቅም የማለውን፤

verses.en: And confirmed the same unto Ya'aqob for a law, and to Yisra'el for an everlasting covenant:
verses.am: ለያዕቆብ ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ለእስራኤልም የዘላለም ኪዳን እንዲሆን አጸና።

verses.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ለአንተ የከነዓንን ምድር የርስታችሁን ገመድ እሰጣለሁ፤

verses.en: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው እነርሱ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ሰዎች፥ እጅግ ጥቂቶችና ስደተኞች ሲሆኑ ነው።

verses.en: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.am: ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ፥ ከመንግሥታትም ወደ ሌላ ሕዝብ አለፉ።

verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ራብን ጠራ፥ የእህልን ኃይል ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ራብን ጠራ፥ የእህልን ኃይል ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.am: በፊታቸው ሰውን ላከ፤ ዮሴፍ ለባርነት ተሸጠ።

verses.en: He sent a man before them, even Yoseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.am: እግሮቹም በእግር ብረት ደከሙ፥ እርሱም በብረት ውስጥ ገባ።

verses.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.am: ቃሉ እስኪመጣለት ድረስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ፈተነው።

verses.en: Until the time that his word came: the word of YAHUAH tried him.
verses.am: ንጉሥ ላከ ፈታውም፥ የአሕዛብም አለቃ አስፈታው።

verses.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.am: የቤቱ ጌታ፥ የጥሪቱ ሁሉ ገዢ አደረገው፥

verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.am: አለቆቹን እንደ ፈቃዱ ይገሥጽ ዘንድ፥ ሽማግሌዎቹንም ጥበበኞች ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ።

verses.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ወደ ግብጽ ገባ፥ ያዕቆብም በካም አገር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: Yisra'el also came into Mitsrayim; and Ya'aqob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም እጅግ አበዛ፥ ከጠላቶቻቸውም ይልቅ አበረታቸው።

verses.en: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ይጠሉ ዘንድ በባሪያዎቹም ላይ ይተነኰሉ ዘንድ ልባቸውን ለወጠ።

verses.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.am: ባሪያውን ሙሴን የመረጠውንም አሮንን ላከ።

verses.en: He sent Mosheh his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.am: የተኣምራቱን ነገር በላያቸው ድንቁንም በካም አገር አደረገ።

verses.en: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.am: ጨለማን ላከ ጨለመባቸውም፤ በቃሉም ዐመፁ።

verses.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.am: ውኃቸውን ወደ ደም ለወጠ፥ ዓሦቻቸውንም ገደለ።

verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.am: ምድራቸው የንጉሦቻቸውም ቤቶች በጓጕንቸር ሞሉ።

verses.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.am: ተናገረ፥ የውሻ ዝንብ ትንኝም በዳርቻቸው መጡ።

verses.en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.am: ዝናባቸውን በረዶ አደረገው፥ እሳትም በምድራቸው ተቃጠለች።

verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.am: ወይናቸውንና በለሳቸውን መታ፥ የአገራቸውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.am: ተናገረ፥ አንበጣም ስፍር ቍጥር የሌለውም ኩብኩባ መጣ፥

verses.en: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.am: የአገራቸውንም ለምለም ሁሉ በላ፥ የምድራቸውንም ፍሬ በላ።

verses.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.am: የአገራቸውንም በኵር ሁሉ፥ የጕልበታቸውን መጀመሪያ ሁሉ መታ።

verses.en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.am: ከወርቅና ከብርም ጋር አወጣቸው፥ በወገናቸውም ውስጥ ደዌ አልነበረም።

verses.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.am: ፈርተዋቸው ነበርና ግብጽ በመውጣታቸው ደስ አላት።

verses.en: Mitsrayim was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.am: ደመናን ለመሸፈኛ ዘረጋባቸው፥ እሳትንም በሌሊት ያበራላቸው ዘንድ ዘረጋ።

verses.en: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.am: ለመኑ፥ ድርጭትንም አመጣላቸው፥ የሰማይንም እንጀራ አጠገባቸው።

verses.en: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.am: ዓለቱን ሰነጠቀ፥ ውኃውም ፈሰሰ፤ ወንዞች በበረሃ ሄዱ፤

verses.en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.am: ለባሪያው ለአብርሃም የነገረውን ቅዱስ ቃሉን አስቦአልና።

verses.en: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም በደስታ የተመረጡትንም በእልልታ አወጣ።

verses.en: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.am: የአሕዛብንም አገሮች ሰጣቸው፥ የወገኖችንም ድካም ወረሱ፥

verses.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.am: ሕጉን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ሥርዓቱንም ይፈልጉ ዘንድ። ሃሌ ሉያ

verses.en: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye YAHUAH.
Praise ye YAHUAH. O give thanks unto YAHUAH; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ፤ ቸር ነውና፥ ምህረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of YAHUAH? who can shew forth all his praise?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል ሥራ ማን ይናገራል? ምስጋናውንስ ሁሉ ማን ያሰማል?

verses.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.am: ፍርድን የሚጠብቁ፥ ጽድቅንም ሁልጊዜ የሚያደርጉ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Remember me, O YAHUAH, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሕዝብህ ሞገስ አስበን፥ በመድኃኒትህም ጐብኘን፤

verses.en: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.am: የመረጥሃቸውን በጎነት እናይ ዘንድ፥ በሕዝብህም ደስታ ደስ ይለን ዘንድ፥ ከርስትህም ጋር እንጓደድ ዘንድ።

verses.en: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.am: ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ኃጢአትን ሠራን፥ ዐመፅንም፥ በደልንም።

verses.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Mitsrayim; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን በግብጽ ሳሉ ተኣምራትህን አላስተዋሉም፥ የምሕረትህንም ብዛት አላሰቡም፤ በኤርትራ ባሕር ባለፉ ጊዜ ዐመፁብህ።

verses.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.am: ኃይሉን ግን ለማስታወቅ። ስለ ስሙ አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.am: የኤርትራንም ባሕር ገሠጸ እርሱም ደረቀ፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ በጥልቅ መራቸው።

verses.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.am: ከሚጠሉአቸውም እጅ አዳናቸው፥ ከጠላትም እጅ ተቤዣቸው።

verses.en: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.am: ያሳደዱአቸውንም ውኃ ደፈናቸው፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ አልቀረም።

verses.en: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በቃሉ አመኑ፥ ምስጋናውንም ዘመሩ።

verses.en: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.am: ፈጥነውም ሥራውን ረሱ፥ በምክሩም አልታገሡም።

verses.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted YAHUAH in the desert.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳም ምኞትን ተመኙ፥ በበረሃም እግዚአብሔርን ተፈታተኑት።

verses.en: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.am: የለመኑትንም ሰጣቸው፤ ለነፍሳቸው ግን ክሳትን ላከ።

verses.en: They envied Mosheh also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሙሴንም እግዚአብሔር የቀደሰውንም አሮንን በሰፈር ተመቀኙአቸው።

verses.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.am: ምድርም ተከፈተች ዳታንንም ዋጠችው፥ የአቤሮንንም ወገን ደፈነች፤

verses.en: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.am: በማኅበራቸውም እሳት ነደደች፥ ነበልባልም ኅጥኣንን አቃጠላቸው።

verses.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.am: በኮሬብም ጥጃን ሠሩ፥ ቀልጦ ለተሠራ ምስልም ሰገዱ።

verses.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.am: ሣርም በሚበላ በበሬ ምሳሌ ክብራቸውን ለወጡ።

verses.en: They forgat YAHUAH their saviour, which had done great things in Mitsrayim;
verses.am: እንዳያጠፋቸው ቍጣውን ይመልስ ዘንድ የተመረጠው ሙሴ በመቅሠፍት ጊዜ በፊቱ ባይቆም ኖሮ፥ ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.am: እንዳያጠፋቸው ቍጣውን ይመልስ ዘንድ የተመረጠው ሙሴ በመቅሠፍት ጊዜ በፊቱ ባይቆም ኖሮ፥ ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Mosheh his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.am: የተወደደችውን ምድር ናቁ፥ በቃሉም አልታመኑም፥

verses.en: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.am: በድንኳኖቻቸውም ውስጥ አንጐራጐሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙም።

verses.en: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በብዔል ፌጎርም ተባበሩበት፥ የሙታንንም መሥዋዕት በሉ።

verses.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.am: በብዔል ፌጎርም ተባበሩበት፥ የሙታንንም መሥዋዕት በሉ።

verses.en: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.am: በሥራቸውም አስመረሩት፥ ቸነፈርም በላያቸው በዛ።

verses.en: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.am: ፊንሐስም ተነሥቶ ፈረደባቸው፥ ቸነፈሩም ተወ፤

verses.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.am: ያም እስከ ዘላለም ለልጅ ልጅ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት።

verses.en: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳላቸው አሕዛብን አላጠፉም፤

verses.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳላቸው አሕዛብን አላጠፉም፤

verses.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Mosheh for their sakes:
verses.am: ከአሕዛብም ጋር ተደባለቁ፥ ሥራቸውንም ተማሩ።

verses.en: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.am: ለጣዖቶቻቸውም ተገዙ፥ ወጥመድም ሆኑባቸው።

verses.en: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom YAHUAH commanded them:
verses.am: ወንዶች ልጆቻቸውንና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለአጋንንት ሠው፤

verses.en: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.am: የወንዶች ልጆቻቸውንና የሴቶች ልጆቻቸን ደም፥ ለከነዓን ጣዖቶች የሠውአቸውን ንጹሕ ደም አፈሰሱ፥ ምድርም በደም ረከሰች።

verses.en: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.am: በሥራቸው ረከሱ፥ በማድረጋቸውም አመነዘሩ።

verses.en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነደደ፥ ርስቱንም ተጸየፈ።

verses.en: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.am: ወደ አሕዛብም እጅ አሳለፋቸው፥ የሚጠሉአቸውም ገዙአቸው።

verses.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.am: ጠላቶቻቸውም ግፍ አደረጉባቸው፥ ከእጃቸውም በታች ተዋረዱ።

verses.en: Therefore was the wrath of YAHUAH kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ አዳናቸው፤ ነገር ግን በምክራቸው አስመረሩት፥ በኃጢአታቸውም ተዋረዱ።

verses.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ጩኸታቸውን በሰማ ጊዜ ጭንቃቸውን ተመለከተ፤

verses.en: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም ኪዳኑን አሰበ፥ እንደ ምሕረቱም ብዛት ተጸጸተ።

verses.en: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.am: በማረኩአቸውም ሁሉ ፊት ሞገስን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አድነን፤ ቅዱስ ስምህን እናመሰግን ዘንድ፥ በምስጋናህም እንመካ ዘንድ፥ ከአሕዛብ መካከል ሰብስበን።

verses.en: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.am: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ ሕዝብም ሁሉ አሜን ይበል። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
Save us, O YAHUAH our YAHUAH, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
Blessed be YAHUAH of Yisra'el from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye YAHUAH.
O give thanks unto YAHUAH, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤

verses.en: Let the redeemed of YAHUAH say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዳናቸው፥ ከጠላቶች እጅ ያዳናቸው ይናገሩ።

verses.en: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.am: ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ፥ ከሰሜንና ከባሕር፥ ከየአገሩ ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.am: ውኃ በሌለበት ምድረ በዳ ተቅበዘበዙ፤ የሚኖሩበትንም ከተማ መንገድ አላገኙም።

verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.am: ተራቡ ተጠሙም፥ ነፍሳቸውም በውስጣቸው አለቀች።

verses.en: Then they cried unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው፤

verses.en: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.am: ወደሚኖሩበት ከተማ ይሄዱ ዘንድ የቀና መንገድን መራቸው።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ፤

verses.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.am: የተራበችን ነፍስ አጥግቦአልና፥ የተራቈተችንም ነፍስ በበረከት ሞልቶአልና።

verses.en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.am: በጨለማ በሞትም ጥላ የተቀመጡ፥ በችግር በብረትም የታሰሩ፤

verses.en: Because they rebelled against the words of YAHUAH, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስለ ዐመፁ፥ የልዑልንም ምክር ስለ ናቁ፥

verses.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.am: ልባቸው በድካም ተዋረደ፤ ታመሙ የሚረዳቸውም አጡ።

verses.en: Then they cried unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ በመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.am: ከጨለማና ከሞት ጥላ አወጣቸው፥ እስራታቸውንም ሰበረ።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ፤

verses.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.am: የናሱን ደዶች ሰብሮአልና፥ የብረቱንም መወርወሪያ ቈርጦአልና።

verses.en: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.am: ስለ ዓመፃቸው ሰነፉ፥ ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም ተቸገሩ።

verses.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.am: ሰውነታቸው መብልን ሁሉ ተጸየፈች፥ ወደ ሞትም ደጆች ቀረቡ።

verses.en: Then they cry unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.am: ቃሉን ላከ ፈወሳቸውም፥ ከጥፋታቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ፤

verses.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.am: የምስጋና መሥዋዕትንም ይሠውለት፥ በእልልታም ሥራውን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.am: በመርከቦች ወደ ባሕር የሚወርዱ፥ በታላቅ ውኃ ሥራቸውን የሚሠሩ፥

verses.en: These see the works of YAHUAH, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.am: እነርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ፥ በጥልቅም ያለችውን ድንቁን አዩ።

verses.en: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.am: ተናገረ፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ተነሣ፥ ሞገድም ከፍ ከፍ አለ።

verses.en: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይ ይወጣሉ ወደ ጥልቅም ይወርዳሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውም በመከራ ቀለጠች።

verses.en: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.
verses.am: ደነገጡ እንደ ስካርም ተንገደገዱ፥ ጥበባቸውም ሁሉ ተዋጠች።

verses.en: Then they cry unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.am: ዐውሎንም ጸጥ አደረገ፥ ሞገዱም ዝም አለ።

verses.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.am: ዝም ብሎአልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ወደ ፈለጉትም ወደብ መራቸው።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተአምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ።

verses.en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ ጉባኤ ከፍ ከፍ ያድርጉት፥ በሽማግሌዎችም ሸንጎ ያመስግኑት።

verses.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.am: ወንዞችን ምድረ በዳ፥ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ደረቅ አደረጋቸው፤

verses.en: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.am: ከተቀመጡባት ክፋት የተነሣ ፍሬያማዋን ምድር ጨው አደረጋት።

verses.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.am: ምድረ በዳን ለውኃ መቆሚያ፥ ደረቁንም ምድር የውኃ ምንጮች አደረገ።

verses.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.am: በዚያም ራብተኞችን አስቀመጠ፥ የሚኖርባትንም ከተማ ሠሩ።

verses.en: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.am: እርሻዎችንም ዘሩ ወይኖችንም ተከሉ፥ የእህልንም ሰብል አደረጉ።

verses.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.am: ባረካቸውም እጅግም በዙ፤ እንስሶቻቸውንም አላሳነሰባቸውም።

verses.en: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.am: እነርሱ በችግር በክፋት በጭንቀት ተዋረዱ እያነሱም ሄዱ፤

verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.am: በአለቶችም ላይ ኅሣርን፥ አፈሰሰ፥ መንገድም በሌለበት በምድረ በዳ አሳታቸው።

verses.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
verses.am: ችግረኛንም ከችግሩ ረዳው፤ እንደ በጎች መንጋ ወገን አደረገው።

verses.en: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.am: ቅኖች ያያሉ፥ ደስም ይላቸዋል፤ ኃጢአትም ሁሉ አፍዋን ትዘጋለች።

verses.en: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ጥበበኛ የሆነና ይህን የሚጠብቅ ማን ነው? እርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን ምሕረት ያስተውላል።

verses.en: [A Song or Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.am: ልቤ ጽኑ ነው፥ አቤቱ፥ ልቤ ጽኑ ነው፤ እቀኛለሁ በክብሬም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.am: በገና ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ መሰንቆም፤ እኔም ማልጄ እነሣለሁ።

verses.en: I will praise thee, O YAHUAH, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በወገኖችም መካከል እዘምርልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ በሰማይ ላይ ታላቅ ናትና፥ እውነትህም እስከ ደመናት ድረስ ነውና።

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O YAHUAH, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ በል፥ ክብርህም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ትሁን።

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.am: ወዳጆችህ ይድኑ ዘንድ፤ በቀኝህ አድን አድምጠኝም።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ተናገረ። ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሴኬምንም እካፈላለሁ፥ የሱኮትንም ሸለቆ እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Yehudah is my lawgiver;
verses.am: ገለዓድ የእኔ ነው ምናሴም የእኔ ነው፤ ኤፍሬም የራሴ መጠጊያ ነው። ይሁዳ ንጉሤ ነው።

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.am: ሞዓብ መታጠቢያዬ ነው፥ በኤዶምያስ ላይም ጫማዬን እዘረጋለሁ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ይገዙልኛል።

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.am: ወደ ጽኑ ከተማ ማን ይወስደኛል? ማንስ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ይመራኛል?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O YAHUAH, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O YAHUAH, go forth with our hosts?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የጣልኸኝ አንተ አይደለህምን? አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከሠራዊታችን ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.am: በመከራችን ረድኤትን ስጠን፤ የሰውም ማዳን ከንቱ ነው።

verses.en: Through YAHUAH we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይልን እናደርጋለን፤ እርሱም የሚያስጨንቁንን ያዋርዳቸዋል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hold not thy peace, O YAHUAH of my praise;
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ምሥጋናዬን ዝም አትበል፥

verses.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛ አፍና የተንኰለኛ አፍ በላዬ ተላቅቀውብኛልና፤ በሽንገላ አንደበትም በላዬ ተናገሩ፤

verses.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.am: በጥል ቃል ከበቡኝ፥ በከንቱም ተሰለፉብኝ።

verses.en: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.am: በወደድኋቸው ፋንታ አጣሉኝ፥ እኔ ግን እጸልያለሁ።

verses.en: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.am: በመልካም ፋንታ ክፉን በወደድኋቸውም ፋንታ ጠላትነትን መለሱልኝ።

verses.en: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.am: በላዩ ኃጢአተኛን ሹም፤ ሰይጣንም በቀኙ ይቁም።

verses.en: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.am: በተምዋገተም ጊዜ ተረትቶ ይውጣ፤ ጸሎቱም ኃጢአት ትሁንበት።

verses.en: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.am: ዘመኖቹም ጥቂት ይሁኑ፤ ሹመቱንም ሌላ ይውሰድ።

verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.am: ልጆቹም ድሀ አደግ ይሁኑ፥ ሚስቱም መበለት ትሁን።

verses.en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.am: ልጆቹም ተናውጠው ይቅበዝበዙ ይለምኑም፥ ከስፍራቸውም ይባረሩ።

verses.en: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.am: ባለዕዳም ያለውን ሁሉ ይበርብረው፥ እንግዶችም ድካሙን ሁሉ ይበዝብዙት።

verses.en: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.am: የሚያግዘውንም አያግኝ። ለድሀ አደግ ልጆቹም የሚራራ አይኑር።

verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.am: ልጆቹ ይጥፉ፤ በአንድ ትውልድ ስሙ ይደምሰስ።

verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with YAHUAH; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.am: የአባቶቹ ኃጢአት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትታሰብ፤ የእናቱም ኃጢአት አትደምሰስ።

verses.en: Let them be before YAHUAH continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁልጊዜ ይኑሩ፤ መታሰቢያቸው ከምድር ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.am: ምሕረትን ያደርግ ዘንድ አላሰበምና ችግረኛንና ምስኪንን ልቡ የተሰበረውንም ሰው ይገድል ዘንድ አሳደደ።

verses.en: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.am: መርገምን ወደደ ወደ እርሱም መጣች፤ በረከትንም አልመረጠም ከእርሱም ራቀች።

verses.en: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.am: መርገምን እንደ ልብስ ለበሳት፥ እንደ ውኃም ወደ አንጀቱ፥ እንደ ቅባትም ወደ አጥንቱ ገባች።

verses.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.am: እንደሚለብሰው ልብስ። ሁልጊዜም እንደሚታጠቀው ትጥቅ ይሁነው።

verses.en: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from YAHUAH, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.am: ይህ ሥራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በሚያጣሉኝ በነፍሴም ላይ ክፉን በሚናገሩ ነው።

verses.en: But do thou for me, O YAHUAH, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.am: አንተ ግን አቤቱ ጌታዬ፥ ስለ ስምህ ምሕረትህን በእኔ ላይ አድርግ፤ ምሕረትህ መልካም ናትና አድነኝ።

verses.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.am: እኔ ችግረኛ ምስኪንም ነኝና፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.am: እንዳለፈ ጥላ አለቅሁ፥ እንደ አንበጣም እረገፍሁ።

verses.en: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.am: ጕልበቶቼ በጾም ደከሙ፤ ሥጋዬም ቅቤ በማጣት ከሳ።

verses.en: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.am: እኔም በእነርሱ ዘንድ ለነውር ሆንሁ፤ ባዩኝ ጊዜ ራሳቸውን ነቀነቁ።

verses.en: Help me, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እርዳኝ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, YAHUAH, hast done it.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እጅህ ይህች እንደ ሆነች፥ አንተም ይህችን እንዳደረግህ ይወቁ።

verses.en: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.am: እነርሱ ይራገማሉ አንተ ግን ባርክ፤ በእኔ ላይ የሚነሡ ይፈሩ፥ ባሪያህ ግን ደስ ይበለው።

verses.en: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.am: የሚያጣሉኝ እፍረትን ይልበሱ፤ እፍረታቸውን እንደ መጐናጸፊያ ይልበሱአት።

verses.en: I will greatly praise YAHUAH with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በአፌ እጅግ አመሰግነዋለሁ። በብዙዎችም መካከል አከብረዋለሁ፤

verses.en: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ከሚያሳድዱአት ያድን ዘንድ በድሀ ቀኝ ቆሞአልና።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH said unto my Master, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን ለእግርህ መቀመጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የኃይልን በትር ከጽዮን ይልክልሃል፤ በጠላቶችህም መካከል ግዛ።

verses.en: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር ቀድሞ በኃይልህ ቀን፥ በቅዱሳን ብርሃን፥ ከአጥቢያ ኮከብ አስቀድሞ ከሆድ ወለድሁህ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.am: እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት አንተ ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ፥ እግዚአብሔር ማለ አይጸጸትም።

verses.en: YAHUAH at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቀኝህ ነገሥታትን በቍጣው ቀን ይቀጠቅጣቸዋል።

verses.en: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል ይፈርዳል፥ ሬሳዎችንም ያበዛል፤ በሰፊ ምድር ላይ ራሶችን ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.en: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.am: በመንገድ ከፈሳሽ ውኃ ይጠጣል፤ ስለዚህ ራስ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. I will praise YAHUAH with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። አቤቱ፥ በቅኖች ሸንጎ በጉባኤም በፍጹም ልቤ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: The works of YAHUAH are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ታላቅ ናት፥ ደስ በሚሰኙባት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተፈለገች ናት።

verses.en: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.am: ሥራው ምስጋናና ግርማ ነው፤ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: YAHUAH is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.am: ለተአምራቱ መታሰቢያን አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነው።

verses.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.am: ለሚፈሩት ምግብን ሰጣቸው፤ ኪዳኑንም ለዘላለም ያስባል።

verses.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.am: የአሕዛብን ርስት ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ የሥራውን ብርታት አሳየ።

verses.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.am: የእጆቹ ሥራ እውነትና ፍርድ ነው፤ ትእዛዙም ሁሉ የታመነ ነው፥

verses.en: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.am: ለዘላለምም የጸና ነው፥ በእውነትና በቅንም የተሠራ ነው።

verses.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.am: መድኃኒትንም ለሕዝቡ ሰደደ፥ ኪዳኑንም ለዘላለም አዘዘ፤ ስሙ የተቀደሰና የተፈራ ነው።

verses.en: The fear of YAHUAH is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.am: የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፥ ለሚያደርጓትም ሁሉ ደኅና ማስተዋል አላቸው፤ ምስጋናውም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Blessed is the man that feareth YAHUAH, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ፥ ትእዛዙንም እጅግ የሚወድድ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.am: ዘሩ በምድር ላይ ኃያል ይሆናል፤ የቅኖች ትውልድ ትባረካለች።

verses.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.am: ክብርና ባለጠግነት በቤቱ ነው፥ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.am: ለቅኖች ብርሃን በጨለማ ወጣ፤ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ጻድቅም ነው።

verses.en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.am: ቸር ሰው ይራራል ያበድራልም፥ በፍርድም ነገሩን ይፈጽማል።

verses.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.am: ለዘላለም አይናወጥም፤ የጻድቅ መታሰቢያ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከክፉ ነገር አይፈራም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ለመታመን ልቡ የጸና ነው።

verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.am: በጠላቶቹ ላይ እስኪያይ ድረስ ልቡ ጽኑ ነው፥ አይፈራም።

verses.en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.am: በተነ ለችግረኞችም ሰጠ፤ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ዓለም ይኖራል፤ ቀንዱ በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛም አይቶ ይቈጣል፥ ጥርሱንም ያፋጫል፥ ይቀልጣልም፤ የኃጢአተኞችም ምኞት ትጠፋለች።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise, O ye servants of YAHUAH, praise the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ አመስግኑት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Blessed be the name of YAHUAH from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.am: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ቡሩክ ይሁን።

verses.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same YAHUAH's name is to be praised.
verses.am: ከፀሐይ መውጫ ጀምሮ እስከ መግቢያው ድረስ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ይመስገን።

verses.en: YAHUAH is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍተኛ ነው፥ ክብሩም ከሰማያት በላይ ነው።

verses.en: Who is like unto YAHUAH our YAHUAH, who dwelleth on high,
verses.am: እንደ አምላካችን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ማን ነው? በላይ የሚኖር፤

verses.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.am: በሰማይና በምድር የተዋረዱትን የሚያይ፤

verses.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.am: ከአለቆች ጋር ከሕዝቡም አለቆች ጋር ያኖረው ዘንድ ችግረኛን ከመሬት የሚያነሣ፥ ምስኪኑንም ከፋንድያ ከፍ ከፍ የሚያደርግ፤

verses.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: መካኒቱን በቤት የሚያኖራት፥ ደስ የተሰኘችም የልጆች እናት የሚያደርጋት። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: When Yisra'el went out of Mitsrayim, the house of Ya'aqob from a people of strange language;
verses.am: እስራኤል ከግብጽ፥ የያዕቆብም ቤት ከእንግዳ ሕዝብ በወጣ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Yehudah was his sanctuary, and Yisra'el his dominion.
verses.am: ይሁዳ መቅደሱ፥ እስራኤልም ግዛቱ ሆነ።

verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.am: ባሕር አየች ሸሸችም፥ ዮርዳኖስም ወደ ኋላው ተመለሰ።

verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.am: ተራሮች እንደ ኮርማዎች፥ ኮረብቶችም እንደ ጠቦቶች ዘለሉ።

verses.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.am: አንቺ ባሕር የሸሸሽ፥ አንቺም ዮርዳኖስ ወደ ኋላሽ የተመለስሽ፥ምን ሆናችኋል?

verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.am: እናንተም ተራሮች፥ እንደ ኮርማዎች፥ ኮረብቶችስ፥ እንደ ጠቦቶች ለምን ዘለላችሁ?

verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of YAHUAH, at the presence of YAHUAH of Ya'aqob;
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ አምላክ ፊት፥ ከጌታ ፊት ምድር ተናወጠች፤

verses.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.am: ድንጋዩን ወደ ውኃ መቆሚያ፥ ጭንጫውንም ወደ ውኃ ምንጭ ከለወጠ።

verses.en: Not unto us, O YAHUAH, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
verses.am: ለእኛ አይደለም፥ አቤቱ፥ ለእኛ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ለስምህ ስለ ምሕረትህ ስለ እውነትህም ምስጋናን ስጥ።

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their YAHUAH?
verses.am: አሕዛብ። አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? አይበሉ።

verses.en: But our YAHUAH is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.am: አምላካችንስ በላይ በሰማይ ነው፤ በሰማይም በምድርም የፈቀደውን ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ጣዖታቶች የወርቅና የብር፥ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.am: አፍ አላቸው አይናገሩምም፤ ዓይን አላቸው አያዩምም፤

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.am: ጆሮ አላቸው አይሰሙምም፤ አፍንጫ አላቸው አያሸትቱምም፤

verses.en: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.am: እጅ አላቸው አይዳሰሱምም፤ እግር አላቸው አይሄዱምም፤ በጕሮሮአቸውም አይናገሩም።

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.am: የሚሠሩአቸውም የሚያምኑባቸውም ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: O Yisra'el, trust thou in YAHUAH: he is their help and their shield.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ፤ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: O house of Aaron, trust in YAHUAH: he is their help and their shield.
verses.am: የአሮን ቤት ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Ye that fear YAHUAH, trust in YAHUAH: he is their help and their shield.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ፤ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Yisra'el; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አሰበን ይባርከንማል፤ የእስራኤልን ቤት ይባረካል፥ የአሮንንም ቤት ይባረካል።

verses.en: He will bless them that fear YAHUAH, both small and great.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩትን፥ ትንንሾችንና ትልልቆችን ይባርካል።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በላያችሁ፥ በላያችሁና በልጆቻችሁ ላይ ይጨምር።

verses.en: Ye are blessed of YAHUAH which made heaven and earth.
verses.am: እናንተ ሰማይንና ምድርን ለሠራ ለእግዚአብሔር የተባረካችሁ ናችሁ።

verses.en: The heaven, even the heavens, are YAHUAH's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.am: የሰማያት ሰማይ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ምድርን ግን ለሰው ልጆች ሰጣት።

verses.en: The dead praise not YAHUAH, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሙታን የሚያመሰግኑህ አይደሉም ወደ ሲኦልም የሚወርዱ ሁሉ፤

verses.en: But we will bless YAHUAH from this time forth and for evermore. Praise YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኛ ሕያዋን ግን ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እግዚአብሔርን እንባርካለን። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: I love YAHUAH, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የልመናዬን ድምፅ ሰምቶአልና ወደድሁት።

verses.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.am: ጆሮውን ወደ እኔ አዘንብሎአልና በዘመኔ ሁሉ እጠራዋለሁ።

verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.am: የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፥ የሲኦልም ሕማም አገኘኝ፤ ጭንቀትንና መከራን አገኘሁ።

verses.en: Then called I upon the name of YAHUAH; O YAHUAH, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራሁ። አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን አድናት።

verses.en: Gracious is YAHUAH, and righteous; yea, our YAHUAH is merciful.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ጻድቅ ነው፥ አምላካችንም ይቅር ባይ ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕፃናትን ይጠብቃል፤ ተቸገርሁ እርሱም አዳነኝ።

verses.en: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for YAHUAH hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትሽ ተመለሺ፥ እግዚአብሔር መልካም አድርጎልሻልና፤

verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ከሞት፥ ዓይኔንም ከእንባ፥ እግሬንም ከመሰናከል አድኖአልና።

verses.en: I will walk before YAHUAH in the land of the living.
verses.am: በሕያዋን አገር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.am: አመንሁ ስለዚህም ተናገርሁ፤ እኔም እጅግ ተቸገርሁ።

verses.en: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.am: እኔም ከድንጋጤዬ የተነሣ። ሰው ሁሉ ሐሰተኛ ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: What shall I render unto YAHUAH for all his benefits toward me?
verses.am: ስላደረገልኝ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ምንን እመልሳለሁ?

verses.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የመድኃኒትን ጽዋ እቀበላለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: I will pay my vows unto YAHUAH now in the presence of all his people.
verses.am: በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ስእለቴን ለእግዚአብሔር እፈጽማለሁ።

verses.en: Precious in the sight of YAHUAH is the death of his saints.
verses.am: የቅዱሳኑ ሞት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የከበረ ነው።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፥ ባሪያህ ነኝ፥ የሴት ባሪያህም ልጅ ነኝ፤ ሰንሰለቴን ሰበርህ።

verses.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለአንተ የምስጋና መሥዋዕትን እሠዋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: I will pay my vows unto YAHUAH now in the presence of all his people,
verses.am: በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ስእለቴን ለእግዚአብሔር እፈጽማለሁ፥

verses.en: In the courts of YAHUAH's house, in the midst of thee, O Yerushalayim. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ፥ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ በመካከልሽም። ሃሌሉያ

verses.en: O praise YAHUAH, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት፥ ወገኖችም ሁሉ ያመስግኑት፤

verses.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of YAHUAH endureth for ever. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: ምሕረቱ በእኛ ላይ ጸንታለችና፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እውነት ለዘላለም ትኖራለች። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ናትና።

verses.en: Let Yisra'el now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች የእስራኤል ቤት አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች የአሮን ቤት አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: Let them now that fear YAHUAH say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩ ሁሉ አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: I called upon YAHUAH in distress: YAHUAH answered me, and set me in a large place.
verses.am: በተጨነቅሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራሁት፤ ሰማኝ አሰፋልኝም።

verses.en: YAHUAH is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ነው፥ አልፈራም ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?
