verses.en: YAHUAH taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ነው፥ እኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አያለሁ።

verses.en: It is better to trust in YAHUAH than to put confidence in man.
verses.am: በሰው ከመታመን ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር መታመን ይሻላል።

verses.en: It is better to trust in YAHUAH than to put confidence in princes.
verses.am: በገዦች ተስፋ ከማድረግ ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ማድረግ ይሻላል።

verses.en: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of YAHUAH will I destroy them.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁሉ ከበቡኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው፤

verses.en: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of YAHUAH I will destroy them.
verses.am: መክበቡንስ ከበቡኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው፤

verses.en: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of YAHUAH I will destroy them.
verses.am: ንብ ማርን እንዲከብብ ከበቡኝ፥ እሳትም በእሾህ ውስጥ እንዲነድድ ነደዱ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው።

verses.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but YAHUAH helped me.
verses.am: ገፋኸኝ፥ ለመውደቅም ተንገዳገድሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አገዘኝ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.am: ኃይሌም ዝማሬዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ እርሱም መድኃኒት ሆነልኝ።

verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of YAHUAH doeth valiantly.
verses.am: የእልልታና የመድኃኒት ድምፅ በጻድቃን ድንኳን ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ኃይልን አደረገች።

verses.en: The right hand of YAHUAH is exalted: the right hand of YAHUAH doeth valiantly.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገችኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ኃይልን አደረገች።

verses.en: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of YAHUAH.
verses.am: አልሞትም በሕይወት እኖራለሁ እንጂ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.am: መገሠጽስ እግዚአብሔር ገሠጸኝ፤ ለሞት ግን አልሰጠኝም።

verses.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise YAHUAH:
verses.am: የጽድቅን ደጆች ክፈቱልኝ፤ ወደ እነርሱ ገብቼ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: This gate of YAHUAH, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.am: ይህች የእግዚአብሔር ደጅ ናት፤ ወደ እርስዋ ጻድቃን ይገባሉ።

verses.en: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.am: ሰምተኸኛልና፥ መድኃኒትም ሆነኸኛልና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
verses.am: ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ፥ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ፥

verses.en: This is YAHUAH's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.am: ይህች ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሆነች፥ ለዓይናችንም ድንቅ ናት።

verses.en: This is the day which YAHUAH hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የሠራት ቀን ይህች ናት፤ ሐሤትን እናድርግ፥ በእርስዋም ደስ ይበለን።

verses.en: Save now, I beseech thee, O YAHUAH: O YAHUAH, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አሁን አድን፤ አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አሁን አቅና።

verses.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of YAHUAH: we have blessed you out of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚመጣ ቡሩክ ነው፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት መረቅናችሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is YAHUAH, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ነው፥ ለእኛም በራልን፤ እስከ መሠዊያው ቀንዶች ድረስ የበዓሉን መሥዋዕት በገመድ እሰሩት።

verses.en: Thou art my YAHUAH, and I will praise thee: thou art my YAHUAH, I will exalt thee.
verses.am: አንተ አምላኬ ነህ አመሰግንህማለሁ። አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ሰምተኸኛልና፥ መድኃኒትም ሆነኸኛልና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ናትና።

verses.en: ALEPH. Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በመንገዳቸው ንጹሐን የሆኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ የሚሄዱ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.am: ምስክሩን የሚፈልጉ፥ በፍጹም ልብ የሚሹት ምስጉኖች ናቸው፤

verses.en: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.am: ዓመፅንም አያደርጉም፥ በመንገዶቹም ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህን እጅግ እንጠብቅ ዘንድ አንተ አዘዝህ።

verses.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን ለመጠበቅ፤ መንገዶቼ ይቀኑ ዘንድ እወድድ ነበር።

verses.en: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን ሁሉ ስመለከት በዚያን ጊዜ አላፍርም።

verses.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የጽድቅህን ፍርድ ስማር በቅን ልብ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን እጠብቃለሁ፤ በፍጹም አትጣለኝ።  ቤት

verses.en: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.am: ጕልማሳ መንገዱን በምን ያነጻል? ቃልህን በመጠበቅ ነው።

verses.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.am: በፍጹም ልቤ ፈለግሁህ፥ ከትእዛዝህ አታርቀኝ።

verses.en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.am: አንተ እንዳልበድል፥ ቃልህን በልቤ ሰወርሁ።

verses.en: Blessed art thou, O YAHUAH: teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቡሩክ ነህ፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.am: የአፍህን ፍርድ ሁሉ በከንፈሬ ነገርሁ።

verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.am: እንደ ብልጥግና ሁሉ በምስክርህ መንገድ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.en: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን አሰላስላለሁ፥ መንገድህንም እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.am: በትእዛዝህ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ቃልህንም አልረሳም።  ጋሜል

verses.en: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.am: ለባሪያህ መልካም አድርግ ሕያው እንድሆን፥ ቃልህንም እንድጠብቅ።

verses.en: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼን ክፈት፥ ከሕግህም ተኣምራትህን አያለሁ።

verses.en: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.am: እኔ በምድር እንግዳ ነኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር።

verses.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሁልጊዜ ፍርድህን እጅግ ናፈቀች።

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.am: ከትእዛዛትህ የሳቱትን ትዕቢተኞችንና ርጉማንን ዘለፍህ።

verses.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.am: ምስክርህን ፈልጌአለሁና። ስድብንና ነውርን ከእኔ አርቅ።

verses.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.am: አለቆች ደግሞ ተቀምጠው እኔን አሙኝ፤ ባሪያህ ግን ሕግህን ያሰላስል ነበር።

verses.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
verses.am: ምስክርህም ተድላዬ ነው፥ ሥርዓትህም መካሪዬ ነው።  ዳሌጥ

verses.en: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ወደ ምድር ተጠጋች፤ እንደ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: መንገድህን ነገርሁ ሰማኸኝም፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.am: የሥርዓትህን መንገድ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ተኣምራትህንም አሰላስላለሁ።

verses.en: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.am: ከኀዘን የተነሣ ነፍሴ አንቀላፋች፤ በቃልህ አጠንክረኝ።

verses.en: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.am: የዓመፅን መንገድ ከእኔ አርቅ፥ በሕግህም ማረኝ፤

verses.en: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.am: የእውነትህን መንገድ መረጥሁ፥ ፍርድህንም አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O YAHUAH, put me not to shame.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምስክርህን ተጠጋሁ፤ አታሳፍረኝ።

verses.en: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.am: ልቤን ባሰፋኸው ጊዜ፥ በትእዛዝህ መንገድ ሮጥሁ።  ሄ

verses.en: HE. Teach me, O YAHUAH, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሥርዓትህን መንገድ አስተምረኝ፥ ሁልጊዜም እፈልገዋለሁ።

verses.en: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.am: እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ሕግህንም እፈልጋለሁ፤ በፍጹም ልቤም እጠብቀዋለሁ።

verses.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.am: እርስዋን ወድጃለሁና የትእዛዝህን መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.en: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.am: ልቤን ወደ ምስክርህ አዘንብል፥ ወደ ስስትም አይሁን።

verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.am: ከንቱ ነገርን እንዳያዩ ዓይኖቼን መልስ፤ በመንገድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
verses.am: እንዲፈራህ ባሪያህን በቃልህ አጽና።

verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
verses.am: ፍርድህ መልካም ናትና የተጠራጠርሁትን ስድብ ከእኔ አርቅ።

verses.en: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ትእዛዝህን ናፈቅሁ፤ በጽድቅህ ሕያው አድርገኝ  ዋው

verses.en: VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O YAHUAH, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ፥ ምሕረትህና መድኃኒትህ ይምጡልኝ።

verses.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.am: በቃልህ ታምኛለሁና ለሚሰድቡኝ በነገር እመልስላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.am: በፍርድህም ታምኛለሁና የእውነትን ቃል ከአፌ ፈጽመህ አታርቅ።

verses.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ዓለም ሁልጊዜ ሕግህን እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህንም ፈልጌአለሁና አስፍቼ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.am: በነገሥታት ፊት ምስክርህን እናገራለሁ፥ አላፍርምም፤

verses.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.am: እጅግም በወደድኋቸው በትእዛዛትህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.am: እጆቼንም ወደ ወደድኋቸው ወደ ትእዛዛትህ አነሣለሁ፤ ሥርዓትህንም አሰላስላሁ።  ዛይ

verses.en: ZAIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.am: ለባሪያህ ተስፋ ያስደረግኸውን ቃልህን አስብ።

verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.am: ቃልህ ሕያው አድርጎኛልና ይህች በመከራዬ ደስ አሰኘችኝ።

verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኞች እጅግ ዐመፁ፤ እኔ ግን ከሕግህ አልራቅሁም።

verses.en: I remembered thy judgments of old, O YAHUAH; and have comforted myself.
verses.am: ከጥንት የነበረውን ፍርድህን አሰብሁ፥ አቤቱ፥ ተጽናናሁም።

verses.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.am: ሕግህን ከተዉ ከኃጢአተኞች የተነሣ ኅዘን ያዘኝ።

verses.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.am: በእንግድነቴ አገር ሥርዓትህ መዝሙር ሆነችኝ።

verses.en: I have remembered thy name, O YAHUAH, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሌሊት ስምህን አሰብሁ፥ ሕግህንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህንም ፈልጌአለሁና፤ ይህች ሆነችልኝ።  ሔት

verses.en: CHETH. Thou art my portion, O YAHUAH: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ክፍሌ ነው፤ ሕግህን እጠብቃለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.am: በፍጹም ልቤ ወደ ፊትህ ተማለልሁ፤ እንደ ቃልህ ማረኝ።

verses.en: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.am: ስለ መንገዶችህ አሰብሁ፥ እግሬንም ወደ ምስክሮችህ መለስሁ።

verses.en: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን ለመጠበቅ ጨከንሁ አልዘገየሁምም።

verses.en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.am: የኃጥኣን ገመዶች ተተበተቡብኝ፤ ሕግህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.am: ስለ ጽድቅህ ፍርድ፥ በእኩለ ሌሊት አመሰግንህ ዘንድ እነሣለሁ።

verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.am: እኔ ለሚፈሩህ ሁሉ፥ ትእዛዝህንም ለሚጠብቁ ባልንጀራ ነኝ።

verses.en: The earth, O YAHUAH, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በምድር ሁሉ ሞላች፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።  ጤት

verses.en: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O YAHUAH, according unto thy word.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ ለባሪያህ መልካም አደረግህ።

verses.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.am: በትእዛዛትህ ታምኛለሁና መልካም ምክርና እውቀትን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.am: እኔ ሳልጨነቅ ሳትሁ፤ አሁን ግን ቃልህን ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቸር ነህ፥ በቸርነትህም ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.am: የትዕቢተኞች ዓመፅ በላዬ በዛ፤ እኔ ግን በፍጹም ልቤ ትእዛዛትህን እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.en: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
verses.am: ልባቸው እንደ ወተት ረጋ፤ እኔ ግን በሕግህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን እማር ዘንድ ያስጨነቅኸኝ መልካም ሆነልኝ።

verses.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.am: ከአእላፋት ወርቅና ብር ይልቅ የአፍህ ሕግ ይሻለኛል።  ዮድ

verses.en: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.am: እጆችህ ሠሩኝ አበጃጁኝም፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ትእዛዛትህንም እማራለሁ።

verses.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.am: በቃልህ ታምኛለሁና የሚፈሩህ እኔን አይተው ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: I know, O YAHUAH, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍርድህ ጽድቅ እንደ ሆነች፥ በእውነትህም እንዳስቸገርኸኝ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ ለመጽናናቴ ትሁነኝ፥ እንደ ቃልህም ለባሪያህ ይሁነው።

verses.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
verses.am: ሕግህ ተድላዬ ናትና ቸርነትህ ትምጣልኝ፥ በሕይወትም ልኑር።

verses.en: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኞች በዓመፅ ጠምመውብኛልና ይፈሩ፤ እኔ ግን በትእዛዝህ እጫወታለሁ።

verses.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.am: የሚፈሩህና ምስክሮችህን የሚያውቁ ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.am: እንዳላፍር ልቤ በሥርዓትህ የቀና ይሁን።  ካፍ

verses.en: CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
verses.am: ነፍሴ መድኃኒትህን ናፈቀች፤ በቃልህም ታመንሁ።

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.am: መቼ ታጽናናኛለህ እያልሁ ዓይኖቼ ስለ ቃልህ ፈዘዙ።

verses.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.am: በጢስ እንዳለ አቁማዳ ሆኛለሁና፤ ሥርዓትህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.am: የባሪያህ ዘመኖች ስንት ናቸው? በሚያሳድዱኝስ ላይ መቼ ትፈርድልኛለህ?

verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ጨዋታን ነገሩኝ፥ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ሕግህ ግን አይደለም።

verses.en: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ እውነት ናቸው፤ በዓመፅ አሳድደውኛል፤ እርዳኝ።

verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.am: ከምድር ሊያጠፉኝ ጥቂት ቀርቶአቸው ነበር፤ እኔ ግን ትእዛዛትህን አልተውሁም።

verses.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.am: እንደ ምሕረትህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ የአፍህንም ምስክር እጠብቃለሁ።  ላሜድ

verses.en: LAMED. For ever, O YAHUAH, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቃልህ በሰማይ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.am: እውነትህ ለልጅ ልጅ ናት፤ ምድርን መሠረትሃት እርስዋም ትኖራለች።

verses.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.am: ሁሉም ባሪያዎችህ ናቸውና ቀኑ በትእዛዝህ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.am: ሕግህ ተድላዬ ባይሆን፥ ቀድሞ በጐስቍልናዬ በጠፋሁ ነበር።

verses.en: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.am: በእርሱ ሕያው አድርገኸኛልና ፍርድህን ለዘላለም አልረሳም።

verses.en: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.am: እኔ የአንተ ነኝ፤ ፍርድህን ፈልጌአልሁና አድነኝ።

verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ጠበቁኝ፤ ምስክርህን ግን መረመርሁ።

verses.en: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.am: የሥራህን ሁሉ ፍጻሜ አየሁ፤ ትእዛዝህ ግን እጅግ ሰፊ ነው።  ሜም

verses.en: MEM. O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሕግህን እንደ ምን እጅግ ወደድሁ! ቀኑን ሁሉ እርሱ ትዝታዬ ነው።

verses.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ለእኔ ነውና ትእዛዝህ ከጠላቶቼ ይልቅ አስተዋይ አደረገኝ።

verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.am: ምስክርህ ትዝታዬ ነውና ካስተማሩኝ ሁሉ ይልቅ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.en: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን ፈልጌአለሁና ከሽማግሌዎች ይልቅ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.am: ቃልህን እጠብቅ ዘንድ ከክፉ መንገድ ሁሉ እግሬን ከለከልሁ።

verses.en: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.am: አስተምረኸኛልና ከፍርድህ አልራቅሁም።

verses.en: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.am: ቃልህ ለጕሮሮዬ ጣፋጭ ነው፤ ከማርና ከወለላ ይልቅ ለአፌ ጣፈጠኝ።

verses.en: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.am: ከትእዛዝህ የተነሣ አስተዋልሁ፤ ስለዚህ የሐሰትን መንገድ ጠላሁ።  ኖን

verses.en: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.am: ሕግህ ለእግሬ መብራት፥ ለመንገዴ ብርሃን ነው።

verses.en: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.am: የጽድቅህን ፍርድ እጠብቅ ዘንድ ማልሁ፥ አጸናሁም።

verses.en: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O YAHUAH, according unto thy word.
verses.am: እጅግ ተቸገርሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O YAHUAH, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከአፌ የሚወጣውን ቃል ውደድ፥ ፍርድህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሁልጊዜ በእጅህ ውስጥ ናት፤ ሕግህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ወጥመድን ዘረጉብኝ፤ ከትእዛዝህ ግን አልሳትሁም።

verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.am: የልቤ ደስታ ነውና ምስክርህን ለዘላለም ወረስሁ።

verses.en: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ለፍጻሜውም ትእዛዝህን አደርግ ዘንድ ልቤን አዘነበልሁ።  ሳምኬት

verses.en: SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.am: ዓመፀኞችን ጠላሁ፥ ሕግህን ግን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.am: አንተ ረዳቴና መጠጊያዬ ነህ፥ በቃልህም ተማመንሁ።

verses.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተ ኃጢአተኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥ የአምላኬንም ትእዛዝ ልፈልግ።

verses.en: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.am: እንደ ቃልህ ደግፈኝ፥ ሕያውም እሆናለሁ። ከተስፋዬም አልፈር።

verses.en: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.am: እርዳኝ እድናለሁም፥ ሁልጊዜም ሥርዓትህን እመረምራለሁ።

verses.en: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.am: ምኞታቸው ዓመፃ ነውና ከሥርዓትህ የሚርቁትን ሁሉ አጐሳቈልሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.am: የምድርን ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ እንደ ርኵሰት አጠፋሃቸው፤ ስለዚህ ምስክርህን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.am: ሥጋዬ አንተን ከመፍራት የተነሣ ደንገጠ፤ ከፍርድህ የተነሣ ፈርቻለሁ።  ዔ

verses.en: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.am: ፍርድንና ጽድቅን ሠራሁ፤ ለሚያስጨንቁኝ አሳልፈህ አትስጠኝ።

verses.en: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.am: ባሪያህን በመልካም ጠብቀው፤ ትዕቢተኞችም አይጋፉኝ።

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼ ለማዳንህ፥ ለጽድቅህም ቃል ፈዘዙ።

verses.en: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: ለባሪያህ እንደ ምሕረትህ አድርግ፥ ሥርዓትህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.am: እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ምስክርህንም አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: It is time for thee, YAHUAH, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የሥራ ጊዜ ነው፥ ሕግህንም ሻሩት።

verses.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከወርቅና ከዕንቍ ይልቅ ትእዛዝህን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ ትእዛዝህ ሁሉ አቀናሁ፥ የዓመፅንም መንገድ ሁሉ ጠላሁ።  ፌ

verses.en: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.am: ምስክሮችህ ድንቆች ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ነፍሴ ፈለገቻቸው።

verses.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.am: የቃልህ ፍቺ ያበራል፥ ሕፃናትንም አስተዋዮች ያደርጋል።

verses.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.am: አፌን ከፈትሁ፥ አለከለክሁም፤ ወደ ትእዛዝህ ናፍቄአለሁና።

verses.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.am: ስምህን ለሚወድዱ እንድምታደርገው ፍርድ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመልከተ ማረኝም።

verses.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.am: አካሄድን እንደ ቃልህ አቅና፤ ኃጢአትም ሁሉ አይግዛኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.am: ከሰው ግፍ አድነኝ፤ ትእዛዝህንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: በባሪያህ ላይ ፊትህን አብራ፥ ሥርዓትህንም አሰተምረኝ።

verses.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.am: ሕግህን አልጠበቅሁምና የውኃ ፈሳሽ ከዓይኖቼ ፈሰሰ።  ጻዴ

verses.en: TZADDI. Righteous art thou, O YAHUAH, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፥ ፍርድህም ቅን ነው።

verses.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.am: ምስክርህን በጽድቅ አዘዝህ፥ እጅግም ቅን ነው።

verses.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ቃልህን ረስተዋልና የቤትህ ቅንዓት አቀለጠኝ።

verses.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.am: ቃልህ እጅግ የነጠረ ነው፥ ባሪያህም ወደደው።

verses.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.am: እኔ ታናሽና የተናቅሁ ነኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.am: ጽድቅህ የዘላለም ጽድቅ ነው፥ ቃልህም እውነት ነው።

verses.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.am: መከራና ችግር አገኙኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህ ግን ተድላዬ ናቸው።

verses.en: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.am: ምስክርህ ለዘላለም ጽድቅ ነው፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ በሕይወትም አኑረኝ።  ቆፍ

verses.en: KOPH. I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O YAHUAH: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.am: በፍጹም ልቤ ጮኽሁ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስማኝ፤ ሥርዓትህን እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.en: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.am: ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ አድነኝ፥ ምስክርህንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.am: ማለዳ ጮኽሁ፤ ቃልህንም ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.am: ቃልህን አስብ ዘንድ ዓይኖቼ ለመማለድ ቀደሙ።

verses.en: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O YAHUAH, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቸርነትህ ድምፄን ስማ፤ እንደ ፍርድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.am: በዓመፃ የሚያሳድዱኝ ቀረቡ፥ ከሕግህም ራቁ።

verses.en: Thou art near, O YAHUAH; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቅርብ ነህ፥ መንገዶችህም ሁሉ ቅኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.am: ከዘላለም እንደ መሠረትኸው ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ ከምስክርህ የተነሣ አወቅሁ።  ሬስ

verses.en: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.am: ሕግህን አልረሳሁምና ችግሬን ተመልከት አድነኝም።

verses.en: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.am: ፍርዴን ፍረድ አድነኝም፤ ስለ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.am: መድኃኒት ከኅጥኣን ሩቅ ነው፥ ሥርዓትህን አልፈለጉምና።

verses.en: Great are thy tender mercies, O YAHUAH: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቸርነትህ እጅግ ብዙ ነው፤ እንደ ፍርድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.am: ያሳደዱኝና ያስጨነቁኝ ብዙዎች ናቸው፤ ከምስክር ግን ፈቀቅ አላልሁም።

verses.en: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.am: ቃልህን አልጠበቁምና ሰነፎችን አይቼ አዘንሁ።

verses.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O YAHUAH, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን እንደ ወደድሁ ተመልከት፤ አቤቱ፥ በምሕረትህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.am: የቃልህ መጀመሪያ እውነት ነው፥ የጽድቅህንም ፍርድ ሁሉ ለዘላለም ነው።  ሳን

verses.en: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.am: ገዢዎች በከንቱ አሳደዱኝ፤ ከቃልህ የተነሣ ግን ልቤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.am: ብዙ ምርኮ እንዳገኘ በቃልህ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.am: ዓመፃን ጠላሁ ተጸየፍሁም፤ ሕግን ግን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.am: ስለ ጽድቅህ ፍርድ ሰባት ጊዜ በቀን አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.am: ሕግህን ለሚወድዱ ብዙ ሰላም ነው፥ ዕንቅፋትም የለባቸውም።

verses.en: YAHUAH, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ማዳንህን ተስፋ አደርግሁ፥ ትእዛዛትህንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ምስክርህን ጠበቀች እጅግም ወደደችው።

verses.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.am: መንገዶቼ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናቸውና ትእዛዝህንና ምስክርህን ጠበቅሁ።  ታው

verses.en: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O YAHUAH: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትቅረብ፤ እንደ ቃልህም አስተዋይ አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.am: ልመናዬ ወደ ፊትህ ትድረስ፤ እንደ ቃልህ አድነኝ።

verses.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኸኛልና ከንፈሮቼ ምስጋናን አወጡ።

verses.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ ጽድቅ ናቸውና አንደበቴ ቃልህን ተናገረ።

verses.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህን መርጫለሁና እጅህ የሚያድነኝ ይሁን።

verses.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O YAHUAH; and thy law is my delight.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ማዳንህን ናፈቅሁ፤ ሕግህም ተድላዬ ነው።

verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ትኑርልኝ ታመሰግንህማለች፥ ፍርድህም ይርዳኝ።

verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.am: እንደ ጠፉ በግ ተቅበዘበዝሁ፤ ትእዛዛትህን አልረሳሁምና ባሪያህን ፈልገው።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] In my distress I cried unto YAHUAH, and he heard me.
verses.am: በተጨነቅሁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ ሰማኝም።

verses.en: Deliver my soul, O YAHUAH, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.am: ከዓመፀኛ ከንፈር ከሸንጋይም አንደበት፥ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን አድናት።

verses.en: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.am: ስለ ሽንገላ አንደበት ምንም ይሰጡሃል? ምንስ ይጨምሩልሃል?

verses.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.am: እንደ በረሃ እንጨት ፍም የኃያላን ፍላጾች የተሳሉ ናቸው።

verses.en: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.am: መኖሪያዬ የራቀ እኔ ወዮልኝ፤ በቄዳር ድንኳኖች አደርሁ።

verses.en: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.am: ሰላምን ከሚጠሉ ጋር ነፍሴ ብዙ ጊዜ ኖረች።

verses.en: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.am: እኔ ሰላማዊ ነኝ፤ በተናገኋቸው ጊዜ ግን በከንቱ ተሰለፉብኝ።

verses.en: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼ ወደ ተራሮች አነሣሁ፤ ረዳቴ ከወዴት ይምጣ?

verses.en: My help cometh from YAHUAH, which made heaven and earth.
verses.am: ረዳቴ ሰማይና ምድርን ከሠራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.am: እግርህን ለመናወጥ አይሰጠውም፤ የሚጠብቅህም አይተኛም።

verses.en: Behold, he that keepeth Yisra'el shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ አይተኛም አያንቀላፋምም።

verses.en: YAHUAH is thy keeper: YAHUAH is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቅሃል፥ እግዚአብሔርም በቀኝ እጅህ በኩል ይጋርድሃል።

verses.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.am: ፀሐይ በቀን አያቃጥልህም ጨረቃም በሌሊት።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከክፉ ሁሉ ይጠብቅሃል፥ ነፍስህንም ይጠብቃታል።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.am: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እግዚአብሔር መውጣትህና መግባትህን ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንሄድ ባሉኝ ጊዜ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ እግሮቻችን በአደባባይሽ ቆሙ።

verses.en: Yerushalayim is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌምስ እርስ በርስዋ እንደ ተገጠገጠች ከተማ ተሠርታለች።

verses.en: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of YAHUAH, unto the testimony of Yisra'el, to give thanks unto the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑ ዘንድ፥ ለእስራኤል ምስክር ሊሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ነገዶች ወደዚያ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of Dawid.
verses.am: ዙፋኖች በዚያ ለፍርድ ተቀምጠዋልና፥ የዳዊት ቤት ዙፋኖች።

verses.en: Pray for the peace of Yerushalayim: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.am: ለኢየሩሳሌም ሰላምን ለምኑ፤ አንተንም ለሚወድዱ ልማት ይሁን።

verses.en: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.am: በኃይልህ ሰላም፥ በጌጠኛ ቤትህም ልማት ይሁን።

verses.en: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.am: ስለ ወንድሞቼ ስለ ባልንጀሮቼም፥ በውስጥሽ ሰላም ይሁን አልሁ።

verses.en: Because of the house of YAHUAH our YAHUAH I will seek thy good.
verses.am: ስለ አምላካችን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ላንቺ መልካምነትሽን ፈለግሁ።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.am: 1 በሰማይ የምትኖር ሆይ፥ ዓይኖቼን ወደ አንተ አነሣሁ።

verses.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon YAHUAH our YAHUAH, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የባሪያዎች ዓይኖች ወደ ጌታቸው እጅ እንደ ሆኑ፥ የባሪያይቱም ዓይን ወደ እመቤትዋ እጅ እንደ ሆነ፥ እንዲሁ እስኪምረን ድረስ ዓይናችን ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Have mercy upon us, O YAHUAH, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.am: ማረን፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረን፤ ንቀትን እጅግ ጠግበናልና፤

verses.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.am: የባለጠጎች ስድብና የትዕቢተኞችን ንቀት ነፍሳችን እጅግ ጠገበች።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] If it had not been YAHUAH who was on our side, now may Yisra'el say;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ባይሆን እስራኤል እንዲህ ይበል።

verses.en: If it had not been YAHUAH who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ባይሆን ሰዎች በእኛ ላይ በተነሡ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.am: ቍጣቸውን በላያችን በነደደ ጊዜ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሕያዋን ሳለን በዋጡን ነበር፤

verses.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ውኃ ባሰጠመን ነበር፥ በነፍሳችንም ላይ ፈሳሽ ባለፈ ነበር፤

verses.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የጐርፍ ውኃ በነፍሳችን ላይ ባለፈ ነበር።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.am: ለጥርሳቸው ንክሻ ያላደረገን እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.am: ነፍሳችን እንደ ወፍ ከአዳኞች ወጥመድ አመለጠች። ወጥመድ ተሰበረ እኛም አመለጥን።

verses.en: Our help is in the name of YAHUAH, who made heaven and earth.
verses.am: ረድኤታችን ሰማይንና ምድርን በሠራ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ነው።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] They that trust in YAHUAH shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር የታመኑ እንደማይታወክ ለዘላለም እንደሚኖር እንደ ጽዮን ተራራ ናቸው።

verses.en: As the mountains are round about Yerushalayim, so YAHUAH is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.am: ተራሮች በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ እንደ ሆኑ፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ለዘላለም፤ እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ዙሪያ ነው።

verses.en: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.am: ጻድቃን እጃቸውን ወደ ክፋት እንዳይዘረጉ የኃጥኣን በትር በጻድቃን ዕጣ ላይ አይኖርም።

verses.en: Do good, O YAHUAH, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለቸሮች ልባቸውም ለቀና መልካምን አድርግ።

verses.en: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, YAHUAH shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Yisra'el.
verses.am: ወደ ጠማማነት የሚመለሱትን ግን ዓመፃን ከሚሠሩት ጋር እግዚአብሔር ይወስዳቸዋል። ሰላም በእስራኤል ላይ ይሁን።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] When YAHUAH turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ፥ እጅግ ደስተኞች ሆንን።

verses.en: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, YAHUAH hath done great things for them.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አፋችን ደስታን፥ አንደበታችንም ሐሴትን ሞላ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገላቸው ተባለ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገልን፥ ደስም አለን።

verses.en: Turn again our captivity, O YAHUAH, as the streams in the south.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በደቡብ እንዳሉ ፈሳሾች ምርኮአችንን መልስ።

verses.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.am: በልቅሶ የሚዘሩ በደስታ ይለቅማሉ።

verses.en: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.am: በሄዱ ጊዜ፥ ዘራቸውን ተሸክመው እያለቀሱ ተሰማሩ፤ በተመለሱ ጊዜ ግን ነዶአቸውን ተሸክመው ደስ እያላቸው ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees for Shelomoh.] Except YAHUAH build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except YAHUAH keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቤትን ካልሠራ፥ ሠራተኞች በከንቱ ይደክማሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከተማን ካልጠበቀ፥ ጠባቂ በከንቱ ይተጋል።

verses.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.am: በማለዳ መገሥገሣችሁም ከንቱ ነው። ለወዳጆቹ እንቅልፍን በሰጠ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ የመከራን እንጀራ የምትበሉ፥ ከተቀመጣችሁበት ተነሡ።

verses.en: Lo, children are an heritage of YAHUAH: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ልጆች የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ናቸው፥ የሆድም ፍሬ የእርሱ ዋጋ ነው።

verses.en: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
verses.am: በኃያል እጅ እንዳሉ ፍላጾች፥ የጐልማስነት ልጆች እንዲሁ ናቸው።

verses.en: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ምኞቱን የሚፈጽም ብፁዕ ሰው ነው፤ ጠላቶቻቸውን በአደባባይ በተናገሩ ጊዜ እርሱ አያፍርም።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Blessed is every one that feareth YAHUAH; that walketh in his ways.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩት ሁሉ፥ በመንገዶቹም የሚሄዱ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.am: የድካምህንም ፍሬ ትመገባለህ፤ ምስጉን ነህ መልካምም ይሆንልሃል።

verses.en: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.am: ሚስትህ በቤትህ እልፍኝ ውስጥ እንደሚያፈራ ወይን ናት፤ ልጆችህ በማዕድህ ዙሪያ እንደ ወይራ ቡቃያ ናቸው።

verses.en: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው እንዲህ ይባረካል።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Yerushalayim all the days of thy life.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን ይባርክህ፤ በሕይወትህ ዘመን ሁሉ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምን መልካምነትዋን ታያለህ።

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Yisra'el.
verses.am: የልጆችህንም ልጆች ታያለህ። በእስራኤል ላይ ሰላም ይሁን።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Yisra'el now say:
verses.am: እስራኤል። ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ ተሰለፉብኝ ይበል፤

verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.am: ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ ተሰለፉብኝ፤ ነገር ግን አላሸነፉኝም።

verses.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች በጀርባዬ ላይ መቱኝ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም አስረዘሙአት።

verses.en: YAHUAH is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው፤ የኃጢአተኞችን አንገታቸውን ቈረጠ።

verses.en: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.am: ጽዮንን የሚጠሉ ሁሉ ይፈሩ፥ ወደ ኋላቸውም ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.am: በሰገነት ላይ እንደ በቀለ ሣር፥ ሳይነቀል እንደሚደርቅ፥

verses.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.am: ለሚያጭደው እጁን፥ ነዶዎቹን ለሚሰበስብ እቅፉን እንደማይሞላ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of YAHUAH be upon you: we bless you in the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በመንገዱም የሚያልፉ። የእግዚአብሔር በረከት በእናንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንመርቃችኋለን አይሉም።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ከጥልቅ ጠራሁህ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ድምፄን ስማ፤ ጆሮህ የልመናዬን ቃል የሚያደምጥ ይሁን።

verses.en: If thou, YAHUAH, shouldest mark iniquities, O YAHUAH, who shall stand?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአትንስ ብትጠባበቅ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማን ይቆማል?

verses.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.am: ይቅርታ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና።

verses.en: I wait for YAHUAH, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ስምህ ተስፋ አደረግሁህ፤ ነፍሴ በሕግህ ታገሠች።

verses.en: My soul waiteth for YAHUAH more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.am: ከማለዳው ሰዓት ጀምሮ እስከ ሌሊት ነፍሴ በእግዚአብሔር ታመነች።

verses.en: Let Yisra'el hope in YAHUAH: for with YAHUAH there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምሕረት፥ በእርሱም ዘንድ ብዙ ማዳን ነውና እስራኤል በእግዚአብሔር ይታመን።

verses.en: And he shall redeem Yisra'el from all his iniquities.
verses.am: እርሱም እስራኤልን ከኃጢአቱ ሁሉ ያድነዋል።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] YAHUAH, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ልቤ አይታበይብኝ፥ ዓይኖቼም ከፍ ከፍ አይበሉብኝ፤ ከትልልቆች ጋር፥ ከእኔም ይበልጥ ከሚከበሩ ጋር አልሄድሁም።

verses.en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.am: ነፍሴን አሳረፍኋት፥ የእናቱንም ጡት እንዳስተውት ዝም አሰኘኋት፤ ነፍሴ የእናቱን ጡት እንዳስተውት በእኔ ውስጥ ናት።

verses.en: Let Yisra'el hope in YAHUAH from henceforth and for ever.
verses.am: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እስራኤል በእግዚአብሔር ይታመን።

verses.en: A Song of degrees. YAHUAH, remember Dawid, and all his afflictions:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ዳዊትን ገርነቱንም ሁሉ አስብ፤

verses.en: How he sware unto YAHUAH, and vowed unto the mighty YAHUAH of Ya'aqob;
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር እንደ ማለ፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ እንደ ተሳለ።

verses.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.am: በእውነት ወደ ቤቴ ድንኳን አልገባም፥ ወደ ምንጣፌም አልጋ አልወጣም፥

verses.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.am: ለዓይኖቼም መኝታ ለሽፋሽፍቶቼም እንቅልፍ፥ ለጕንጮቼም ዕረፍትን አልሰጥም፥

verses.en: Until I find out a place for YAHUAH, an habitation for the mighty YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ስፍራ፥ ለያዕቆብ አምላክ ማደሪያ እስካገኝ ድረስ ብሎ።

verses.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በኤፍራታ ሰማነው፥ በዱር ውስጥም አገኘነው።

verses.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.am: ወደ ማደሪያዎቹ እንገባለን፤ እግሮቹ በሚቆሙበት ስፍራ እንሰግዳለን።

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሥ፥ አንተና የመቅደስህ ታቦት።

verses.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.am: ካህናቶችህ ጽድቅን ይልበሱ፥ ቅዱሳንህም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: For thy servant Dawid's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.am: ስለ ዳዊት ስለ ባሪያህ የቀባኸውን ሰው ፊት አትመልስ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath sworn in truth unto Dawid; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዳዊት በእውነት ማለ አይጸጸትምም፥ እንዲህ ብሎ። ከሆድህ ፍሬ በዙፋንህ ላይ አስቀምጣለሁ።

verses.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.am: ልጆችህ ኪዳኔን፥ ይህንም የማስተምራቸውን ምስክሬን ቢጠብቁ፥ ልጆቻቸው ደግሞ በዙፋንህ ላይ ለዘላለም ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን መርጦአታልና፥ ማደሪያውም ትሆነው ዘንድ ወድዶአታልና፥ እንዲህ ብሎ።

verses.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.am: ይህች ለዘላለም ማረፊያዬ ናት፤ መርጫታለሁና በዚህች አድራለሁ።

verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.am: አሮጊቶችዋን እጅግ እባርካለሁ፥ ድሆችዋንም እንጀራ አጠግባለሁ።

verses.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.am: ካህናቶችዋንም ደኅንነትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፥ ቅዱሳኖችዋም እጅግ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: There will I make the horn of Dawid to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.am: በዚያ ለዳዊት ቀንድን አበቅላለሁ፥ ለቀባሁትም ሰው መብራትን አዘጋጃለሁ።

verses.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.am: ጠላቶችንም እፍረትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፤ በእርሱ ግን ቅድስናዬ ያብባል።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.am: ወንድሞች በኅብረት ቢቀመጡ፥ እነሆ፥ መልካም ነው፥ እነሆም፥ ያማረ ነው።

verses.en: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.am: ከራስ እስከ ጢም እንደሚፈስስ፥ እስከ አሮን ጢም፥ በልብሱ መደረቢያ እንደሚወርድ ሽቱ ነው።

verses.en: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there YAHUAH commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.am: በጽዮን ተራሮች እንደሚወርድ እንደ አርሞንዔም ጠል ነው፤ በዚያ እግዚአብሔር በረከቱን ሕይወትንም እስከ ዘላለም አዝዞአልና።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Behold, bless ye YAHUAH, all ye servants of YAHUAH, which by night stand in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ፥ በአምላካችን ቤት አደባባዬች የምትቆሙ እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሁላችሁ።

verses.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless YAHUAH.
verses.am: በሌሊት በቤተ መቅደስ ውስጥ እጆቻችሁን አንሡ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ባርኩ።

verses.en: YAHUAH that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.am: ሰማይንና ምድርን የሠራ እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን ይባርክህ።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise ye the name of YAHUAH; praise him, O ye servants of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። የእግዚአብሔርን ስም አመስግኑ፤ እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ አመስግኑት፥

verses.en: Ye that stand in the house of YAHUAH, in the courts of the house of our YAHUAH,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ፥ በአምላካችን ቤት አደባባይ የምትቆሙ።

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH; for YAHUAH is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ለስሙ ዘምሩ፥ መልካም ነውና፤

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath chosen Ya'aqob unto himself, and Yisra'el for his peculiar treasure.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ለራሱ፥ እስራኤልንም ለመዝገቡ መርጦታልና፤

verses.en: For I know that YAHUAH is great, and that our YAHUAH is above all elohim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ፥ ጌታችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ እንዲበልጥ አውቄአለሁና።

verses.en: Whatsoever YAHUAH pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.am: በሰማይና በምድር በባሕርና በጥልቆች ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር የወደደውን ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.am: ከምድር ዳር ደመናትን ያወጣል፤ በዝናብ ጊዜ መብረቅን አደረገ፤ ነፋሳትንም ከመዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.en: Who smote the firstborn of Mitsrayim, both of man and beast.
verses.am: የግብጽን በኵር ልጆች ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ መታ።

verses.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Mitsrayim, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.am: ግብጽ ሆይ፥ በመካከልሽ በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ ላይ ተኣምራትንና ድንቅን ሰደደ።

verses.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.am: ብዙ አሕዛብን መታ፥ ብርቱዎችንም ነገሥታት ገደለ።

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.am: የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ የባሳንንም ንጉሥ ዐግን፥ የከነዓንን መንግሥታት ሁሉ ገደለ፤

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Yisra'el his people.
verses.am: ምድራቸውንም ርስት አድርጎ ለእስራኤል ለሕዝቡ ርስት ሰጠ።

verses.en: Thy name, O YAHUAH, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O YAHUAH, throughout all generations.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስምህ ለዘላለም ነው፥ ዝክርህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው፤

verses.en: For YAHUAH will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳልና፥ ባሪያዎቹንም ይረዳልና።

verses.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ጣዖታት የብርና የወርቅ፥ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.am: አፍ አላቸው፥ አይናገሩምም፤ ዓይን አላቸው፥ አያዩምም፤

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.am: ጆሮ አላቸው፥ አይሰሙምም፤ እስትንፋስም በአፋቸው የለም።

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.am: የሚሠሩአቸው ሁሉ የሚታመኑባቸውም ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ ይሁን።

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O house of Yisra'el: bless YAHUAH, O house of Aaron:
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት። የአሮን ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት፤

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O house of Levi: ye that fear YAHUAH, bless YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሌዊ ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት።

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH out of Zion, which dwelleth at Yerushalayim. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የሚያድር እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን የተባረከ ነው። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH of elohim: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: የአማልክትን አምላክ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: O give thanks to YAHUAH of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: የጌቶችን ጌታ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: እርሱ ብቻውን ታላቅ ተኣምራትን ያደረገ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ሰማያትን በብልሃት የሠራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ምድርን በውኃ ላይ ያጸና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: ብቻውን ታላላቅ ብርሃናትን የሠራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: ለፀሐይ ቀንን ያስገዛው፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ለጨረቃና ለከዋክብትም ሌሊትን ያስገዛቸው፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that smote Mitsrayim in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: ከበኵራቸው ጋር ግብጽን የመታ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And brought out Yisra'el from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: እስራኤልንም ከመካከላቸው ያወጣ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: በጸናች እጅ በተዘረጋችም ክንድ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: የኤርትራን ባሕር በየክፍሉ የከፈለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And made Yisra'el to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: እስራኤልን በመካከሉ ያሳለፈ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ፈርዖንንና ሠራዊቱን በኤርትራ ባሕር የጣለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ሕዝቡን በምድረ በዳ የመራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: ታላላቅ ነገሥታትን የመታ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: ብርቱዎችንም ነገሥታት የገደለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: ምድራቸውን ርስት አድርጎ የሰጠ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: Even an heritage unto Yisra'el his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ለባሪያው ለእስራኤል ርስት፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: እኛን በመዋረዳችን አስቦናልና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ከጠላቶቻችንም እጅ አድኖናልና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ለሥጋ ሁሉ ምግብን የሚሰጥ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: የሰማይን አምላክ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: By the rivers of Babel, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.am: በባቢሎን ወንዞች አጠገብ በዚያ ተቀመጥን፤ ጽዮንንም ባሰብናት ጊዜ አለቀስን።

verses.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.am: በአኻያ ዛፎችዋ ላይ መሰንቆቻችንን ሰቀልን።

verses.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.am: የማረኩን በዚያ የዝማሬን ቃል ፈለጉብን፥ የወሰዱንም። የጽዮንን ዝማሬ ዘምሩልን አሉን።

verses.en: How shall we sing YAHUAH's song in a strange land?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ዝማሬ በባዕድ ምድር እንዴት እንዘምራለን?

verses.en: If I forget thee, O Yerushalayim, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ብረሳሽ፥ ቀኜ ትርሳኝ።

verses.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Yerushalayim above my chief joy.
verses.am: ባላስብሽ፥ ምላሴ በጕሮሮዬ ይጣበቅ፤ ከደስታዬ ሁሉ በላይ ኢየሩሳሌምን ባልወድድ።

verses.en: Remember, O YAHUAH, the children of Edom in the day of Yerushalayim; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ቀን የኤዶምን ልጆች አስብ። እስከ መሠረትዋ ድረስ አፍርሱ አፍርሱ ያሉአትን።

verses.en: O daughter of Babel, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.am: አንቺ ወራዳ የባቢሎን ልጅ ሆይ፥ ስለ ተበቀልሽን የሚበቀልሽ የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.am: ሕፃናቶችሽን ይዞ በዓለት ላይ የሚፈጠፍጣቸው የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the elohim will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፍጹም ልቤ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ የአፌን ነገር ሰምተኸኛልና፤ በመላእክት ፊት እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.am: ወደ ቅዱስ መቅደስህ እሰግዳለሁ፤ ስለ ምሕረትህና ስለ እውነትህ ስምህንም አመሰግናለሁ፥ በሁሉ ላይ ቅዱስ ስምህን ከፍ ከፍ አድርገሃልና።

verses.en: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.am: በጠራሁህ ቀን በፍጥነት አድምጠኝ፤ ነፍሴን በኃይልህ በብዙ አጸናሃት።

verses.en: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O YAHUAH, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፤ የአፍህን ቃል ሁሉ ሰምተዋልና።

verses.en: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of YAHUAH: for great is the glory of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም መንገድ ይዘምራሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ታላቅ ነውና።

verses.en: Though YAHUAH be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከፍ ያለ ነውና፥ ወደ ችግረኞችም ይመለከታልና፤ ትዕቢተኞችንም ከሩቅ ያውቃል።

verses.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.am: በመከራ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ፥ አንተ ሕያው ታደርገኛለህ፤ በጠላቶቼ ቍጣ ላይ እጆቼን ትዘረጋለህ፥ ቀኝህም ታድነኛለች።

verses.en: YAHUAH will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O YAHUAH, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ብድራትን ይመልስልኛል፤ አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ ለዘላለም ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ የእጅህን ሥራ ቸል አትበል።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መረመርኸኝ፥ አወቅኸኝም።

verses.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.am: አንተ መቀመጤንና መነሣቴን አወቅህ፤ አሳቤን ሁሉ ከሩቅ አስተዋልህ።

verses.en: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.am: ፍለጋዬንና ዕረፍቴን አንተ መረመርህ፤ መንገዶቼን ሁሉ ቀድመህ አወቅህ፥

verses.en: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O YAHUAH, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.am: የዓመፃ ቃል በአንደበቴ እንደሌለ።

verses.en: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ እነሆ የቀድሞውንና የኋላውን አወቅህ፤ አንተ ፈጠርኸኝ፥ እጅህንም በላዬ አደረግህ።

verses.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.am: እውቀትህ ከእኔ ይልቅ ተደነቀች፤ በረታች፥ ወደ እርስዋም ለመድረስ አልችልም።

verses.en: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.am: ከመንፈስህ ወዴት እሄዳለሁ? ከፊትህስ ወዴት እሸሻለሁ?

verses.en: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይ ብወጣ፥ አንተ በዚያ አለህ። ወደ ሲኦልም ብወርድ፥ በዚያ አለህ።

verses.en: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.am: እንደ ንስር የንጋትን ክንፍ ብወስድ፥ እስከ ባሕር መጨረሻም ብበርር፥

verses.en: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.am: በዚያ እጅህ ትመራኛለች፥ ቀኝህም ትይዘኛለች።

verses.en: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.am: በውኑ ጨለማ ትሸፍነኛለች ብል፥ ሌሊት በዙሪያዬ ብርሃን ትሆናለች፤

verses.en: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.am: ጨለማ በአንተ ዘንድ አይጨልምምና፥ ሌሊትም እንደ ቀን ታበራለችና፤ እንደ ጨለማዋ እንዲሁ ብርሃንዋ ነው።

verses.en: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ኵላሊቴን ፈጥረሃልና፥ በእናቴም ሆድ ሰውረኸኛል።

verses.en: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.am: ግሩምና ድንቅ ሆኜ ተፈጥሬአለሁና አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ሥራህ ድንቅ ነው፥ ነፍሴም እጅግ ታውቀዋለች።

verses.en: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.am: እኔ በስውር በተሠራሁ ጊዜ፥ አካሌም በምድር ታች በተሠራ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼ ከአንተ አልተሰወሩም።

verses.en: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.am: ያልተሠራ አካሌን ዓይኖችህ አዩኝ፤ የተፈጠሩ ቀኖቼ ሁሉ አንድ ስንኳ ሳይኖር በመጽሐፍህ ተጻፉ።

verses.en: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O YAHUAH! how great is the sum of them!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሳቦችህ በእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ምን እጅግ የተከበሩ ናቸው! ቍጥራቸውም እንደ ምን በዛ!

verses.en: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.am: ብቈጥራቸው ከአሸዋ ይልቅ ይበዛሉ፤ ተነሣሁም፥ እኔም ገና ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ።

verses.en: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O YAHUAH: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ኃጢአተኞችን የምትገድል ከሆንህስ፥ የደም ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ከእኔ ፈቀቅ በሉ።

verses.en: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.am: በክፋት ይናገሩብሃልና፤ ጠላቶችህም በከንቱ ያምፁብሃል።

verses.en: Do not I hate them, O YAHUAH, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሚጠሉህን እኔ የጠላሁ አይደለሁምን? ስለ ጠላቶችህም አልተሰቀቅሁምን?

verses.en: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.am: ፍጹም ጥል ጠላኋቸው፥ ጠላቶችም ሆኑኝ።

verses.en: Search me, O YAHUAH, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መርምረኝ ልቤንም እወቅ፤ ፍተነኝ መንገዴንም እወቅ፤

verses.en: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.am: በደልንም በእኔ ውስጥ ብታገኝ እይ፤ የዘላለምንም መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Deliver me, O YAHUAH, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.am: ለመዘምራን አለቃ የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.en: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከክፉ ሰው አድነኝ፥ በልባቸውም ክፉ ካሰቡ ከዓመፀኞች ሰዎች ጠብቀኝ፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ ለሰልፍ ይከማቻሉ።

verses.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.am: ምላሳቸውን እንደ እባብ ሳሉ፤ ከከንፈራቸው በታች የእፉኝት መርዝ ነው።

verses.en: Keep me, O YAHUAH, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከኃጢአተኞች እጅ ጠብቀኝ፥ እርምጃዬንም ሊያሰናክሉ ከመከሩ ከዓመፀኞች አድነኝ።

verses.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኞች ወጥመድን ሰወሩብኝ፥ ለእግሮቼም የወጥመድ ገመድን ዘረጉ፤ በመንገድ ዕንቅፋትን አኖሩ።

verses.en: I said unto YAHUAH, Thou art my YAHUAH: hear the voice of my supplications, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም። አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፤ የልመናዬን ቃል፥ አቤቱ፥ አድምጥ አልሁት።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጌታዬ፥ የመድኃኒቴ ጕልበት፥ በሰልፍ ቀን ራሴን ሸፈንህ።

verses.en: Grant not, O YAHUAH, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከምኞቴ የተነሣ ለኃጢአተኞች አትስጠኝ፤ በላዬ ተማከሩ፤ እንዳይጓደዱ አትተወኝ።

verses.en: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.am: የሚከብቡኝን ራስ የከንፈራቸው ክፋት ይክደናቸው።

verses.en: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.am: የእሳት ፍም በላያቸው ይውደቅ፤ እንዳይነሡም ወደ እሳትና ወደ ማዕበል ይጣሉ።

verses.en: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.am: ተናጋሪ ሰው በምድር ውስጥ አይጸናም፤ ዓመፀኛን ሰው ክፋት ለጥፋት ይፈልገዋል።

verses.en: I know that YAHUAH will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለድሀ ዳኝነትን ለችግረኛም ፍርድን እንዲያደርግ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.am: ጻድቃንም በእውነት ስምህን ያመሰግናሉ፤ ቀኖችም በፊትህ ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ ስማኝ፤ ወደ አንተ ስጮኽም የልመናዬን ቃል አድምጥ።

verses.en: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.am: ጸሎቴን በፊትህ እንደ ዕጣን ተቀበልልኝ፥ እጅ መንሣቴም እንደ ሠርክ መሥዋዕት ትሁን።

verses.en: Set a watch, O YAHUAH, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለአፌ ጠባቂ አኑር፥ የከንፈሮቼንም መዝጊያ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.am: ልቤን ወደ ክፉ ነገር አትመልሰው፥ ዓመፃን ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ጋር ለኃጢአት ምክንያት እንዳልሰጥ፤ ከምርጦቻቸውም ጋር አልተባበር።

verses.en: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.am: ጻድቅ በምሕረት ይገሥጸኝ፥ ይዝለፈኝም፥ የኃጢአተኛ ዘይት ግን ራሴን አይቅባ፤ ጸሎቴ ገና በክፋታቸው ላይ ነውና።

verses.en: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.am: ኃያላኖቻቸው በዓለት አጠገብ ተጣሉ፤ ጣፋጭ ናትና ቃሌን ይሰማሉ።

verses.en: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ እንደ ተሰነጠቀ እንደ መሬት ጓል፥ እንዲሁ አጥንቶቻችን በሲኦል ተበተኑ።

verses.en: But mine eyes are unto thee, O YAHUAH: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታ፥ ዓይኖቼ ወደ አንተ ናቸውና፤ በአንተ ታመንሁ፥ ነፍሴን አታውጣት።

verses.en: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.am: ከሰወሩብኝ ወጥመድ፥ ዓመፅንም ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ዕንቅፋት ጠብቀኝ።

verses.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.am: እኔ ብቻዬን እስካልፍ ድረስ ኃጢአተኞች በወጥመዳቸው ይውደቁ።

verses.en: [Maschil of Dawid; A Prayer when he was in the cave.] I cried unto YAHUAH with my voice; with my voice unto YAHUAH did I make my supplication.
verses.am: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፤ በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለመንሁ።

verses.en: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.am: ልመናዬን በፊቱ አፈስሳለሁ፤ መከራዬንም በፊቴ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በውስጤ ባለቀች ጊዜ መንገዴን አወቅሁ፤ በምሄድባት በዚያች መንገድ ወጥመድን ሰወሩብኝ።

verses.en: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.am: ወደ ቀኝ ተመለከትሁ አየሁም፥ የሚያውቀኝም አጣሁ፤ መሸሸጊያም የለኝም፥ ስለ ነፍሴም የሚመራመር የለም።

verses.en: I cried unto thee, O YAHUAH: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ። አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህ፥ በሕያዋንም ምድር አንተ እድል ፈንታዬ ነህ አልሁ።

verses.en: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.am: እጅግ ተቸግሬአለሁና ወደ ልመናዬ አድምጥ፤ በርትተውብኛልና ከሚያሳድዱኝ አድነኝ።

verses.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስምህን አመሰግን ዘንድ፤ ነፍሴን ከወህኒ አውጣት፤ ዋጋዬን እስክትሰጠኝ ድረስ ጻድቃን እኔን ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ በእውነትህ ልመናዬን አድምጥ፥ በጽድቅህም መልስልኝ።

verses.en: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.am: ሕያው ሁሉ በፊትህ ጻድቅ አይደለምና ከባሪያህ ጋር ወደ ፍርድ አትግባ።

verses.en: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.am: ጠላትህ ነፍሴን አሳድዶአታል፥ ሕይወቴንም በምድር ውስጥ አጐስቍሎአታል፤ ቀድሞ እንደ ሞተ ሰው በጨለማ አኑሮኛል።

verses.en: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በውስጤ አለቀችብኝ፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.en: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.am: የቀድሞውን ዘመን አሰብሁ፥ ሥራህንም ሁሉ አሰላሰልሁ፤ የእጅህንም ሥራ ተመለከትሁ።

verses.en: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.am: እጆቼን ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፤ ነፍሴም እንደ ምድረ በዳ አንተን ተጠማች።

verses.en: Hear me speedily, O YAHUAH: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፈጥነህ ስማኝ፤ ነፍሴ አልቃለች፤ ፊትህን ከኔ አትመልስ፥ ወደ ጕድጓድም እንደሚወርዱ አልሁን።

verses.en: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.am: አንተን ታምኛለሁና በማለዳ ምሕረትህን አሰማኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አንሥቻለሁና የምሄድበትን መንገድ አስታውቀኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me, O YAHUAH, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ተማፅኛለሁና ከጠላቶቼ አድነኝ።

verses.en: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my YAHUAH: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.am: አንተ አምላኬ ነህና ፈቃድህን ለማድረግ አስተምረኝ፤ ቅዱስ መንፈስህም በጽድቅ ምድር ይምራኝ።

verses.en: Quicken me, O YAHUAH, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ስምህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ በጽድቅህም ነፍሴን ከመከራዋ አውጣት።

verses.en: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
verses.am: በምሕረትህ ጠላቶቼን ደምስሳቸው፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝና ነፍሴን የሚያስጨንቁአትን ሁሉ አጥፋቸው።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Blessed be YAHUAH my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ይባረክ፥ ለእጆቼ ሰልፍን፥ ለጣቶቼም ዘመቻን የሚያስተምር፤

verses.en: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.am: መሓሪዬና መሸሸጊያዬ፥ መጠጊያዬና መድኃኒቴ፤ ረዳቴና መታመኛዬም፤ ሕዝቤንም ከእኔ በታች የሚያስገዛልኝ።

verses.en: YAHUAH, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እርሱን ታውቀው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ታስብለት ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.am: ሰው ከንቱን ነገር ይመስላል፤ ዘመኑ እንደ ጥላ ያልፋል።

verses.en: Bow thy heavens, O YAHUAH, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሰማዮችህን ዝቅ ዝቅ አድርጋቸው ውረድም፤ ተራሮችን ዳስሳቸው ይጢሱም።

verses.en: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.am: መብረቆችህን ብልጭ አድርጋቸው በትናቸውም፤ ፍላጾችህን ላካቸው አስደንግጣቸውም።

verses.en: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.am: እጅህን ከአርያም ላክ አድነኝም ከብዙ ውኆች፥ አፋቸውም ምናምንን ከሚናገር፥ ቀኛቸው የሐሰት ቀኝ ከሆነ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆች እጅ አስጥለኝ።

verses.en: I will sing a new song unto thee, O YAHUAH: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አዲስ ቅኔ እቀኛልሃለሁ፤ አሥር አውታር ባለው በገና እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth Dawid his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.am: ለነገሥታት መድኃኒትን የሚሰጥ፥ ባሪያውን ዳዊትን ከክፉ ሰይፍ የሚያድነው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.am: አድነኝ፥ አፋቸውም ምናምንን ከሚናገር፥ ቀኛቸውም የሐሰት ቀኝ ከሆነ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆች እጅ አስጥለኝ።

verses.en: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.am: ልጆቻቸው በጕልማስነታቸው እንደ አዲስ አትክልት የሆኑ፥ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም እንደ እልፍኝ ያማሩና ያጌጡ፤

verses.en: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.am: ዕቃ ቤቶቻቸውም የተሞሉ በየዓይነቱ ዕቃ የሚሰጡ፥ በጎቻቸውም ብዙ የሚወልዱ፥ በማሰማርያቸውም የሚበዙ፥

verses.en: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.am: ላሞቻቸውም የሚሰቡ፤ ቅጥራቸውም መፍረሻና መውጫ የሌለው፥ በአደባባዮቻቸውም ዋይታ የሌለ፤

verses.en: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose YAHUAH is YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንደዚህ የሚሆን ሕዝብ የተመሰገነ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ የሆነ ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: [Dawid's Psalm of praise.] I will extol thee, my YAHUAH, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.am: አምላኬ ንጉሤ ሆይ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም ዓለምም እባርካለሁ።

verses.en: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.am: በየቀኑ ሁሉ እባርክሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም ዓለምም አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: Great is YAHUAH, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው እጅግም የተመሰገነ ነው፤ ለታላቅነቱም ፍጻሜ የለውም።

verses.en: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.am: ትውልደ ትውልድ ሥራህን ያመሰግናሉ፥ ኃይልህንም ያወራሉ።

verses.en: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.am: የቅድስናህን ግርማ ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ ተኣምራትህንም ይነጋገራሉ።

verses.en: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.am: የግርማህንም ኃይል ይናገራሉ፥ ታላቅነትህንም ይነጋገራሉ፥ ብርታትህንም ይነጋገራሉ።

verses.en: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.am: የቸርነትህን ብዛት መታሰብ ያወጣሉ፥ በጽድቅህም ሐሤትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ርኅሩኅና መሓሪ ነው፥ ከቍጣ የራቀ፥ ምሕረቱም ብዙ ነው፤

verses.en: YAHUAH is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሚታገሡት ቸር ነው። ምሕረቱም በሥራው ሁሉ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: All thy works shall praise thee, O YAHUAH; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፥ ቅዱሳንህም ይባርኩሃል።

verses.en: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.am: የመንግሥትህን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ ኃይልህንም ይነጋገራሉ፥

verses.en: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ኃይልህን የመንግሥትህንም ግርማ ክብር ያስታውቁ ዘንድ

verses.en: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.am: መንግሥትህ የዘላለም መንግሥት ናት፥ ግዛትህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቃሎቹ የታመነ ነው፥ በሥራውም ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር የተፍገመገሙትን ሁሉ ይደግፋቸዋል፥ የወደቁትንም ያነሣቸዋል።

verses.en: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.am: የሁሉ ዓይን አንተን ተስፋ ያደርጋል፤ አንተም ምግባቸውን በየጊዜው ትሰጣቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.am: አንተ እጅህን ትከፍታለህ፥ ሕይወት ላለውም ሁሉ መልካምን ታጠግባለህ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በመንገዱ ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነው በሥራውም ሁሉ ቸር ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ፥ በእውነት ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ ቅርብ ነው።

verses.en: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.am: ለሚፈሩት ምኞታቸውን ያደርጋል፥ ልመናቸውንም ይሰማል ያድናቸዋልም።

verses.en: YAHUAH preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የሚወድዱትን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል፤ ኃጢአተኞችንም ሁሉ ያጠፋል።

verses.en: My mouth shall speak the praise of YAHUAH: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.am: አፌ የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና ይናገራል፤ ሥጋም ሁሉ ለዘላለም ዓለም የተቀደሰውን ስሙን ይባርክ።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise YAHUAH, O my soul.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኚ።

verses.en: While I live will I praise YAHUAH: I will sing praises unto my YAHUAH while I have any being.
verses.am: በሕይወቴ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፤ በምኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ ለአምላኬ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.am: ማዳን በማይችሉ በሰው ልጆችና በአለቆች አትታመኑ።

verses.en: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.am: ነፍሱ ትወጣለች ወደ መሬቱም ይመለሳል፤ ያን ጊዜ ምክሩ ሁሉ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Happy is he that hath YAHUAH of Ya'aqob for his help, whose hope is in YAHUAH his YAHUAH:
verses.am: የያዕቆብ አምላክ ረዳቱ የሆነ ተስፋውም በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር የሆነ ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤

verses.en: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.am: እርሱም ሰማይንና ምድርን ባሕርንም፥ በእነርሱ ያለውንም ሁሉ የፈጠረ፤ እውነትን ለዘላለም የሚጠብቅ፤

verses.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. YAHUAH looseth the prisoners:
verses.am: ለተበደሉት የሚፈርድ፥ ለተራቡ ምግብን የሚሰጥ ነው። እግዚአብሔር የታሰሩትን ይፈታል፤

verses.en: YAHUAH openeth the eyes of the blind: YAHUAH raiseth them that are bowed down: YAHUAH loveth the righteous:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የወደቁትን ያነሣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ዕውሮችን ጥበበኞች ያደርጋቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ጻድቃንን ይወድዳል፤

verses.en: YAHUAH preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስደተኞችን ይጠብቃል፤ ድሀ አደጎችንና ባልቴቶችን ይቀበላል፤ የኃጢአተኞችንም መንገድ ያጠፋል።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall reign for ever, even thy YAHUAH, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይነግሣል፤ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ አምላክሽ ለልጅ ልጅ ነው። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH: for it is good to sing praises unto our YAHUAH; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ መዝሙር መልካም ነውና። ለአምላካችን ምስጋና ያማረ ነው።

verses.en: YAHUAH doth build up Yerushalayim: he gathereth together the outcasts of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ይሠራል፥ ከእስራኤልም የተበተኑትን ይሰበስባል።

verses.en: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.am: ልባቸውን የቈሰሉትን ይፈውሳል፥ ሕማማቸውንም ይጠግናል።

verses.en: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.am: የከዋክብትንም ብዛት ይቈጥራል፥ ሁሉንም በየስማቸው ይጠራቸዋል።

verses.en: Great is our YAHUAH, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.am: ጌታችን ታላቅ ነው፥ ኃይሉም ታላቅ ነው፥ ለጥበቡም ቍጥር የለውም።

verses.en: YAHUAH lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የዋሃንን ያነሣል፥ ኃጢአተኞችን ግን እስከ ምድር ድረስ ያዋርዳል።

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our YAHUAH:
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በምስጋና ዘምሩ፥ ለአምላካችንም በመሰንቆ ዘምሩ፤

verses.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.am: ሰማዩን በደመናት ይሸፍናል ለምድርም ዝናብን ያዘጋጃል፤ ሣርን በተራሮች ላይ ያበቅላል፤ ለምለሙንም ለሰው ልጆች ጥቅም።

verses.en: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.am: ለሚጠሩት ለቍራዎች ጫጩቶች ለእንስሶችም ምግባቸውን ይሰጣል።

verses.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.am: የፈረስን ኃይል አይወድድም፥ በሰውም ጭን አይደሰትም።

verses.en: YAHUAH taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሚፈሩት፥ በምሕረቱም በሚታመኑት ይደሰታል።

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH, O Yerushalayim; praise thy YAHUAH, O Zion.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኚ፥

verses.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.am: ጽዮንም ሆይ፥ ለአምላክሽ እልል በዪ፤ የደጆችሽን መወርወሪያ አጽንቶአልና፥ ልጆችንም በውስጥሽ ባርኮአልና።

verses.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.am: በወሰንሽም ሰላምን አደረገ፥ የስንዴንም ስብ አጠገበሽ።

verses.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.am: ነገሩን ወደ ምድር ይሰድዳል፥ ቃሉም እጅግ ፈጥኖ ይሮጣል።

verses.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.am: አመዳዩን እንደ ባዘቶ ይሰጣል፤ ጉሙን እንደ አመድ ይበትነዋል፤

verses.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.am: በረዶውን እንደ ፍርፋሪ ያወርዳል፤ በበረዶውስ ፊት ማን ይቆማል?

verses.en: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.am: ቃሉን ልኮ ያቀልጠዋል፤ ነፋሱን ያነፍሳል፥ ውኆችንም ያፈስሳል።

verses.en: He sheweth his word unto Ya'aqob, his statutes and his judgments unto Yisra'el.
verses.am: ቃሉን ለያዕቆብ፥ ሥርዓቱንና ፍርዱን ለእስራኤል ይናገራል።

verses.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለሌሎች አሕዛብ ሁሉ እንዲህ አላደረገም፥ ፍርዱንም አልገለጠላቸውም። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise ye YAHUAH from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን ከሰማያት አመስግኑት፤ በአርያም አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.am: መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት፤ ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.am: ፀሐይና ጨረቃ፥ አመስግኑት፤ ከዋክብትና ብርሃን ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.am: ሰማየ ሰማያት፥ አመስግኑት የሰማያት በላይም ውኃ።

verses.en: Let them praise the name of YAHUAH: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.am: እርሱ ብሎአልና፥ ሆኑም፤ እርሱም አዝዞአልና፥ ተፈጠሩም፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑት።

verses.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ዓለም አቆማቸው፤ ትእዛዝን ሰጠ፥ አያልፉምም።

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.am: እባቦች ጥልቆችም ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ከምድር አመስግኑት፤

verses.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.am: እሳትና በረዶ አመዳይና ውርጭ፥ ቃሉን የሚያደርግ ዐውሎ ነፋስም፤

verses.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.am: ተራሮች ኰረብቶችም ሁሉ፥ የሚያፈራም ዛፍ ዝግባም ሁሉ፤

verses.en: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.am: አራዊትም እንስሳትም ሁሉ፥ ተንቀሳቃሾችም የሚበርሩ ወፎችም፤

verses.en: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.am: የምድር ነገሥታት አሕዛብም ሁሉ፥ አለቆች የምድርም ፈራጆች ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.am: ጕልማሶችና ቈነጃጅቶች፥ ሽማግሌዎችና ልጆች፤

verses.en: Let them praise the name of YAHUAH: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑ፤ ስሙ ብቻውን ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና፥ ምስጋናውም በሰማይና በምድር ላይ ነው።

verses.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Yisra'el, a people near unto him. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሕዝቡንም ቀንድ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ የቅዱሳኑንም ሁሉ ምስጋና ወደ እርሱ ለቀረበ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሕዝብ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Sing unto YAHUAH a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። ለእግዚአብሔር አዲሱን ቅኔ ተቀኙለት፤ ምስጋናው በቅዱሳኑ ጉባኤ ነው።

verses.en: Let Yisra'el rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.am: እስራኤል በፈጣሪው ደስ ይበለው፥ የጽዮንም ልጆች በንጉሣቸው ሐሤትን ያድርጉ።

verses.en: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.am: ስሙን በዘፈን ያመስግኑ፥ በከበሮና በመሰንቆም ይዘምሩለት።

verses.en: For YAHUAH taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ተደስቶአልና፥ የዋሃንንም በማዳኑ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.am: ቅዱሳን በክብር ይመካሉ፤ በምንጣፋቸውም ላይ ሐሤትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: Let the high praises of YAHUAH be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና በጕሮሮአቸው ነው፤ ሁለት አፍ ያለውም ሰይፍ በእጃቸው ነው፥

verses.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.am: በአሕዛብ ላይ በቀልን በሰዎችም መካከል ቅጣትን ያደርጉ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.am: ንጉሦቻቸውን በሰንሰለት፥ አለቆቻቸውንም በእግር ብረት ያስሩ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: የተጻፈውን ፍርድ ያደርጉባቸው ዘንድ። ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ይህች ክብር ናት። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise YAHUAH in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን በመቅደሱ አመስግኑት፤ በኃይሉ ጠፈር አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.am: በችሎቱ አመስግኑት፤ በታላቅነቱ ብዛት አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.am: በመለከት ድምፅ አመስግኑት፤ በበገናና በመሰንቆ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.am: በከበሮና በዘፈን አመስግኑት፤ በአውታርና በእምቢልታ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.am: ድምፁ መልካም በሆነ ጸናጽል አመስግኑት፤ እልልታ ባለው ጸናጽል አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise YAHUAH. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: እስትንፋስ ያለው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግን። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: I was small among my brothers, and youngest in my father’s house. I tended my father’s sheep.
My hands formed a musical instrument, and my fingers tuned a lute.
Who shall tell my Master? YAHUAH himself, he himself hears.
He sent forth his angel and took me from my father’s sheep, and he anointed me with his anointing oil.
My brothers were handsome and tall; but YAHUAH did not take pleasure in them.
I went out to meet the Philistine, and he cursed me by his idols.
But I drew his own sword and beheaded him, and removed reproach from the children of Yisra'el.
